tei:div.tei:p: $$ ༄༅// bla ma kun dga' tshe dbang rin po che'i mdzad rnam mdor bsdus bzhugs so//

༄༅// bsil ldan rwa ba'i ljongs chol gsum chos ldan gyi yul gru'i nang tshan/ mdo khams sgang drug dang chu bzhi shod chen bcu gsum gyis mdzes pa las/ rngul zla zal mo'i sgang dbyi shod ri bo che'i sa yi char/ yon tan gnas mchog gze rgyal tsā ri tra yis nye bar skyong ba'i yul/ rdo shul stod ma'i phyogs gtogs gangs gzhung gang chung phu zhes pa'i sa char/ 'gro phan sman pa'i brgyud pa bar ma chad par byung zhing dam pa'i chos la blo gtad byed pa'i rigs rus dri ma med pa gi li tshang zhes par yab gi li padma dang*/ yum tshe g.yang gnyis kyi sras su rab byung bco lnga pa'i shing byi spyi lo 1924 lor sku bltams/ chab mdo'i 'phags pa lhas dwags po'i rnam sprul yin pas 'gro phan rgya cher 'byung bar lung bstan/ rdo shul spyi'i ma dgon sgo chen bdud 'dul sngags gling gi grwa sar zhugs shing bla ma nam mkha' tshe dbang la gtsug phud phul/ mtshan kun dga' tshe dbang du gsol/ sku nar son rim bzhin bod yig 'bri klog sogs la sbyangs/ lhag par du rje 'di nyid gso rig mkhas pa'i dbang phyug zhig te sku na chung dus nas rang yul sman pa thag lug bu nor mdun nas rtsa chu dang sngo sman ngos 'dzin skor bslabs/ de nas 'dzi sgar kong sprul 'jam mgon blo gros rab 'phel mdun nas zin tig skor sogs nad par sman sprod pa'i zhal khrid zhib rgyas gsan pa ma zad bka' rnying gi zab chos du ma gsan/ tsha ba sgang ske dgon pa'i sprul sku ri che zhabs drung gsum pa'i sras yongs grags su sras sprul zhu ba khong gi sku mdun nas rgyud bzhi rgyas bshad dang*/ sgo chen mkhan po 'bum skyabs nor bu'am 'bum dga'i mdun nas rtsis dkar nag dang sdom gsum/ spyod 'jug sogs tha snyad dang nang rig pa'i gzhung lugs du ma gsan sbyang gnad smin du mdzad/ gnam sprul bzod pa rab brtan sku mdun nas gnam lcags chos skor yongs rdzogs gsan zhing*/

'jam mgon blo rab sku mdun nas rin chen gter mdzod chen mo dang ratna'i phur pa/ snying thig skor smin khrid gsan bzhes mdzad/ khyad par du rigs bdag sras sprul mdun yun ring bzhugs te rin chen gter mdzod chen mo'i dbang dang*/ rdzogs pa chen po klong chen snying thig gi gdams zab rnams dang*/ mtshan bcas mtshan med kyi rdzogs rim skor khrid sbyang mthar phyin pa mdzad cing thugs kyi sras su gyur/ dpal spung si tu padma dbang mchog rgyal po'i mdun nas 'gro mgon bka' brgyud pa'i gdams zab gtsor gyur pa'i thun min man ngag kyang thob pa sogs mdor na mkhas grub du ma'i zhabs rdul spyi bor blangs shing gdams zab bdud rtsi'i snying po spyi rabs gdul bya'i dpal du bskrun/ de nas mdo khams sde dge rdzong gsar bkra shis lha rtse'i chos grwar phebs te 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse chos kyi blo gros mchog gi sku drung du bcar nas chos grwa bkra shis lha rtser yun ring bzhugs te/ bka' rnying sa gsum gyi gdams zab rgya cher gsan/ de nas dbus kyi lha gdan phyogs su phebs skabs bka' blon raka ka shag tshang la gnas tshang g.yar po zhus pas gnang*/ de'i phyi nyin raka ka shag rgyud sman rtsis khang lcags ri 'gro phan rig byed gling sman gyi slob grwar bzhugs/ sman rtsis mkhas dbang mkhyen rab nor bu dang mjal zhing khong gi sku mdun nas rgyud bzhi dang de'i 'grel pa/ bai sngon/ byang zur gnyis kyi rgyud 'grel/ g.yu thog pa'i rgyud bzhi cha lag bco brgyad/ dar mo sman ram pa'i man ngag bka' rgya ma sogs la lo ngo gsum gyi ring bzhugs te sbyang brtson gnang*/ de nas bkra shis lhun po dang*/ gtsang sa skya/ rgyang rtse/ lho brag sogs nas 'brug yul rgyud 'brug gi gnas chen khag dang*/ rgya gar gyi gnas chen khag /bal yul mchod rten rnam gsum sogs su gnas mjal tu phebs pa dang*/ de nas chab mdo rdza chu rgyud kyi sman pa mkhas chen 'ju mi pham gyi dngos slob brag 'go dpon lha'i mdun nas sman gyi lag len zhib phra dang*/

sngo sman skor dang gsang sman ngos 'dzin khyad par du 'phags pa 'jam mgon mi pham pa'i zhal khrid thun mong ma yin par grags pa rnams yongs su gsan/ de nas chab mdor phebs karma pa dang skyabs mgon rgyal dbang mchog mjal zhing*/ thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang*/ yi dam 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum pa'i dbang chen rnams thob/ de dag kyang sgrub pa snying por gzhol te nyams bzhes mdzad pas/ yi dam lhag pa'i lha rab 'byams kyis zhal gzigs/ khyad par gangs chung phur sbra chung phub ste yi dam rata gling phur pa bsnyen sgrub gzhol ba'i tshe phur khrom 'phar ba dang*/ yongs dge'i gro lod bsnyen pa'i tshe rakta phyur ba dang*/ 'chi med 'phags ma snying thig bsnyen sgrub gnang tshe bu mo lo chung zhig gis/ dung gi mchod rten zhig dngos su sprad pa sogs grub pa'i mtshan ma brnyes/ mdor na yi dam rtsa ba gsum gtso bor byas pa'i lhag pa'i lha rab 'byams la gnas chen gangs brag rnams su lo zla zhag sogs sgrub pa mdzad pas/ de dang de dag gi grub pa'i mtshan ma brnyes te mchog thun la dbang 'byor/ lha dang srung ma rtag tu 'go bas/ sman bsdu sgrub kyi skabs sman rdzas rnyed dka' ba rnams sman srung zhang blon sogs kyis rtsol med du 'bul du yong ba kun gyis mthong thos myong gsum du yod/ sman bcos kyi phan 'bras shin tu bzang bas ri bo che dang khyung po steng chen nang chen sogs nye 'khor mang tshogs kyi khrod du dam pa khong la snyan grags dang bag chags zab mo mnga' ba ma zad/ khyung po/ rdo shul/ nang chen/ dge ri sogs nas slob tshogs kyang mang du 'dus pas de dag la/ phyi ltar na sman gyi slob sbyong dang*/ nang ltar dge sgrub sdig spang sogs thun mong blo sbyong dang sngon 'gro bsags sbyang nas thun min bskyed rdzogs kyi bar gang zag gi nyams tshod dang bstun te gnang*/ khong gi gzhan phan gyi mdzad pa bzang pos yid 'phrog te rdo shul stod smad dang steng chen/

nang chen phyogs sogs yul gru so so nas yong ba'i slob tshogs kyang mang du 'dus pa ma zad/ de dag las sbyang 'bras legs par mthar son pa'i sman pa brgyad cu gya lnga tsam byung ba de dag kyang gzhan phan sman brgyud kyi 'gro don phyogs mthar khyab bzhin pa dang*/ dam pa khong gi mkhyen dpyod dang sku tshe hril por sman bcos gnang ba'i nyams myong khag zin bris su bkod pa/ nyer mkho bdud rtsi'i bum bzang zhes bya ba'i nyams yig khyad du 'phags pa phyis 'byung gdul bya'i bgo skal du bstsal ba de/ ri bo che rdzong sman khang dang 'phrod bsten cus kyis bod sman pa rnams la slob gzhir 'grem spel byas pa dang*/ gzhung dmangs gnyis nas bsngags brjod kyi me tog 'thor ba bcas mdor na dgon 'di dang khyad par yul 'dir gtsos pa'i nyam thag mgon med kyi nad pa dbul phongs sogs la/ bka' drin dang thugs rje tshad med pa'i mdzad pa bzang po gnang*/ dgung grangs don gsum pa me byi lo 1996 lor bod zla brgyad pa'i tshes bco brgyad nyin glo bur du sku bsnyun pa'i tshul bstan te tshes bcu dgu nyin dgongs pa chos dbyings su thim/ thugs dam nyin gsum ring bzhugs/ de nas thugs dam grol rjes gdung chas gsol te dgung zhag zhe dgu'i ring grwa tshang yongs nas smin gling rdor sems dang*/ sman bla'i mdo chog 'jam mgon mi pham gsung bcas kyi sgo nas mchod 'bul rgya cher phul ba sogs gshegs rjes kyi bya ba rnams grwa tshang yongs nas thugs 'gan bzhes te 'thus tshang zhus/ rje de'i yang sprul 'khrul bral zla ba gzhon nu mchog gi 'dzum zhal khyung po rme ru phyogs nas gsal/ de yang gzhan phan mdzad pa bzang po'i 'od dkar phyogs nas phyogs su 'phro ba'i rten 'brel gyi thog mar a 'dzoms 'brug chen padma phrin las mchog gis gnam lcags rtsa gsum gling pa'i thugs sprul sku 'phreng drug pa 'phags pa rgya mtsho'i sras de nyid/

kun dga' tshe dbang mchog gis yang srid du ngos 'dzin gnang nas mtshan 'gyur med bstan pa rnam rgyal zhes gsol te bstan dang 'gro ba'i don du 'tsho zhing gzhes pa lags so/// / ༄༅// nad sman sprod pa'i nyams yig lag len cung zad bcas kyi nyams myong bdud rtsi'i bum bzang bzhugs so// ༄༅// sman bla drang srong rig 'dzin la// mi phyed snying nas rab btud nas// srid pa'i rims nad drung 'byin phyir// nyams kyi yig chung 'di na spro// de la rtags dang bcos thabs gnyis kyis bstan// thog mar rtags la nad kyi byung tshul dang*// rgyu rkyen zhugs tshul blta reg dri ba yis// nad ngos bzung ste zas spyod sman dpyad kyi// spyi ching 'gro tshul shes pasar dgos pa la// de'ang rgyu rkyen yul dus slong rkyen na lugs gnyen po rnams ni rtsa rgyud du mdor dril te gsungs pa gal che zhes zin tig las gsungs pa ltar/ ༈ de la 'dir rtsa ba thugs kyi brjod bya thams cad dpe don mya ngan med pa'i ljon shing gi tshul du rde'u 'grim pa la/ gnas lugs nad gzhi'i rtsa ba/ ngos 'dzin rtags kyi rtsa ba/ gso byed thabs kyi rtsa ba dang gsum las/ dang po chu dang chab rom gyi tshul du gnas pa gnas lugs nad gzh-i'i rtsa ba/ rtsa ba de las gyes pa'i sdong po gnyis yod pa ni/ rnam par ma gyur pa lus chu ltar gyur pa'i sdong po/ rnam par gyur pa lus chab rom ltar du gnas pa'i sdong po gnyis so// rnam par ma gyur pa'i sdong po de la gyes pa'i yal ga gsum yod pa ni/ nad rlung mkhris bad kan gsum gyi yal ga /lus zungs bdun gyi yal ga /dri ma gsum gyi yal ga'o// nad kyi yal ga las lo ma bco lnga yod pa ni/ rlung srog 'dzin spyi bor gnas pa'i lo ma/ gyen rgyu brang la gnas pa'i lo ma/ khyab byed snying la gnas pa'i lo ma/ me mnyam pho ba la gnas pa'i lo ma/ thur sel gzhang la gnas pa'i lo ma ste rlung lnga/

mkhris pa 'ju byed zhu dang ma zhu'i bar na gnas pa'i lo ma/ mdangs bsgyur mchin pa la gnas pa'i lo ma/ sgrub byed snying la gnas pa'i lo ma/ mthong byed mig la gnas pa'i lo ma/ mdog gsal pags pa la gnas pa'i lo ma ste mkhris pa lnga/ bad kan rten byed brang la gnas pa'i lo ma/ myag byed pho ba la gnas pa'i lo ma/ myong byed lce la gnas pa'i lo ma/ tshim byed mgo la gnas pa'i lo ma/ 'byor byed tshig mig kun la gnas pa'i lo ma bcas bad kan te khyon bco lnga'o// gnyis pa lus zungs kyi yal ga rgyas pa'i lo ma bdun yod pa ni/ kha zas bza' btung gi dwangs ma'i lo ma/ de'i dwangs ma khrag gi lo ma/ de'i dwangs ma sha yi lo ma/ de'i dwangs ma tshil gyi lo ma/ de'i dwangs ma rus pa'i lo ma/ de'i dwangs ma rkang gi lo ma/ de'i dwangs ma khu ba dkar dmar gyi lo ma bcas lus zung bdun no// gsum pa dri ma'i yal ga la lo ma gsum yod pa ni/ dri ma gshang ba'i lo ma/ dri ma gci ba'i lo ma/ dri ma rngul ba'i lo ma dang gsum mo// da ni gnyis pa chab rom ltar lus rnam par gyur pa'i sdong po la yal ga dgu yod pa ni/ nad rnams skyed par byed pa rgyu'i yal ga /de la lhan cig skyes pa rkyen gyi yal ga /rgyu rkyen ldan pa'i nad nyid 'jug pa'i sgo drug gi yal ga /zhugs nas lus kyi stod smad bar du gnas pa'i yal ga /rgyu bar byed pa lam gyi yal ga /na so yul dus kyi dbang gis nad 'phel zhing smin pa'i yal ga /'bras bu srog gcod pa nad dgu yi yal ga /bcos nyes sogs kyi rkyen las nad gzhan du log pa ldog rgyu bcu gnyis kyi yal ga /mdo don dril na tsha grang gnyis su 'du ba'i yal ga bcas khyon dgu'o// dang po rgyu'i yal ga la lo ma gsum yod pa ni/ rgyu 'dod chags kyis rlung bskyed pa'i lo ma/ zhe sdang gis mkhris pa bskyed pa'i lo ma/ gti mug gis bad kan bskyed pa'i lo ma dang gsum mo// gnyis pa lhan cig skyes pa rkyen gyi yal ga la lo ma bzhi yod pa ni/

dus dman lhag log pa'i lo ma/ gdon glo bur ba'i lo ma/ kha zas bsil drod ma snyoms pa'i lo ma/ spyod lam drag dal ma snyoms pa'i lo ma dang bzhi'o// gsum pa 'jug sgo'i yal ga la lo ma drug yod pa ni/ nad pags la gram pa'i lo ma/ sha la rgyas pa'i lo ma/ rtsa la rgyu ba'i lo ma/ rus la zhen pa'i lo ma/ don la bab pa'i lo ma/ snod la lhung ba'i lo ma bcas drug yod/ bzhi pa gnas kyi yal ga la lo ma gsum yod pa ni/ bad kan klad pa la brten stod la gnas pa'i lo ma/ mkhris pa mchin mkhris la brten bar na gnas pa'i lo ma/ rlung ni dpyi sked la brten smad na gnas pa'i lo ma bcas gsum mo// lnga pa rgyu lam gyi yal ga lo ma bco lnga yod pa ni/ rlung lus zungs rnams kyi nang nas rus pa la rgyu ba'i lo ma/ rlung dbang po rnams kyi nang nas rna ba la rgyu ba'i lo ma/ rlung snyigs ma rnams kyi nang nas reg bya'i sgo ba spu la rgyu ba'i lo ma/ rlung don rnams kyi nang nas snying dang srog rtsar rgyu ba'i lo ma/ rlung snod rnams kyi nang nas long du rgyu ba'i lo ma ste rlung gi rgyu lam lnga/ mkhris pa lus zungs rnams kyi nang nas khrag la rgyu ba'i lo ma/ mkhris pa dri ma rnams kyi nang nas rgyus pa la rgyu ba'i lo ma/ mkhris pa dbang po rnams kyi nang nas mig la rgyu ba'i lo ma/ mkhris pa don rnams kyi nang nas mchin pa la rgyu ba'i lo ma/ mkhris pa snod rnams kyi nang nas mkhris snod dang rgyu mar rgyu ba'i lo ma ste mkhris pa'i rgyu lam lnga/ bad kan lus zungs rnams kyi nang nas dwangs ma sha tshil rkang dang khu bar rgyu ba'i lo ma/ bad kan sny-igs ma rnams kyi nang nas bshang gci la rgyu ba'i lo ma/ bad kan dbang po rnams kyi nang nas sna lce la rgyu ba'i lo ma/ bad kan don rnams kyi nang nas pho mtsher mkhal mar rgyu ba'i lo ma/ bad kan snod rnams kyi nang nas pho ba dang lgang par rgyu ba'i lo ma ste bad kan gyi rgyu lam lnga dang khyon bco lnga'o// drug pa nad smin par byed pa na so yul dus kyi yal ga lo ma dgu yod pa ni/

rgas pa rlung gi mi yin pa'i lo ma/ dar ma mkhris pa'i mi yin pa'i lo ma/ byis pa bad kan gyi mi yin pa'i lo ma bcas na so'i dbye ba gsum/ ngad can grang ba rlung gi yul yin pa'i lo ma/ skam sa tsha gdung che ba mkhris pa'i yul yin pa'i lo ma/ rlan can snum bag ldan pa bad kan gyi yul yin pa'i lo ma bcas yul gyi dbye ba gsum/ rlung nad dbyar dus dang dgong dang tho rangs ldang ba'i lo ma/ mkhris pa ston gyi dus dang nyin gung mtshan gung ldang ba'i lo ma/ bad kan dpyid kyi dus dang srod dang snga dror ldang ba'i lo ma bcas dus kyi dbye ba gsum bcas khyon dgu'o// bdun pa 'bras bu srog gcod pa nad dgu'i yal ga la lo ma dgu yod pa ni/ lus zungs zad nas sman dpyad mi gtub pa'i lo ma/ 'byung po'i gdon gyis rnam par 'tshe bas tshe srog zin pa'i lo ma/ dus las 'das te rlung nad srog rten chad pa'i lo ma/ tsha ba la 'das pa'i lo ma/ grang ba gting du mkhar ba'i lo ma/ tshe dang las dang bsod nams gsum zad pa'i lo ma/ tsha grang gi 'du ba gcig 'chos na gcig skye ba lta bu 'du ba gshed du bab pa'i lo ma ste/ sman dpyad sogs log pa'i sbyor ba mtshungs pas nad kyi stobs bskyed nas srog la rgol ba'i lo ma/ nad srog gi gnad tu bab pa'i lo ma ste dgu'o// brgyad pa ldog rgyu'i yal ga la lo ma bcu gnyis yod pa ni/ rlung zhi nas mkhris par ldog pa'i lo ma/ rlung zhi nas bad kan du ldog pa'i lo ma/ mkhris pa zhi nas rlung du ldog pa'i lo ma/ mkhris pa zhi nas bad kan du ldog pa'i lo ma/ bad kan zhi nas rlung du ldog pa'i lo ma/ bad kan zhi nas mkhris par ldog pa'i lo ma/ yang rlung ma zhi nas mkhris par ldog pa'i lo ma/ rlung ma zhi nas bad kan du ldog pa'i lo ma/ mkhris pa ma zhi nas rlung du ldog pa'i lo ma/ mkhris pa ma zhi nas bad kan du ldog pa'i lo ma/ bad kan ma zhi nas rlung du ldaug pa'i lo ma/

bad kan ma zhi nas mkhris par ldog pa'i lo ma bcas bcu gnyis so// dgu pa mdo don dril ba'i yal ga la lo ma gnyis yod pa ni/ rlung dang bad kan gnyis kyi ngo bo grang ba chu yin pa'i lo ma/ khrag dang mkhris pa tsha ba me yin pa'i lo ma gnyis so// srin dang chu ser gnyis tsha grang thun mong 'gyur ba can yin pas sger thub kyi lo ma med do// ljon shing snga ma'i tshul rdzogs so/ ༈ /da ni gnyis pa me dang du ba'i tshul du gnas pa ngos 'dzin rtag gi rtsa ba sdong po gsum yod pa ni/ mig gis blta ba'i sdong po/ sor mos reg pa'i sdong po/ ngag gi dri ba'i sdong po dang gsum/ dang po blta ba'i sdong po las gyes pa'i yal ga gnyis ni/ lce la lta ba'i yal ga dang chu la lta ba'i yal ga gnyis/ lce la blta ba'i yal ga la lo ma gsum ni/ rlung gi lce ni dmar zhing skam la rtsub pa'i lo ma/ mkhris pa'i lce ni bad kan gyi dreg pa skya ser mthug pos g.yog pa'i lo ma/ bad kan gyi lce ni skya glegs mdangs med 'jam la rlon pa'i lo ma dang gsum mo// chu la blta ba'i yal ga la lo ma gsum ni/ rlung gi chu ni chu 'dra lbu ba che ba'i lo ma/ mkhris pa'i chu dmar ser rlangs che dri ma dug pa'i lo ma/ bad kan gyi chu ni dkar la dri rlangs chung ba'i lo ma bcas gsum mo// gnyis pa reg pa'i sdong po la yal ga gsum ni/ rlung gi rtsa la reg pa'i yal ga /mkhris pa'i rtsa la reg pa'i yal ga /bad kan gyi rtsa la reg pa'i yal ga dang gsum/ rlung gi rtsa la reg pa'i yal ga las gyes pa'i lo ma gcig ni/ rlung gi rtsa ni rkyal stong skabs su sdod pa'i lo ma'o// mkhris pa'i rtsa'i yal ga las gyes pa'i lo ma gcig ni/ mkhris pa'i rtsa ni mgyogs rgyas grim par 'phar ba'i lo ma'o// bad kan gyi rtsa'i yal ga las gyes pa'i lo ma gcig ni/ bad kan gyi rtsa ni bying rgud dar bar 'phar ba'i lo ma'o// gsum pa ngag gis dri ba'i sdong po la yal ga gsum yod pa ni/

rlung nad dri ba'i yal ga /mkhris nad dri ba'i yal ga /bad kan gyi nad dri ba'i yal ga dang gsum/ dang po rlung nad dri ba'i yal ga la gyes pa'i lo ma bcu gcig yod pa ni/ yang la rtsub pa'i zas spyod rnams kyi rgyus rlung slong ba'i lo ma/ rlung de'i rkyen gyis g.yal 'dar byed pa'i lo ma/ bya rmyang byed pa'i lo ma/ grang shum byed pa'i lo ma/ dpyi dang rked pa rus tshigs ma lus pa na ba'i lo ma/ gzer ba nges med du 'pho ba'i lo ma/ stong skyug byed pa'i lo ma/ dbang po lnga mi gsal ba'i lo ma/ shes pa 'tshubs pa'i lo ma/ bkres dus na ba'i lo ma/ snum bcud kyis phan par nges pa'i lo ma bcas so// mkhris nad dri ba'i yal ga lo ma bdun yod pa ni/ rgyu rno zhing tsha ba zas spyod kyis mkhris pa slong ba'i lo ma/ mkhris pa de'i rkyen gyis kha kha ba'i lo ma/ mgo na ba'i lo ma/ sha drod sngar bas tsha ba'i lo ma/ lus stod gzer ba'i lo ma/ zas skom zhu dus na ba'i lo ma/ bsil bas phan par nges pa'i lo ma bcas so// bad kan dri ba'i yal ga lo ma bcu gcig yod pa ni/ lci la snum pa'i zas dang spyod lam gyis bad kan slong ba'i lo ma/ bad kan de'i rkyen gyis dwang ga mi bde ba'i lo ma/ kha zas 'ju dka' ba'i lo ma/ yang yang skyugs shing pho bas zas mi len pa'i lo ma/ kha mngar ba'i lo ma/ pho ba 'tshings pa'i lo ma/ sgregs pa byed pa'i lo ma/ lus sems lci ba'i lo ma/ lus phyi nang gnyis ka grang ba'i lo ma/ kha zas zos rjes mi bde ba'i lo ma/ zas spyod gnyis ka dro na nges par 'phrod pa'i lo ma bcas so/ ༈ /ljon shing bar ma'i tshul rdzogs so// da ni gsum pa nyi ma dang ba mo'i tshul du gnas pa gso byed thabs kyi rtsa ba de la'ang gyes pa'i sdong po bzhi yod pa ni/ 'tsho ba zas kyi sdong po/ bya ba spyod lam gyi sdong po/ sbyor ba sman gyi sdong po/ cha byad dpyad kyi sdong po bzhi/ dang po 'tsho ba zas kyi sdong po las gyes pa'i yal ga drug yod pa ni/

rlung nad zas kyi yal ga /rlung nad skom gyi yal ga /mkhris nad zas kyi yal ga /mkhris nad skom gyi yal ga /bad kan nad zas kyi yal ga /bad kan nad skom gyi yal ga dang drug go /dang po rlung nad zas kyi yal ga las gyes pa'i lo ma bcu yod pa ni/ rta sha'i lo ma/ bong bu'i sha'i lo ma/ 'phyi sha'i lo ma/ lo sha'i lo ma/ sha chen gyi lo ma/ 'bru mar gyi lo ma/ lo mar gyi lo ma/ bur smug gi lo ma/ sgog skya'i lo ma/ btsong sgog gi lo ma bcas bcu'o// rlung nad skom gyi yal ga la lo ma bzhi yod pa ni/ bzhos thog 'o ma'i lo ma/ lca ba ra mnye'i zan chang gi lo ma/ bur chang gi lo ma/ rus chang gi lo ma bcas bzhi/ mkhris nad zas kyi yal ga la lo ma lnga yod pa ni/ ba ra'i mar gsar gyi lo ma/ ri dwags sha gsar gyi lo ma/ ra sha'i lo ma/ skom sha'i lo ma/ nas sngon chag tshe'i lo ma bcas lnga'o// mkhris nad skom gyi yal ga lo ma bdun yod pa ni/ ba ra'i zho'i lo ma/ ba ra'i dar ba'i lo ma/ rkyab tshod kyi lo ma/ khur tshod kyi lo ma/ chab tsha'i lo ma/ gangs las blangs pa'i chu bsil gyi lo ma/ chu bkol grang gi lo ma bcas bdun no// bad kan skya bo'i nad zas kyi yal ga la lo ma drug yod pa ni/ lug sha'i lo ma/ g.yag rgod kyi sha'i lo ma/ gcan gzan gyi sha'i lo ma/ nya sha'i lo ma/ sbrang rtsi'i lo ma/ skam sa'i 'bru rnying gi zan dron po'i lo ma bcas drug go /bad kan nad skom gyi yal ga la lo ma gsum yod pa ni/ 'bri'i zho dar gyi lo ma/ gar chang nar son gyi lo ma/ chu bskol gyi lo ma bcas gsum mo// gnyis pa spyod lam gyi sdong po las gyes pa'i yal ga gsum ni/ rlung gi gnas dang spyod lam gyi yal ga /mkhris pa'i gnas dang spyod lam gyi yal ga /bad kan gyi gnas dang spyod lam gyi yal ga dang gsum mo// dang po rlung gi spyod lam gyi yal ga la lo ma gnyis ni/ gnas dro sar sdod pa'i lo ma/ yid du 'ong ba'i grogs bsten pa'i lo ma'o// mkhris pa'i spyod lam gyi yal ga la lo ma gnyis ni/

gnas bsil sar 'dug pa'i lo ma/ spyod lam dal bar sdod pa'i lo ma'o// bad kan spyod lam gyi yal ga la lo ma gnyis ni/ rtsol bas bcag pa'i lo ma/ gnas dro sar bsten pa'i lo ma'o// gsum pa sbyor ba sman gyi sdong po la yal ga bco lnga yod pa ni/ spyir sman la ro dang nus pa'i dbang gis rlung sman ro'i yal ga /rlung sman nus pa'i yal ga /mkhris sman ro'i yal ga /mkhris sman nus pa'i yal ga /bad kan gyi sman ro'i yal ga /bad kan gyi sman nus pa'i yal ga /ro nus de dang sbyar thabs kyi dbang gis zhi sbyang gnyis su dbye ba las/ rlung zhi byed khu ba'i yal ga /rlung zhi byed sman mar gyi yal ga /mkhris pa zhi byed thang gi yal ga /mkhris pa zhi byed cur nis kyi yal ga /bad kan zhi byed ril bu'i yal ga /bad kan zhi byed tres sam gyi yal ga /rlung sbyong byed 'jam rtsi'i yal ga /mkhris pa sbyong byed bshal gyi yal ga /bad kan sbyong byed skyugs kyi yal ga dang bco lnga'o// rlung sman ro'i yal ga la lo ma gsum yod pa ni/ ro mngar ba'i lo ma/ ro skyur ba'i lo ma/ ro lan tshwa ba'i lo ma dang gsum mo// rlung sman nus pa'i yal ga la lo ma gsum yod pa ni/ nus pa snum pa'i lo ma/ nus pa lci ba'i lo ma/ nus pa 'jam pa'i lo ma dang gsum mo// mkhris sman ro'i yal ga la lo ma gsum yod pa ni/ ro mngar ba'i lo ma/ ro kha ba'i lo ma/ ro bska ba'i lo ma dang gsum mo// mkhris sman nus pa'i yal ga la lo ma gsum yod pa ni/ nus pa bsil ba'i lo ma/ yon tan nam nus pa sla ba'i lo ma/ nus pa brtul ba'i lo ma dang gsum mo// bad kan sman ro'i yal ga la lo ma gsum yod pa ni/ ro tsha ba'i lo ma/ ro skyur ba'i lo ma/ ro bska ba'i lo ma dang gsum mo// bad kan sman gyi nus pa'i yal ga la lo ma gsum yod pa ni/ nus pa rno ba'i lo ma/ nus pa rtsub pa'i lo ma/ nus pa yang ba'i lo ma dang gsum mo// rlung zhi byed khu ba'i yal ga la lo ma gsum yod pa ni/

sre long sogs rus khu'i lo ma/ bcud bzhi'i khu ba'i lo ma/ lug mgo rnying ba'i mgo khrol gyi lo ma dang gsum mo// rlung zhi byed sman mar gyi yal ga la lo ma lnga ni/ dzā ta'i gtsor byas sman mar gyi lo ma/ sgog skya gtsor byas sman mar gyi lo ma/ 'bras gsum gtsor byas sman mar gyi lo ma/ rtsa ba lnga yi gtsor byas sman mar gyi lo ma/ sman chen gtsor byas sman mar gyi lo ma dang lnga'o// mkhris pa zhi byed thang gi yal ga la lo ma bzhi ni/ ma nu'i gtsor byas thang gi lo ma/ sle tres gtsor byas thang gi lo ma/ tig ta gtsor byas thang gi lo ma/ 'bras gsum gtsor byas thang gi lo ma dang bzhi'o// mkhris pa zhi byed cur nis sam phye ma'i yal ga la lo ma bzhi ni/ ga pur gtsor byas phye ma'i lo ma/ tsandan gtsor byas phye ma'i lo ma/ gur gum gtsor byas phye ma'i lo ma/ cu gang gtsor byas phye ma'i lo ma dang bzhi'o// bad kan zhi byed ril bu'i yal ga la lo ma gnyis ni/ btsan dug gtsor byas ril bu'i lo ma/ tshwa sna rnams kyi ril bu'i lo ma dang gnyis so// bad kan zhi byed phye ma'am tres sam gyi yal ga la lo ma lnga ni/ se 'bru gtsor byas tres sam gyi lo ma/ da li gtsor byas tres sam gyi lo ma/ rgod ma kha'i tres sam gyi lo ma/ tshwa bsreg sbyor ba'i tres sam gyi lo ma/ cong zhi bsreg thal byas pa'i tres sam gyi lo ma bcas lnga'o// rlung sbyong byed 'jam rtsi'i yal ga la lo ma gsum ni/ sle 'jam gyi lo ma/ bkru 'jam gyi lo ma/ bkru ma slen gyi lo ma dang gsum mo// mkhris pa sbyong byed bshal gyi yal ga la lo ma bzhi ni/ spyi bshal gyi lo ma/ sgos bshal gyi lo ma/ drag bshal gyi lo ma/ 'jam bshal gyi lo ma dang bzhi'o// bad kan sbyong byed skyugs kyi yal ga la lo ma gnyis ni/ drag skyugs kyi lo ma/ 'jam skyugs kyi lo ma gnyis so// bzhi pa cha byad dpyad kyi sdong po las gyes pa'i yal ga gsum ni/

rlung dpyad kyi yal ga /mkhris dpyad kyi yal ga /bad kan dpyad kyi yal ga gsum/ rlung dpyad kyi yal ga'i lo ma gnyis ni/ sku mnye bya ba'i lo ma/ hor gyi me btsa'i lo ma'o// mkhris pa dpyad kyi yal ga la lo ma gsum ni/ rngul dbyung bya ba'i lo ma/ gtar kha bya ba'i lo ma/ bsil chu'i 'khrul 'khor bskor ba'i lo ma dang gsum mo// bad kan dpyad kyi yal ga la lo ma gnyis yod pa ni/ drod dug bya ba'i lo ma/ me btsa' bya ba'i lo ma bcas so// de dag gis ljon shing phyi ma'i tshul rdzogs so// da ni rdel grangs de dag lhag chad med par gtan la 'beb cing zhar byung dgos pa dang nying dgos me 'bras kyi dpe bstan skabs 'di'i mjug bsdus te/ dum bu phyi ma gsum la rim bzhin 'jug par gdams pa dang bcas rtsis kyi le'u'o// don ni/ gnad lugs nad gzhi ngos 'dzin rtags/ gso byed thabs ste rtsa ba gsum/ rtsa ba snga ma la rnam par gyur ma gyur gnyis/ bar ma la blta reg dri ba gsum/ phyi ma la zas spyod/ sman dpyad bzhi ste sdong po dgu ru don dril ba'o// sdong po dang po la nad zungs dri ma'i yal ga gsum/ rnam par gyur pa'i sdong po la rgyu rkyen 'jug sgo gnas pa rgyu lam ldang dus 'bras bu ldog rgyu mdo dril te dgu/ blta sdong lce chu gnyis/ reg pa rtsa la mi 'dra ba gsum/ dri sdong la nyes gsum so sor slong rkyen na lugs goms pa'i dri ba gsum/ zas sdong la nyes gsum/ so sor zas skom gyi yal ga gnyis gnyis te drug /spyod sdong la nyes gsum dbye ba gsum/ sman sdong la nyes gsum so so'i ro nus dbye ba drug /de steng sbyar thabs la zhi byed gnyis re sbyar bas drug /sbyong gsum dpyad sdong la nyes gsum so sor dpyad gsum bya ste thams cad bsdoms pas yal ga bzhi bcu rtsa bdun no// yal ga de rnams las gyes pa'i lo 'dab ni/ sdong po dang po la nad la bco lnga/

zungs bdun dri ma gsum ste lus kyi yan lag nyi shu rtsa lnga'i grangs kyi lo ma dang*/ rnam par gyur pa nad sdong la nad kyi zin tig /de gnad 'dus pa'i lo ma drug cu re gsum yod pa ni ljon shing snga ma la'o// blta sdong la drug /reg sdong la gsum/ dri ba la nyer dgu yod pa ni ljon shing bar ma la'o// rlung zas bcu bzhi/ mkhris zas bcu gnyis/ bad kan zas skom dgu bcas zas sdong lo ma la so lnga/ spyod sdong la lo ma drug /sman sdong la ro nus kyi lo ma dgu dgu ste lo ma bco brgyad sbyar thabs khu bar gsum/ sman mar lnga thang dang phye ma la bzhi re bzhi re ste brgyad/ ril bu la gnyis/ tres sam lnga/ rlung 'jam rtsi mkhris pa bshal/ bad kan skyugs pas mi 'da' ba'i bcos thabs lo ma dgu ste/ khyon sman sdong la lo ma lnga bcu tham pa/ dpyad sdong la bdun te de dag ni ljon shing phyi ma la'o// de ltar nad gzhi la lo 'dab gya brgyad/ ngos 'dzin pas so brgyad/ gso thabs la go brgyad de khyon bsdom pas nyis brgya dang nyer bzhi yod pa yin no// de ltar gso rig nyams su blangs pa las lus mi na bar gnas pa dang*/ na ba gso ba'i tshul la mkhas par gyur nas rang gzhan gyi don la 'bad pa'i rgyus gnas skabs su thun mong gi bde ba dang*/ mthar thug gi thun min gyi bde ba 'grub pa ste/ mtshon byed rnam par ma gyur pa'i sdong po'i zungs bdun gyi lo 'dab kyi rtser me tog shin tu mdzes pa gsar pa kha bye ma thag pa gnyis dang*/ ro bcud phun sum tshogs pa'i 'bras bu gsum gyis mdzes par byas pa las/ dang po nad med bde bar gnas pa'i me tog /tshe ring por 'tsho ba'i me tog gnyis so// gnyis pa 'bras bu ni/ lha dang mi'i chos lugs kyi che ba thob pa'i 'bras bu/ zang zing dang 'phags nor gyis 'byor ba'i 'bras bu/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug rnam grol gyi bde ba 'grub pa'i 'bras bu dang gsum ste/

de ltar me 'bras lngas mtshon pa'i dgos pa ni gso rigs la yod pa de 'dzin pa'i 'tsho byed pa rnams la yon tan gyi khyad par 'di lta bu grub pa nyid do/ ༈ /rtsa dpyad mdor bsdus cung zad 'bri/ rtsa blta ba'i man ngag nyams kyi yig chung ni/ nad pa zas spyod ma 'khrugs pa'i ngal gsos pa la de dang mtshungs par sman pas ri rtse nyi shar gyi dus su'am glo bur du yang rung ste/ skyes pa'i lag pa g.yon/ bud med kyi g.yas par thog mar blta'o// de yang nad pa'i mkhrig gnyer nas de nyid kyi tshon gang thur du mjal ba'i sar/ sman pa'i sor mo gsum gyis rtsa'i reg bya tshor bar rim gyis mnan la blta/ skyes pa la sman pa'i lag g.yas pa'i mdzub mos yar zur gyi mgo ru snying*/ mar zur du rgyu ma/ gung mo'i yar zur du mtsher pa/ mar zur la pho ba/ srin lag gi yar zur la mkhal ma g.yon/ mar zur la snod bsam se'u/ sman pa'i lag g.yon mdzub mo'i yar zur la glo ba/ mar zur du long kha/ gung mo'i yar zur mchin pa/ mar zur mkhris pa/ srin lag gi yar zur mkhal ma g.yas/ mar zur la lgang pa'i rtsa rgyu'o// de nyid ji ltar rgyu na tshong 'dus rgya srang 'dra ba'i rtsa sogs lbub lta bu'i nang du/ tshong dpon dang 'dra ba'i snod kyi rlung khrag de rlung khyab byed kyis bskyod nas/ lag mgo dang don snod kyi bar bying du rgyu bar byed la/ de'ang phyir rgyu ba na don rnam pa lnga'i rlung khrag rgyu/ sor mo gsum gyi yar zur la mngon/ nang du 'jug pa na/ snod drug gi rlung khrag rgyu/ sor mo gsum gyi mar zur du mngon/ de ltar sor mo gsum gsum drug po'i 'og tu don snod bcu gnyis kyi rtsa rgyu ste/ de skad du/ yar zur don lnga phyir rgyu gdags kyi rtsa/ mar zur snod drug nad rgyu srib kyi rtsa/ zhes dang don snod der mi rgyu bas 'gal zhe na/ rlung khrag kun tu rgyu bas tshong dpon bzhin// bcu gnyis 'dres pa pha tse'i re so 'dra// zhes so// de nas nad ngos bzung ba ni/

sman pa'i dbugs 'byin 'jug gnas gsum tha mal du gnas pa'i phyir rgyu ba la gnyis/ nang du 'jug pa la gnyis/ bar du gcig ste lnga 'phar na nad med pa'i rtsa yin/ de las mang ba drug dang bdun brgyad dang dgu tsam du 'phar na/ tsha ba dang*/ rab tu tsha ba dang*/ tsha ba la 'das pa gsum gyi rtsa'o// de las nyung ba ni/ bzhi dang gsum/ gnyis tsam du 'phar na grang ba dang*/ rab tu grang ba dang*/ grang ba gting 'khar ba gsum gyi rtsa'o// man ngag tu mgyogs bul ji ltar 'dug kyang rung*/ rim gyis shed je cher mnan pas mkhrang ba dang grim pa'i cha 'dug na tsha ba'i nad/ stong pa dang lhod pa'i cha 'dug na grang ba'o// de la grang mang myur du 'phar yang rtsa sbubs stong na rtags tsha la ngo bo grang ba/ grang nyung du 'phar yang gting mkhrang na rtags grang yang ngo bo tsha ba'o// de yang rkyal stong skabs su sdod na rlung*/ mgyogs rgyas grim par 'phar na khrag mkhris/ bying gud dal ba bad kan/ 'dres na ldan 'dus/ 'dar zhing rgyu dka' na chu ser/ 'khyig cing leb mor 'phar na srin/ rtsub la thung ba gag lhog /gung mo'i 'og gi rtsa g.yas g.yon du mi gsal na bad smug /phra bying gting na dam na dmu 'or/ rus pa la thug par mngon pa skran/ reg bya tsha zhing 'dar spun rnag /brtag dka' sna tshogs ston pa 'gyur ldog mang ba gdon yin no// de rnams don snod gang la bab pa ni/ mdzub mo gnyis kyis glo snying stod kyi nad/ gung mo gnyis kyis pho mchin bar gyi nad/ srin mdzub gnyis kyis mkhal rked smad kyi nad du brtag par bya'o// bcos skyed byung ma byung brtag pa ni/ rtsa phra ba sbom du song*/ thung ba ring du song*/ bying ba steng du thon/ grim pa lhod du song ba sogs bcos skyed byung ba'i rtsa yin la/ min na de las ldog pa'o// bla rtsa ni/ lag pa'i mkhrig ma'i mar zur gyi chu rgyus gseb tu blta ste/ de yang lan grangs brgya'i bar du che chung stod smad/

drag dal bying rgyas/ sdod 'then thang lhod med par 'phar na lo brgya 'tsho la/ gong gi skyon de rnams grangs gang gi bar du byung ba'i lo dus mi dge'o// mi 'tsho ba'i rtsa ni/ dar lce rlung gis bskyod pa ltar drag dal nges med du 'phar ba dang*/ khra'i mjug rtse 'dra ba dang*/ thig zag gi chu zhugs 'dra ba dang*/ nad glo bur stobs che ba la rtsa ldog pa'am/ rtsa rgyud phra ba/ zung zad rtsa rgyas shing 'brub pa phal cher 'chi/ glo ba'i rtsa tshad 'khrugs/ sha dug /bad mkhris pho bar 'dril ba dang bzhi la/ nad med pa'i rtsa byung na mi 'tsho/ yang na rtsa rgyud grangs nges pa can du sdod pa'am/ mkhal rtsa glo bur du sdod na mi 'tsho/ nges pa can gyi rtags ni/ snying gi rtsa ma tshang zhing lce gzhung nag mig 'bur tshugs su blta ba zhag gcig nas 'chi/ glo rtsa ma tshang zhing sna rdog zhom/ sna'i nang gi spu gra gyen du log na zhag gsum nas 'chi/ mchin rtsa ma tshang zhing mig 'bras gyen du log /smin ma 'khyil na zhag gnyis nas 'chi/ mtsher rtsa ma tshang zhing*/ ma mchu thur du 'phyang*/ lhan sna nang du rdeb na zhag lnga nas 'chi/ mkhal rtsa ma tshang zhing rna ba'i urta chad na zhag brgyad nas gshin rjes 'khrid/ 'di dag thams cad gzhi rtsa ji ltar yod gong du rtsad bcad nas kha dmar gdag par bya'o// nad med rtsa bzhi bzhi la/ pho mo byang chub sems kyi rtsa/ tsha grang gi rtsar 'khrul pa dang*/ sbrum ma'i rtsa'ang tsha bar 'khrul pa yod cing*/ gong brgal dang sdod 'then la sogs pa yod pa de dag 'chi rtsar 'khrul nyen yod pa'i phyir ro/ ༈ /chu dpyad kyi lag len ni/ nad pas ha cang tshad las 'das pa'i bsil drod kyi zas skom dang*/ nad gzhi 'khrugs pa'i spyaud lam spangs/ srod dus kyi zas chu dor/ nam smad kyi nad chu de nyid/ 'khar gzhong lcags dkar dkar yol la sogs pa chu mdog mi 'gyur pa'i snod kyi nang du blta ste/ bungs/ lbu ba/ rlangs pa/ kha dog /dri ro/

ldog lugs/ gar sla/ ku ya/ spris ma rnams las shes par bya'o// de'ang bungs chung ba tsha ba/ che ba grang ba/ lbu ba sngo la che ba rlung*/ phra ser sang rkyen pa mkhris pa/ mchil ma 'dra ba bad kan/ dbus nas 'thor zhing mthar byer ba'i nad/ 'dres na ldan 'dus so// rlangs pa che na tsha ba chung na grang ba/ res 'jog 'thab pa'o// kha dog sngo ba rlung*/ ser ba mkhris pa/ dkar ba bad kan/ dmar ba khrag /rgya bshal chu ser/ nag gam 'ja' tshon 'dra na dug /'dres pa ldan 'dus/ smug dug /bad kan smug po/ dri ma che na tsha ba/ chung ngam med na grang ba/ zas gang mnam de nyid ma zhu ba/ ro skyur ba kha bska tsha ba/ ro med dam mngar ba grang ba/ gar ba tsha chu/ sla ba grang ba/ tsha log byed pa tsha ba/ grang nas log pa grang ba/ thog mar ku ya ldog pa tsha grang 'thab pa/ tsha chu yin pa la ldog bul ba/ grang chu yin pa la ldog rkyen na gab tshad yin/ tsha ba byer ba/ grang ba 'byams pa/ gdon shas che ba gsum mi ldog go /ku ya mthug na tsha ba/ srab na grang ba/ de yang kha dog chu mdog tu bshad pa ltar la/ spu rtse gtub 'dra rlung*/ bal 'dab 'dra ba khrag mkhris/ sprin 'dra glo nad/ rnag 'dra de nyid/ bye ma 'dra na mkhal nad/ chu'i steng 'og bar gsum gang du 'dug pa'i dbang gis stod smad bar gyi nad shes par bya'o// spris ma mthug na tsha ba/ srab na grang ba/ dum bur chad pa skran/ gzugs gang shar de'i rigs kyi gdon tsha chu ha cang spris ma mthug na lus zung zhu/ grang chu spris ma mthug na mar tshil ma zhu/ kha zhag mthug po shing bus blangs nas mar bsregs pas bsur dri mnam na zhag rgod ces bya ste/ skyon med do// de rnams man ngag tu ni/ chu mdog dmar ser 'dug kyang ku ya med cing dri dang ro chung ba'am/ med la lbu ba che ba dang*/ sen mo snum med kyi steng du thigs pa gcig blug pas chil gyis 'gro na phyi rtags tsha la ngo bo grang ba'o// yang kha dog dkar ram sngo yang ku ya mthug cing*/

dri dang ro bzang*/ lbu ba sangs sla sen mo'i steng du sran ma ltar 'dril na/ rtags grang ngo bo tsha ba'o// kha dog ji ltar 'dug kyang ro tsha skyur/ tsha bska gang 'dug tsha chu/ kha dog ji ltar 'dug kyang ro mngar ba'am med na grang chu/ dkrug pa lbu ba che zhing tshegs sgra dang bcas na tsha chu/ tshegs sgra med dam chung na grang chu yin/ gsang ba'i rtags bslu ba med pa'o// mi 'tsho ba'i chu ni/ spyir tsha grang gi chu gang yang bcos pas mi 'gyur ba phal cher 'chi'o// khyad par sha tshogs chad 'dra chu rtsa chad 'dra/ 'o ma shi 'dra/ snag tsha chad 'dra/ mtshal chad 'dra ba rnams rlung mkhris bad kan dug dang khrag gi nad kyis 'chi/ mkhal ma'i nad med par chu khong nas ldog byung na yang mi 'tsho bas spang blang gi kha dmar gdags par bya zhing*/ dang po'i chu mdog las bcos pa'i mthun phyogs su gyur pa ni 'tsho'o/ ༈ /de yang blta reg dri ba gsum la don bcu gnyis re ston te/ blta ba lce chu mig dang khrag /kha dog lud pa 'khru dang skyug /ba spu skrang ba rnag dang ni/ so sen mdog dang bcu gnyis so// lce dmar la skam pa rlung*/ ser la g.yog mthug pa mkhris pa/ skya glegs 'jam la rlon pa bad kad no// chu sngo la lbu ba che ba rlung*/ dmar ser ku ya mthug pa mkhris tshad/ dkar la dri rlang chung ba bad kan/ mig har ba rlung*/ dmar ser khrag mkhris/ dkar ba bad kan/ gyen log 'chi ltas so// khrag dmar nag lbu ba che ba rlung*/ ser po chu ser 'dra ba mkhris pa/ skya bo tshi che ba bad kan no// kha dog sngo skya rlung*/ dmar ser snum pa khrag mkhris/ skya sob bad kan no// lud pa skya bo rlung*/ dmar ser dud khu khrag mkhris/ 'byar bag bad kan no// 'khru ba 'ur 'khrog rlung*/ dmar po dri nga ba khrag mkhris/ lbu ba bad snab tsam pa bad kan no// skyugs pa stong skyugs rlung*/ dmar ser khrag mkhris/ skya sob bad kan no// rnag sla zhing dri chung sngo ba rlung*/

dmar ser dri che ba mkhris pa/ dkar po dri chung ba bad kan no// so sen skya ba rlung*/ ser ba mkhris pa/ smug pa bad kan no/ rus pa chag pa grum pa sogs kyi mdog la dmar smug dkar dwangs skyon med/ skya ser sngo nag g.ya' chags pa/ snum zhag med pa rnams skyon can no// dreg pa la/ rtsa drod/ gsang sgo/ skran rde'u/ dmu chu/ skrangs pa/ rnag /zug rngu/ chag pa/ thon pa'i bud pa/ gsang dang bcu gnyis pa'o// rtsa rkyal stong rlung*/ grim mgyogs tsha ba/ bying gud/ bad kan no// dri che ba khrag mkhris/ chung ba bad kan/ mi snyoms pa rlung*/ gsang sgo tshigs pa dang po sogs/ rlung mkhris bad kan gyi gsang*/ mnan mi bzod pa shes so// skran ni/ phyi skran mig gis mthong*/ bar skran lag pas zin/ nang skran zas la 'khren no// rde'u ni/ lgang pa'i nang du spu la sogs pa 'dril zhing chu lam rtsa sgo 'gags pa'o// dmu chu phyi chu skrangs che/ bar chu skrangs chung*/ nang chu skrangs med par gsungs kyang dpyad do// skrangs pa skye 'bri che zhing rnag mi khug pa rlung*/ dmar zhing zug che rnag khug sla ba mkhris pa/ dkar po dri chung rnag khug dka' ba bad kan no// rnag ma smin pa'i skrang po sra zhing mkhrig /smin pa mer mer byed cing stong lhod pags pa la shu ba la sogs 'byung ngo*// mda' mde'u zug rngu gang du yod pa mthe mos mnan pas mi bzod pa'o// rus pa la chag lugs la smyug kha dang 'dum chags sogs so// thon pa tshig yin na gang 'bur ba nas mnan/ chag na rus pa rang 'grigs su btang la chings su bcing ngo*// gsang la rang gsang*/ mda' gsang rnag gsang sogs byang khog yul thig dang bstun cing*/ lag pas reg ste brtag par bya'o// de bzhin dri ba la/ rgyu1 yang*/ rtsub/ tsha/ rno/ snum pa/ lci snum bsil/ rkyen2 sems las drag shul/ yun 3 ji tsam lon pa/ yul4 ngad can grang ba sogs/ ldang dus 5 dgong dang tho rengs sogs/

6goms pa snum bcud dro ba sogs/ lus7 stobs che ba gso sla ba sogs/ me drod mi snyom pa rlung*/ che ba mkhris pa chung ba bad kan no// skom9 dad che ba tsha ba/ mi snyoms pa rlung*/ chung ba bad kan no// gnyid10 chung ba rlung*/ za zi mkhris pa/ che ba bad kan can/ gzer11 ldang dus bad kan 'pho ba rlung*/ mi 'pho ba mkhris pa/ dran pa mi gsal ba rlung*/ za zi mkhris pa/ mi gsal ba bad kan te bcu gnyis sgo nas shes par bya'o// dpe rtsa ba'i dgongs don dang blta reg dri ba'i don cung zad bstan zin nas/ ༈ nad sman sprod pa'i nyams yig cung zad bri ba la/ ༈ thog mar nad thams cad kyi sngon 'gro mjug sdud byed pa rlung yin phyir sngon du bri ba la/ nad rtags ni rtsa stong zhing chu sngo la lbu ba che/ gnyid mi 'ong*/ mgo yu 'khor/ snying dang ro stod dpyi rked na/ gzer 'pho len byed/ lbu sob lu/ 'dar g.yeng byed pa rlung yin pas/ de la sman shing kun nyer lnga/ dzā ti bcu bzhi/ a gar so lnga sogs a gar rigs 'phrod/ rlung gsang mgo dkyil/ brang gzhung*/ gnya' ltag /rkang lag dkyil bzhi sogs la phye 'phur byug /go snyod 'phur dang*/ dzā ti mar sbyar byug /sha gsar chang bzang sogs btang*/ ༈ de yang khrag dang bsdong na khrag rlung yin pas dbug 'tshang*/ ro stod gzer shin tu che/ skabs re bde la skabs rer thu ba res mos byed/ 'di la gong gsal rlung gi sman 'di rnams mi 'phrod pas 'tshang che ba dang gzer che na/ ko byi bdun pa/ rdo rje rab 'joms/ khrag rlung smad dud 'then/ lus byings gzer mig nges med la/ a gar so lnga dang bco lnga/ ko byi bcu gsum/ ko byi lnga thang*/ gser thang bco brgyad/ ge sar bco brgyad/ cham pa dang bsdong na ko byi lnga thang zab/ sprin bral zla zer khrag rlung gis mgo gzer na gong gi sman rnams thod rus bcu pa'i thang gis phul/ gdon grib dang bsdongs na/ 'brong rtse ar brgyad/

a gar so lnga gnyis zab/ rdo rje rab 'joms kyang zab/ ko byi bco lnga dang a gar nyi shu gdon grib shin tu che ba la zab/ brla rkang dpyi sked na srol yod pas a gar bco lnga cung tsam btang na stod smad spyi sman yin pas phan pa las skyon med/ phye 'phur byug na phan/ de min rkang nad kyi sman dang byug pa'i skor gtan nas mi rung*/ khrag rlung smad du bab tshe 'bam la 'gyur ba'ang srid/ 'bam yin pa'i rtags ni/ nad stod nas rim bzhin smad du bab pa'am/ stod smad res mos byas nas na/ khrag rlung bcos byas pas 'bam du 'gyur ba yin/ dang po'i dus sman bzi yod mi gtong ba gnad yin/ 'bam nad 'byung ba'i rgyu rkyen ni/ 'gro sdod che ba dang*/ chang rag ja khreb sogs 'thung che bas thog mar stod nas smad la bab pa yin/ 'bam rtags ni so rkan rgyas mig dmar/ mchu sngo nag tu skrangs/ so dang mur 'gram/ brang dang ro stod na ba 'di rnams smad du bab dus/ de la sman bzi can mi gtong ba gdams ngag yin/ bab sman ni/ gong gi khrag rlung gi sman rnams dang*/ la phyi'i 'bam thang*/ lu ba mang zhing ro stod gzer na// tsandan bco brgyad/ smug po che na/ glang chen bco brgyad/ thang chen nyer lnga/ pho mchin ma bde na/ man bsil dang*/ skyu ru nyer lnga/ mkhal sked ma bde na/ go yu dgu sbyor/ a ru nyer lnga pa dang*/ bcu pa/ bco brgyad gzi med bcas btang*/ spyi la yungs dkar nyer lnga zab/ cham pas 'bam dkrugs na/ a gar bco lnga/ bsil bcud bco lnga/ bco brgyad/ ko byi lnga thang sogs btang*/ cham pas srin dkrugs na gur gum bcu gsum/ tshangs pa dbugs sel 'then byed 'di rnams kyis 'bam gzhi la mi gnod/ 'bam gyi dngos gzhi ni/ rtsa dang chu rgyus la gzer shin tu che/ rkang pa g.yas g.yon gang red sa la btsugs mi phod pa 'ong ba'i dus su khong sman ni sngon gyi so lnga/ glang chen bco brgyad gnyis snga dro dang nyin gung*/

nub mo bong khrag nyer lnga/ zug gzer shin tu che na spos khyung bzi chung can btang bas gzer chen de chags/ skrangs pa/ glog skyi gog /zha lugs la 'phar ldang med pa'i dus su/ la phug gtong ran rtags yin kyang 'd-i'i dus gnad 'gags shin tu che/ gzi sman btang bas chu rtags lbu ba g.yung na chu rtags nang la phug gri gzhog gcig gnyis 'phen/ des chu dwangs zhad dang lbu ba che na btang ran pa yin pas/ sha gsar spar mo do'i nang du/ la phug dkar hrug spar mo gang btab pa'i skyo thang spyi rgyug ltar byas nas phor chung do 'thung*/ yang de'i phyir nang thu zhad med na sha spar mo do'i nang thug pa sngon ltar byed nas phor chung do 'thung*/ yang de'i phyir nang thu med na la phug 'phrod rtags yin pas de mus zhag gnyis gsum du 'thung*/ de mtshams ma skyon na la phug shun pa bshus nas la brdar byas pa ras dkar nang nas khu ba phor gang tsam btsir/ de dkrugs nas lbu ba lan nyi shu tsam phar bcad/ lbu ba bcad tshar ba'i la khu mang nyung khyim bya'i sgong shun do tsam dkar yol du blugs/ snod gang byung zhig gi nang du/ dbyar yin na bye ma/ dgun yin na nas sogs kyi nang du bzhag /de ni khengs rul mi 'gro ba'i gnad yin/ kha bkab nas zhag gcig bzhag /phyir nang nyi dros dkar yol chu tshan du bsros te drod 'thung bde dus gtong*/ snga dro'i skor la kha zas 'dzem/ de'i phyir nang la phug btsag snyigs de'i nang du dmar po lnga'i 'byar gyi phye ma btab/ chu cung zad blug /chu ma dgos na bzang*/ gar sla zho tsam byas nas me'i thog tu drod brgyab nas rkang pa'i skrangs dang*/ gzer gang yod khyab par byugs/ de steng ras kyis dkris nas de nub bzhag /la phug khu ba 'thung lugs dang*/ 'byar sogs 'di ltar zhag bdun tsam bya/ skrangs zhi dka' ba dang gzer ma chags na/ rdo 'byar tshan mo byug pa reg pa bde skyed/ bya khyung dmar po dang sngon po/

la phug khu bar btab nas byugs/ de rnams kyis skrangs gzer gtan med du song dus/ phyir mi ldog pa'i byugs pa snum nag gam mar rnying gang rung bsres nas yun ring byug dgos pas mtha' la gnad che/ 'di rnams kyi tshe spos khyung dang seng ldeng nyer lnga 'thung*/ shin tu bde nas nad lhag med byung tshe ngar gdong la bab na chu ser gdong rtsa/ sgyi khug la bab na byin gzhug long rtsa gang red gtar dgos kyang gtar dgos min lha rje nyams can zhig la 'dri rtog nan tan byas shing cis kyang gtar rgyu byas na dkar yol phor pa 'bring tshad kyi phyed tsam las gtar mi nyan/ khrag mang song na/ skrangs pa chu sogs dang*/ rlung gis zin/ lus stobs zhan/ rgas mgyogs lhags pa mi thub/ zas mi 'ju ba sogs kyi nyes pa bskyed pas nan tan gal che/ khrag gtar mi gtar gang la'ang*/ lum dang chu tshan bsten pas phan che/ chu gzhi yod na lum mi 'phrod pas chu tshan bsten dgos/ 'bam 'di mgo snga ma'i gzhug la nad lhag byung na/ mkhris shas che bar tig brgyad/ 'bring na gser mdog lnga pa/ chung na ril dkar pad sdong*/ bad kan shas che na smug po g.yul rgyal/ bde byed/ kun phan gnyis res mos bab bstun dgos/ bdud rtsi sum sbyor yang 'phrod/ grang khams dkrug na/ a ru nyer lnga/ bsam 'phel nor sbyor/ a ru bcu pa/ go yu dgu sbyor 'di rnams kyis phan/ nad gzhi la mi gnod/ zas ma zhu ba dang skran dug ltar na/ bde byed kun phan/ zhi byed drug pa/ gser mdog lnga pa/ gser zhi kha sprod/ ru rta drug pa shin tu zab/ 'di rnams kyis 'bam gzhi la mi gnod/ grum bu'i nad rtags ni lag pa/ gnya' ltag /sgal tshigs rnams gzer na/ de 'bam du bsgyur dgos pas/ bab sman steng du bong khrag nyer lnga btang na de 'bam du 'gyur 'gro bas bcos bde/ de las grum bu'i sman gzhan rnams mi btang*/ rtsa dkar dang bsdong na/ lag pa dang rkang pa rnams sbrid cing na ba de la rtsa dkar gyi bcos gzhan mi byed par/

a gar nyi shu dang*/ bsam 'phel nor sbyor gnyis btang bas 'bam du 'gyur 'gro bas bcos bde/ dreg dang bsdongs na/ rkang pa'i mthe bong skrang gzer shin tu che/ de la spos khyung*/ dngul chu bco brgyad bzi can btang*/ de gzer chag nas la bcos byas pas 'thus/ 'bam 'di skrangs gzhi la 'gyur 'gro ba mang bas/ de dus chu 'bam la sgyur ci thub byed dgos// chu gsog la 'gyur ba'i rtags ni/ chu lbu ba sob/ rtsa dal zhing phra/ dbugs kha rgod/ thod pa sna gshongs brang tshang ra'i mdo rkang ldeb bcas skrang 'ong na/ skrangs pa chu gsog dang po'i rtags yin pas/ chu gsog 'bam du bsgyur ba'i sman ni chu rtags ser na/ glang chen chu bsgyur/ gur gum chu bsgyur gtong*/ chu mdog ltar byung tshe/ glang chen chu bsgyur/ da li bcu drug rnams btang na/ chu gzhi 'bam du 'gyur 'gro bas gzab/ 'bam gyis rkang zug che byung na btang snyoms su gtong shes dgos/ chu gsog 'bam du 'gyur rtags ni/ chu gsang gi skrangs pa rnams zhi dbugs lhod/ rkang pa kho nar skrangs shing zug gzer shin tu che/ 'bam 'ga' re sngo khra dang*/ dmar thig sogs 'ong*/ mdog mi 'gyur ba'ang yod/ de dus la phug cung zad btang snga na legs/ ༈ snying srog la rlung zhugs pa'i rtags ni/ tshig pa za/ gnyid mi 'ong*/ don med par sems sdug /de la gdon can dang gdon med gnyis yod/ gdon can rigs la rim gro bya/ sman ni rdo rje rab 'joms/ srog rlung 'joms rdor/ rgod po gzer 'joms/ sems kyi bde skyid sogs dang*/ skabs re rga lo yang btang bas phan pa bcas rlung gi bcos yin/ ༈ mkhris pa'i bcos tshul la/ nad rtags ni chu mdog ser/ rtsa grims/ kha kha/ mgo na/ lus byings zhing nyob/ zhen pa log /de la thang chen nyer lnga/ tig brgyad/ g.ya' kyi nyer lnga sogs gtong*/ pho bar bab na mkhris khu skyugs/ pho ba gzer/ de la brag zhun dgu pa/ bdud rtsi sleb chog dang brag khyung gnyis bzi chung can zab che/

rgyu mar bab nas ser po sbyong ba la/ mkhris phye bdun pa/ brag zhun dgu pa zab/ grang mkhris kyi zhe log /zas mi zhu ba la gser mdog lnga pa g.ya' kyi bdun pa/ se 'bru padma 'dab brgyad/ gser zhi sogs gtong*/ mkhris srin gyis srin tshang gzer ba la sogs la/ gar nag bco lnga/ thengs chog yin/ gur khyung*/ gser mdog bco lnga bzi bcas zab/ ༈ bad kan skya bo la/ bde snyoms/ phag gru/ se 'bru'i rigs zab/ bad kan smug pos brang tsha/ chu skyur skyugs/ pho mchin ro brgyab na/ dang po drod can gtong mi nyan/ thang chen nyer lnga sdud thang nyer lnga/ smug po g.yu rgyal/ khrag stobs che na/ skyu ru nyer lnga/ khrag nad kun sel/ ghi dgu/ glang chen bco brgyad bdud rtsi sum sbyor/ man bsil bcas gtong*/ des chu dmar smug de dwangs/ zas mi 'ju skran dug ltar byung na/ smug po 'thab pa'i skabs yin pas/ g.yu dril/ ru rta drug pa/ zla shel sogs sman drod snyoms pa gtong*/ ༈ mkhris pa pho khar 'dril nas pho thog rang yang min yang dang ga mi bde/ zas skom mi len bad rtags kyang yod pa de bad kan ser po yin pas se 'bru padma 'dab brgyad/ bdud tig sogs bad mkhris sman ltag pa sprad/ smug po grang rkyen la/ bco lnga drag sbyor/ cong zhi 'phrul thal/ rdo thal sogs zab/ se 'bru'i rigs kyang 'phrod/ ༈ bad kan gre thogs kyi rtags/ brang rgyab dang khrag mig gzer/ skabs su gre ba'i nang spu yod pa 'dra ba dang*/ phreng ldog lta bur yar 'gro phyir 'gro byed pa 'byung*/ na lugs ma nges pa sna tshogs pa 'byung ste la la mchil ma mid dka' mid pa na ba/ 'ga' zhig mchil ma lce steng du dkri ba/ mchil ma mdog 'gyur zhing rnag chu sngo smug 'ong*/ mchil ma sra skam khab mgo 'dra ba dang*/ la lar lce dang mid pa la 'brum phran 'ong*/ 'ga' zhig gre ba 'gags shing lce chung rgyas la phrag mig zer// la lar lce dang mid pa ya rkan rnams la sha bkra'i 'dzer pa 'byung srid/

mid pa lce/ ro stod sogs la 'brum phran 'byung*/ lce dang mid par spu yis dkris snyam dang ro stod la tsha shar 'ong*/ la la zas zos na mid pa dkyus pa yong*/ ro stod na/ gyen du 'gro na dang ga zhan/ yid 'tshub snying mi dga' tshab chen sha skam kham skyugs byed/ mchin srog ske gsum sbrel nas na/ sha 'gul/ lus kyi 'gul skyod dka'/ nad rtags mang na nad tshab che/ nyung na chung*/ gang la'ang grib rigs shin tu 'dzem/ spu yi dkris 'dra rlung shas che/ ske 'gags gre 'byar bag /gre 'dzer phal cher gnyan srin yin/ pho bar bab na pho gcong sogs bad kan ltar yin/ gang yang rim pas 'go ma lci/ bcos thabs ni/ rlung shas che na spang rgyan bcu steng 'brong khrag drug pa bsnan pa'i spang 'brong*/ de steng ar brgyad bsnan/ khrag shas che na spang rgyan bco lnga'i steng sga lo sman dmar bsdebs/ gnyan srin shas che na spang 'brong steng*/ khyung lnga bsnan pa'i spang 'brong nyer lnga zab/ gra ma zug pa ltar skrang na so phag mer bsreg chur 'phang ba spang khyung steng du zhad tsam bsnan pas/ sman nad lhang ba man ngag go /grang 'gags la rdo thal nyer bdun/ spang 'brong steng se 'bru lnga pa bsnan pa zab/ pho bar byung na/ spang 'brong steng pri yang ku se 'bru bsnan pa man ngag dang mkha' 'gro bcu skor sogs sbyar/ lto sbyong lan mang du bya/ se 'bru'i rigs la rdo zhun sbyor ba bsdebs pa 'bri gung gces btus ltar bya/ rjes gcod me gdab bo// yang na dang po man ngag bsil sbyor zhag shas bsten/ lu ba mang na spang rgyan bco lnga cong zhi'i khu bas dbul/ de rjes cong zhi rgod btul gyis gzhi bzung la/ sga pi pho dbyi mong tsi tra ste tsha ba lnga/ rgya rgyam kha gsum/ dza sug ko gsum/ sngo'i tsha ba gsum/ se 'bru byi tang ga ru rta la phug rnams sbyar ba'i phye ma chu bskol gyis phul/ de nas ma zhu bcos skor la/ ma zhu gsar pa la zhi drug

/bco lnga drag sbyor/ dkar po drug sbyor/ rnying pa la ru rta drug pa/ g.yu dril zla shel/ rnam rgyal ril bu/ yun lon na rin chen rigs/ dbang ril rta ri ma sogs dug bcos bya dgos/ ma zhu ba 'di gcong sde drug gi rtsa ba yin pas thog ma nas bshad rgyud nas gsungs pa ltar spang blang gal che'o// skran ni ma zhu bas skyed/ yun lon pa la skran zer/ gsar pa la tsha shas che/ rnying nas grang shas che/ nad rtags ni/ skran gar yod du zug byed cing de'i dreg pa chag /lto stong la lag pas myang bas gsal/ tsha skran 'phrul 'khor bya/ grang skran la bco lnga drag sbyor/ cong zhi 'phrul thal/ tsha bsreg sbyor ba rnams dang*/ de rjes tsha la'i 'phrul bshal btang*/ ༈ bad kan skya rbab 'or/ dmu chu gsum pha tsho lta bur gcig gis khongs su gcig gtogs la/ thog mar pho ba'i me zhan pa dang*/ lus rgas pa/ sa chu sogs ma 'phrod pas slong bas/ skya rbab ni phal cher bab pas lu skyugs byed cing mig lpags rkang bol sogs g.yo/ 'di la chu mdog ser na 'bol sman bdun pa/ dā li bcu dgu/ tsandan bco lnga/ bdud rtsi 'chi sos sogs btang*/ des phan na dwangs ma chu 'dren dang*/ se 'bru kun phan gyis gzhug bcad/ chu ser ba dang*/ tsha shas cher song na dmu chu dang 'or sogs yin pas/ 'bol sman bdun pa/ bong dkar bcu pa/ glang chen gaṅgā chur bsgyur/ gur gum chu bsgyur bde byed/ chu bsgyur/ chu rtsi nyer lnga sogs btang bas grang chur bsgyur/ rtags ni/ skrangs zhi/ chu dwangs pa byung na bde byed kun phan dwangs ma chu 'dren/ chu sman bde ba'i 'khor lo sogs gtong*/ 'on kyang 'di la drod che rigs mi 'phrod pa shes dgos so/ ༈ /tsha ba dang rims gnyis kyang bcos lugs gcig gis 'thus la/ rims dang*/ tsha ba sogs lus grang shum byed/ mgo dang nywa bzhi 'dar/ de la nor bu bdun thang*/ stong nag phur thang*/ bsil bcud bco lnga/ sprin zla/ 'phrul thang*/

des grang shum byed/ gzer gcig tu 'dus/ rtsa chu sogs smin rtags byung na/ be do'i rigs/ gtso brgyad/ gtso khyung*/ dhārma rā dza rnams 'phrod/ gnyan rims shin tu che na/ deng sang dus dbang gis shin tu mang zhing nad rtags dang na lugs sna tshogs pa 'byung gsungs pa ni/ dang po lus la phog pa'i rtags// ba spu g.yo zhing grang shum byed// mgo na phrum ser khyer zhing lus po 'dar// glal mang tshag tshigs na la mgo bo 'khor// me nyi snyogs shing snying mi dga'// rtsa yang phra grim chu mdog sngo// tsha shar 'ong zhing rmi lam rnyogs// rig pa phra 'khrul gdan mi non// bar du nad rgyas tshig kha khol// mgo gzer srin tshag chu ltar khol// rig pa 'khrul la rtsa drag 'phar// chu dmar ro stod brdzang zhing gzer// pags pa tsha la phrum ser che// nad rtags mi 'dra sna tshogs ston// tshad pa'i gzer gyis sgyu lus bshig /rtsib log gzer zhing kha yang kha// rna ba 'on la smyo 'bog 'byung*// tha ma rig pa 'phyo la shes pa 'thib// an stong la sogs tshig bzhi na// snga dro gzer la phyi dro 'thib// nyin phyed rngul la tho rangs skyugs// lus po chu ltar khol zhing gzer// yan lag 'khyugs la glal ba 'ongs// lus g.yeng sa la 'dug mi bzod// mgo 'khor rna ba 'on la glal ba 'ongs// rgyab kyi an stong dang po skrangs// sog steng sgal 'dab sbos shing gzer// sha bkra sngo zhing sha mdog 'gyur// lce steng 'brum pa dkar po 'ongs// 'og tu 'brum pa nag po 'byung*// ro 'dzin ser nag sbrel ba 'ongs/ na ma thag tu gzer ba 'ongs// gzer ma thag tu lud pa 'ongs// lu ma thag tu dud khu 'byung*// khyad par mi 'dra sna dgu 'byung*// nad rigs gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i// nad sna 'dra min sna tshogs 'byung*// khyad par mgo na rtsib g.yon gzer// mdun rgyab stod smad g.yas g.yon gzer// smad nas 'ong zhing stod du 'gro// gar mkhan lag pa'i phyag rgya 'dra// zhes dang*/

yang*/ nag po sum 'dril thog gi mda'// mgo la phog na thod pa ling gis 'phar// mig la phog na mig 'bras thang la lhung*/ lce la phog na padma ltar du gas// snying la phog na dran med nyid du 'chi// rgyu mar phog na sbos 'gas glang thabs 'dra// yan lag bzhi la phog na tshig rnams 'thor// rtsa ni dar lce rlung gis bskyod pa 'dra// rtags ni tshangs bug zil pa phrom phrom byed// bzlog med de yis phal cher 'chi bar 'gyur// zhes gsungs pas/ lar nad 'di rtsa chu mi rtag 'gyur ldog chen po yod pas/ sman spyi 'joms thang nag ma dang*/ gam phye nad ngan spyi 'joms/ gtso khyung 'dis gnyan gyis mgo bo gnon dgos/ bdud rtsi bum pa las/ dang po gnyan gyi ri bo bsnyil// bar du tshad pa'i me dpung bsad// tha ma rlung gi bya rar sgrim// nad ro sbyang zhing lus zung gso// rgyud bzhi'i lugs la/ bsdu bsad sbyong gsum rim bzhin byed dgos kyang*/ nad ngan 'di la bsdu bsad lhan cig ma byas na smin dus bsgug long cher med pas/ sman gong bshad rnams dang*/ ghi dgu khyung nag /gtso khyung g.yu ral ma/ rnam nor phur gsum/ spru nag nyer dgu/ phur nag dgu thang*/ khyung chen nyer lnga/ khyung lnga mdog bzhi/ spru nag sngo ril/ ar rgod/ dharma rā dza/ khyad par du 'phags pa 'bri lugs sman nag chen mo/ parṇa sha ba ri'i ril bu gtong*/ yang gnyan rims 'di don snod rnams la bab pa'i bcos thabs ni/ mgo gzer la mgo thang bcu gsum/ snying la bab na a gar brgyad pa/ glo bar bab na tsandan brgyad pa/ mchin par gi waṃ dgu pa/ mkhris par tig brgyad/ mtsher par ko la bcu gcig /pho bar zhi drug /rgyu mar mkhris phye bdun pa/ mkhal mar bab na a ru bcu pa bcas don snod so so'i gnyen po rnams/ rnam nor phur gsum/ gi dgu khyung nag /gtso khyung gsum gang rung gi steng du mnan la ltag pa sprad dgos/ mthar sro ma rta ri dang drag po bcu gsum gyi nad ro sbyang zhing zas gsar bcud kyis lus zung gso dgos/

'brum bcos kun mkhyen chos 'byung gis mdzad pa'i phan bde myur ster 'di shin tu zab/ nad rtags ni rim rgod phog pa dang 'dra/ sha mdangs dmar la 'thug /lus thams cad brtse/ glo snying brdung*/ mkhris pa skyugs pa 'ong*/ skya nad kyi skabs yin pas/ spu sgo dbye ba'i thang sle tres bdun pa'am/ sle tres bcu drug pa'i gdus thang dron mo gtong*/ 'dis kyang ma thon ngag la nyan/ 'brum pa rdzogs nas gong bshad gnyan rims sman rnams ltag pa sprad/ rgyas par lhan thabs sogs la gzigs/ bla gnyan byung na so so'i bcos thabs 'phrul// gnyan rims lce thog tu bab pa'i gag pa la/ gag pa'i phan pa kun ldan/ rnam rgyal dgu pa/ spyang lce brgyad pa dang dgu pa/ shu dag bzhi pa/ khyung lnga gtso khyung rnams zab/ gnyan sman gzhung sman rnams kyang zab/ ༈ sib bu'i nad rtags gong dang mtshungs/ thog mar ma nu bzhi thang*/ tsha shas che bar sle tres bzhi thang bsten/ khong sman bdud rtsi lo ma/ shug tsher/ gla gul/ shu dag /shing kun dngul chu rgod btul brgyad sbyor/ chu bskol gyis phul/ ༈ 'brum pa thon skabs gong gi gnyan sman rnams gtong*/ nad stobs che na sro ma rta ris sbyangs/ 'di la rjes 'grul rkyen zas spyod sogs zla gcig bar gzab dgos/ ༈ gnyan sha la bab pa'i lhog pa la thog mar skyer shun gyi thang gtong*/ mtha' skor du dkar gsum byugs/ khyung lnga/ wa rta mnyam sbyor/ dmar chen rdo rje pha lam gyis gsod/ yang sngon mo lhog zan me tog gsum pa res res kyang phan/ khyung rgod mnyam sbyor gyi khong srung gtong*/ des ma thub na gnyan bshal sro ma rta ri ma khyung bshal gtong*/ gnyan skrang chung ngu la byang bul chus bkrus pas phan no/ ༈ /mig nad skor la/ dmar po tsha ba khrag /mig zur za ba srin/ mchi zag tsha ba rlung*/ na tsha med nas 'grim pa bad kan yin/ khrag rkyen la/ tsandan bco brgyad sogs khrag sman/ rlung la a gar rigs sogs/ srin la gur gum bcu gsum/

bad kan la bdud rtsi sum sbyor/ nyi zla'i 'khor lo dang*/ gsal byed so gsum sogs ni mig spyi la shin tu zab bo// rlung la dzā ti dang go snyod btab pa'i zan dron gyis gsos byed pa las khong sman gyis phan dka'o/ ༈ /rna skyag skya seng 'ur sgra can rlung yin pas shing kun nyer lnga'am/ ug chos bcu pa'i phye ma ras thum mar khur btsos pa btsir la rna khung dgag /rna skyag snum zhad can srin yin pas gur khyung rtse gsum sogs srin bcos bya/ rnag zag na la phug khu ba dang ra gcin byugs/ zugs byed cing 'on na a ru dang ru rta gnyis kyi phye thum mar btsos btsir/ ༈ sna nad 'gags 'tshang sogs sna nad spyi ni gzhan du gsal ba ltar bya/ sna khrag sogs khrag gcod la/ khrag gcod gi waṃ bcu gsum/ khrag gcod gur gum brgyad pa/ bi ji'i mtshal lud kha sdom sogs zab/ kha yi nad dang*/ rnyil nad sogs gzhan la ltos/ skad 'gags dang gre ba tsha skam la li khyung zab/ 'brong spang yang 'phrod/ lar dbang po lnga yi nad rnams la don lnga so sor bcos pa gal shin tu che'o/ ༈ /snying gi nad khrag rlung skabs ltar ro// btsan dug sman glo nad bcos skor cham pa khrag 'khrugs sogs kyi nad mjug glo bur zhen pa yin pas/ gtso bo nyer lnga dang*/ tsandan bco lngas tshad pa gcog /glo tshad gong gi gnyan ler ltos/ glo rnag yod rtags chu gar zhing ku ya sprin dang rnag ltar red na dkar po yar 'dren/ zang thal nyer lnga dang bse ru nyer lnga zab/ rlung dang gnyan med na/ ga pur nyer lnga/ dpa' bo bcu bzhi/ mthar lud pa skya sob can dang*/ rlung rtags byung na a gar rigs btang*/ sha gsar dang ba 'os lus zungs gso/ cu gang nyer lnga yun du bsten/ bad klo la rgun 'brum bdun pa/ spang rgyan bco lnga/ glo rlung la bdud rtsi 'chi sos// a gar rigs/ 'khrugs glo kun sel rnams zab/ mchin nad skor la/ chu mdog dmar smug /kan rtsa 'bur ba'am yang na zhan/

mig dmar/ gdong smug /rtsib log g.yas gzer/ chang rag 'thung che ba dang*/ smug po khrag rul mchin par lhag pa sogs kyis 'ong*/ nad zhen shor na dka' bas thang chen nyer lngas bsdus la/ gur gum mchog bdun/ gi dgu sogs glang chen rigs/ zla shel/ mang sbyor sogs kyis bcos nas mchin rtsa gtar/ mchin nad lu chung byed nas lud pa skya sob 'byung*/ de la nyi zla kha sbyor zab/ ༈ mtsher nad sbos gzer byed/ mchu sngo nag tu skrangs/ shu thor 'ong*/ shig mang*/ de la ko la bco brgyad/ zhi drug a ru bdun pa bsres pa zab/ za phrug byung na de steng spos dkar bcu pa sdeb/ ༈ mkhal nad bcos skor/ dang po khrag nad smad du bab pa'i rgyu yin/ grang khrag /rtsa 'gram/ gnyan 'gram sogs 'bod pa/ chu dmar po snyigs ma can mkhal sked gzer ba de yin pas/ a ru bcu pa dang*/ nyer lnga bco brgyad sogs btang*/ ar khyung sar khyung sogs kyis gnyan tshad gcog /des chu dwangs/ gzer chags na nyi dkyil/ go yu dgu sbyor/ se 'bru'i rigs sogs btang bas 'thus/ ༈ 'gram la/ chu lam tsha/ rgyu zhabs gzer/ chu lam nas 'o rul lta bu'i snyigs ma zags pa de/ ser shas che na khrag dang gnyan/ sngo shas che na rlung dang grang ba yin/ res 'ga' gcin nang khrag rang 'ong ba yod/ 'di la gnyan dang gdon che bas/ thog mar drod sman 'gro mi nyan/ man ngag gam phye dmar po/ ar khyung*/ pad rag /chos nyid dmar po bcas yun du bsten/ des chu dwangs na/ go yu dgu sbyor/ nyi dkyil/ bsam nor sogs gtong*/ shin tu zug zer che na/ nyi zla gyen bzlog /sug smel bcu pa/ a ru zag gcod bcas gtong*/ ༈ 'bras bu skrangs pa dang*/ pho rtags 'greng nas skrangs pa sogs 'di'i khongs su gtogs pas/ bre ga bcu gsum/ rtsa thag bcu drug sogs gtong*/ na so rgas pa la me btsa'/ gzhon pa la gtar ga byed pa sogs gang bab shes dgos/ ༈ mkhris nad gong song pho nad bad kan ltar/ ༈ long nad rlung dang rgyu nad mkhris pa ltar bcos/

༈ lgang pa bsam se'u'i nad mkhal bcos kyis 'thus shing*/ de la'ang tsha grang phye nas bcos dgos/ ༈ gcin 'gags ni bad kan gyi be snabs rtsa sbub tu 'khar ba dang*/ rlung gi lgang pa kha log pa dang*/ grang bas chu rgyu'i lam 'gags pa sogs yod/ mo nad rims kyis chu 'gags pa'ang mthong*/ bad kan rlung gis 'gags pa la/ sug smel bcu pa/ tshwa sbyor chen mo/ g.yer drug chu 'dren sogs zab/ rims tshad kyis 'gags na/ gu gul bcu gcig /mo nad kyis 'gags pa rdo rje can sbyor gtong*/ gcin snyi la 'gram bcos kyis 'thus/ ༈ rkang pa'i dregs nad khrag nad chu ser rtsa la bab pa yin/ rkang pa'i mthe bong dang lag pa'i gru mo sogs gzer che/ bong khrag nyer lnga/ spos khyung*/ spos bcu/ klu bdud/ khyung lnga/ grang shas che na/ seng ldeng nyer lnga/ mdzo gcin lci ba sogs kyis 'byar byas pas zhi/ gtar me sogs mthong rgyud ltar bya/ ༈ chu ser ni/ za phrug byed pa'i rigs yin/ sman gong gi dregs sman las mi dgos/ bya khyung pa rig pa bde skyid/ bya khyung shel ral can sogs byug pas 'thus/ ༈ rtsa dkar 'di la brdab 'gram dang*/ rlung dang grib sogs kyi rkyen las/ dpung sog /gru mo/ gnya' ba sogs na la/ byugs pa rtsa dkar kun sel rdo byug sogs byed la/ khong sman/ bsam 'phel nor bu/ ratna bsam 'phel/ byur dmar nyer lnga/ a gar nyi shu sogs zab/ gser tshugs/ rwa tshugs/ seng ldeng gi tshugs sogs zab/ gtar ga mi 'phrod/ ༈ skom nad ni khrag dang smug po/ rlung sogs shas che ba'i sman dang*/ so phag sum thang*/ tsandan bco brgyad spang rgyan bco lnga zab/ ༈ skyeg bu ni/ tsha ba'i rjes su rlung khrag zhugs pa'am/ bad kan gyis gyen rgyu'i rlung dkrug pas 'ong*/ 'di yun ring na pho thog tu 'gyur ba'ang yod pas/ dkar nag mtshams bsreg /rlung la a gar so lnga/ bad kan la go gre bco brgyad/ tshad gzhug la a gar so lnga sogs zab/ ༈ glang thabs ni pho long gi srin 'bu kha zas ma 'phrod pas slong ba zhig yin 'di la gnyan glang dang*/

srin glang*/ ma zhu dug thabs smug po'i glang thabs gsum yod/ rtags ni/ gnyan glang pho ba gris dkrug pa ltar gzer/ srin glang pho ba lhod 'byar byed nas na/ smug po glang thabs kyis sbos nas rngul chu 'dzag zhing na/ bcos thabs/ gnyan glang la/ 'chi med srin sel/ phan pa kun ldan/ ru khyung sogs gtong*/ srin glang la'ang des phan/ smug po'i glang thabs la/ g.yu dril/ zla shel/ ru rta drug pa zab/ glang thabs spyi la/ dmar po spyi 'joms kyi sbyong yang zab/ skyugs na bu ram sen mo tsam gtong*/ de rjes sman btang bas mi skyugs/ cis kyang ma phan na ni ru has drangs/ smug glang la long rtsa gtar/ srin glang la me btsa' bzhag /gnyan glang sman gyis bcos dgos pas shes par bya'o/ ༈ /'khru skyug bcos skor/ tsha 'khru dmar ser/ grang 'khru skya bo zas mdog 'byung*/ tsha 'khru la mkhris phye bdun pa/ ind+ra bzhi thang sogs zab/ grang 'khru la da trig bdun dgu/ gu ling 'bras kyi ril bu rnams zab kyang gcod snga mi rung ba tshod zin dgos/ skyugs pa rnams la/ shing mngar drug pa/ 'bras yos gsum pa sogs kyis bcad/ gang la yang dang po mi bzhag pas 'thus pa lags/ de la sogs pa phran bu'i nad bcos sna tshogs gzhan du blta bar bya'o/ ༈ /byis pa'i rna rtsa dpyad lugs du ma yang*// blun rmongs rnams kyi kha nas ci thon 'bri// shes rlom 'ga' yang de yi rjes su 'brang*// rna ba g.yas g.yon gsum las mang ba'i rtsa// byis pa kun la med pa myong bas grub// rtsa la yal ga yod med khyad tsam mchis// rna rtsa blta thabs brang ti'i lugs las kyang*// g.yas g.yon gsum re drug las bshad pa med// byis pa pho mo snying rtsa go ldog dang*// pho la g.yon gyi dang po snying rtsa dang*// gnyis pa mtsher rtsa gsum pa mkhal g.yon rtsa// g.yas kyi dang po glo rtsa gnyis pa ni// mchin rtsa gsum pa mkhal ma g.yas kyi rtsa// zhag re rtsa re zug pa bshad na yang*// ma nges bcu gnyis zla phyed tshun la yang*// 'ga' re la yang mi rdzogs pa ni mthong*// rtsog grib bsal phyir nub mo bsang khrus byed// nyi shar rna ba chus sbang dar gyis dbyi// rna mdun nyi shar bstan te rgyab nas blta// spyi la rtsa yi kha dog ni// nag la rgyas pa tsha ba'i rtsa// skya la zhan pa grang ba'i rtsa// sha mdog ser na ser nad yin// rtsa gsum skam na myur du 'chi// dmar zhing gsal na nad med rtsa// rtsa rnams kun gyi rtsa ba ru// spun spun nag nog don rtsa yin// rtsa yi mgo rnams 'dzing na gdon// nag po gru bzhi gru gsum ni// rtsa sked pha la rtsa smad ma// sked pa byis pa rang la ngan// lhag par glo rtsa pha la ngan// mchin rtsa ma dang snying rtsa rang*// gru bzhi gru gsum gang byung na// rna ba lag pa g.yas g.yon gyi// dang po'i rtsa gnyis gug na 'chi// bar ma gnyis ni gug na ngan// gso bar dka' ba gzhung nas bshad// mtha' gnyis gug na nad gzhi yod// yal dang chad dang 'chi ba yin// khyad par snying rtsa dag la'o// zangs re chang mtsho'i bskor ba las// brgal nas chang mtshor song na 'chi// snying rtsa tshe yi dmu thag dang*// lha sa byis pa rang rtsa yin// smyug phung rgyas pa 'dra na bzang*// rgan gyi tshe phug thon pa yin// byis pa tshe ni ring bar bshad// glo rtsa skyes pa pho yi sa// mi phyug rkang bran e 'phel dpyad// ljon shing lo 'dab rgyas 'dra dang*// shug phung rgyas pa 'dra ba dang*// dar skud dmar po brkyang 'dra bzang*// le 'u srung mda' tshugs pa yin// bu skyes mi ser thon pa yin// pho yi mda' gral dam pa yin// rta lugs nor phyugs 'phel ngo yin// mchin rtsa ma dang bu mo'i sa// ba dan phyar 'dra dar skud gshib// rin chen phreng ba brgyus 'dra bzang*// mtsher rtsa rkang bzhi phyugs kyi rtsa// gru bzhi bong ba gang 'dra ni// nor phyugs ra ba gang ba yin// shug phung yungs dkar phung po 'dra// nor phyug rkang bran 'phel ngo yin// mkhal rtsa bran dang sgo khyi'i sa// mda' smyug bkugs pa 'dra na bzang*// sa yi rten phur tshugs pa yin// smyug phran rgyas 'dra dar dpyang 'dra// rtse mo gyen la 'gug na bzang*// g.yog byed dgra 'khor khug pa yin// snying rtsa lha mtshun dgra lha'i sa// mtshun gyi lag pa brkyangs pa ni// nag la thur du gug pa dang*// bya pho'i mjug sgro 'dra ba ni// pha khu rgan rabs dag la ngan// blo rtsa skyes pa pho yi sa// nag la thur du gug pa dang*// ba spu lang ling yod pa na// sa yi rten phur bud pa yin// sa shor yul bud 'ong ba yin// wa ni dkar po dkyil stong na// srung mda' mthur du chags pa yin// pho yi mda' gral zhig pa yin// ma yi pang nas bu yal ngo*// g.yang gi ra ba stong nges yin// mchin rtsa ma bu'i rtse sa yin/

khrag gi rgya mtsho ma skam dgos// ser na rtsa mgo 'dzin na skam// nag la zur yu mda' zug 'dra// sbrul nag thur du rgyug 'dra dang*// lcags kyu bkug pa 'dra ba dang*// srin byas 'bu ro khyer 'dra ngan// mtsher rtsa rkang bzhi phyugs kyi rtsa// chu ser gnas mal ma bcas dgos// mtsher rtsa nag la rgyas pa dang*// dmar nag long ga khrag g.yos 'dra// chu ser gnas mal bcas pa yin// dmar nag ri ba'i sdong bu 'dra// phyugs kyi nad dang god kha 'ongs// mkhal rtsa 'og rta chung ma bran// sgo khyi'i sa ru bshad pa yin// de yi dkyil du wa ded na// btsan du re ba'i sa phug na// khro chu'i sla nga byi bas phug /bran gyi sde srid gcod ngo yin/ rna ba lag pa gnyis ka'i rtsa// dmar la gsal na nad med yin// sbom phra med par snyoms pa ni// 'phral zug che yang phug skyon med// lo brgyad bar du rna rtsa brtags// gsang ba'i la nye brtag pa ni// nu ma ma 'thung gong rol du// snod gtsang gnyis su chu blugs nas// nu zho bag re so sor bzhos// chu dang 'o ma 'dres na 'tsho// kha la ling nger ldang na 'tsho// ma 'dres phram phram 'dug na 'chi// zhabs su hril gyis song na na/ kha zhab ka ba btsugs pa na// 'dre gdon yin pas rim gro bya// g.yas pa pho 'dre g.yon mo 'dre// gc-ig 'dres gcig ni ma 'dres na// rim 'gro sogs kyi bslu ba yod// gnyis ka ma 'dres gting song spangs// gcig 'dres gcig ma 'dres pa'am// gcig kha gcig zhabs 'tsho ba dka'// phyi tshul rtags rnams brtag pa 'di ltar 'dod/ mgo bo dung gi gzhong pa ma ral dgos// mtshog khung g.yu yi rgya mtsho ma skam dgos// ltag pa dung gi kha ru ma bye dgos// dpral ba lha yi dmu thag ma chad dgos// mig 'bras zar ma'i me tog ma sad dgos// dri 'dzin zangs kyi sbu gu ma chad dgos// ro 'dzin dar dkar dri ma ma chags dgos// mjing pa me tog yu ba ma yo dgos// dran pa'i bya ra dong du ma lhung dgos// brang kha gshin rje'i khri la ma btab dgos// lto ba srid pa'i 'khor lo ma skam dgos// lag mthil gtso bo'i 'dun sa ma stong dgos// rkang mthil g.yu yi sgrom bu ma chag dgos// mgyogs byed rlung gi 'khor lo ma skam dgos// ser mo bse yi bkrag mdangs ma yal dgos// gzhungs pa shel gyi phreng thag ma chad dgos// kun gzhi dar dkar yol ba ma ral dgos// phyi tshugs dbang po'i rtags rnams ma ngan dgos// yang gcig sman pa g.yu thogs pas// byis pa'i rkyer kha ma shes na// byis pa gso ba'i sman pa min// gsungs pas/

'chang kha nas ni mdzub mo yi// nges na phar zug rtsa de nad// med na mi rgyas yod na rgyas// rgya khab rnon pos gtar na khrag /khem mgo chung ba gang tsam byung*// mig gi yar la mi lta'am// 'bur tshugs blta nas 'khun pa sogs// rgyas pa rgyud kyi dgongs don ltar// tsha grang gang yin gnyen po brten// snying kha mnan pas 'phar ba na// brang gzhung dkar nag mtshams dang ni// rgyab kyi tshigs pa drug dang bdun// bu yi g.yon dang bu mo'i g.yas// nu ma nas ni rang tshon re// phyogs bzhi'i lhen sne 'char sna dang*// lhen gsum kha gsum me tshugs bya// don snod gangs la nad yod pa// brtags nas rang rang gsang la bsreg /spra tshugs byed na sran ma phyed// tsam gyis pags pa 'khum tsam las// mi rung byis pa'i me btsa'o// spra tshugs las kyang spos bzang ngo*// tshugs bya 'di ni lag len yin// byis rims me ltar 'bar zhing 'phar rtsa rgyug /ngu 'chag ru 'thib ba spu log /skom 'dod skyong zhing kha sna lag pas bsub// yang byis pa glo 'khun ni/ tsha sab drag tu lu la 'gog rgyu med// lus po tsha la rtsa yi 'phar sgo drag /glo bstud yong zhing brang dang ma la 'brad// rjes la skyug nyams byed tsam mu la 'khun// 'di ni byis pa dag la phal cher 'byung*// lud med glo ni thang thang po// rnag khrag 'dzag cing tshad rtags che// 'di ni mi 'gyur rtags su 'dod// yang byis pa'i snying la nad yod na 'phar/ glor lu/ mchin pas 'khun/ pho ba sgregs/ mtsher sbos/ long 'khrog /rgyu ma 'khru/ lgang par chu sri/ btang dus zug che/ rims kyis sbrid pa mang*/ klad pa na na g.yal mang*// pho mchin na na skyeg bu byed/ 'di ni shin tu nges so// gso thabs ni/ byis rims la/ sle tres bzhi thang*/ tig ta gnyis thang grang mo kha la byin/ spyi bzhur ka ra chur sbang ba gtong*/ gur gum bzhi pa ka ra sbyar ba gtong*/ tshad stobs che na ga pur/

glo mang na rgun 'brum cu gang chur bsing gtong*/ chang rnying bur gsum gyi khu ba gsum ka ras sbyang*/ rjes su cu gang bde byed chen mo dang*/ kha zas bsil ba bsten/ drod bcud 'jom/ cham pa glo 'khun la/ ma nu bzhi thang*/ byis pa'i glo tshad kun sel/ gnyan tshad la 'khru sman btang*/ yang dkar po bdun sbyor/ cu gang brgyad pa shin tu zab/ ri thang mtshams su ar nag /sgog thal bsnan/ drug bdun dkar nag mtshams su me btsa' gdab/ tshab chen bcos dka' na/ ga pur bdun sbyor zab/ yang na/ ser po glo gcod gdos khur/ rgun 'brum gsum pa btab/ glo nam byung dus hub re btang bar bya/ glo brgyal sel bar the tshom med do// rims tshad spyi la/ spyi 'joms ril bu zab/ gzhan yang nad rigs so so'i bcos thabs gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar/ na lugs rna rtsa la bstun nas bcos dgos so/ ༈ /mo nad kyi rigs rnams grangs mang yang*/ gsar pa khrag tshabs can dang*/ rnying pa rlung tshabs can gnyis yin/ khrag tshab ni ro rgyab dang mchin dri na/ rgyu zhabs tsha 'brab byed/ sked pa man chad khol ba ltar na/ rtsa rgyud tsha zhing 'brum phran 'byung*/ zla mtshan 'byams pa'am 'khyil ba sogs 'byung*/ me nyis dros tshe ldang*/ rlung tshabs ni/ sems mi bde/ smyo 'bog brjed ngas che/ rus pa khol/ snying 'phar/ hus 'debs/ mgo bo 'khor/ srog rtsa rgyas snyam byed/ zhar byung mo nad tshigs 'grim khrag 'dril gyen logs rigs dang gsum sha ma 'thogs pa bcas bcos tshul/ tshigs 'grim tshig rnams gzer zhing skrangs/ tshigs kha bye zhing rtsa chu sra snyi byed/ khrag 'dril pho mchin mdun rgyab/ brang bshur gzer/ kha lce skam zhing mig dmar ldang dub byed/ rtsa dma' zhan zhar bar 'phar 'ongs/ tsha ba gyen log ni btsas rjes su mig rus gzer la/ rgyu ma gzer zhing mig rtsa dmar/ rtsa ni tshad pa spyi dang 'dra/ rlung gyen log ni spyi gtsug dang mgo na/ yi ga ldog yal ga mang rlung rtsa'o// khrag gyen log ni/

zla mtshan nyung*/ mig dmar/ kha skam/ snying srog gzer/ mgo bo na/ tshad pa gyen du song ba'i rtags dang mthun/ sha ma tsha 'thog dang*/ grang 'thog gnyis las/ tsha 'thogs ni ldang dub byed/ mgo bo gzer/ tsha drod 'ong*/ rngul shum 'ong*/ grang 'thog la/ zug med pa'o// bcos thabs ni/ khrag tshab la/ smyug rtsi nyer lnga sogs gzhung sman rnams dang*/ rgya ru bcu bzhi kha tshar can/ stod yul du tsandan bco brgyad/ mtshan yul la glang chen bcu gsum/ gur gum bcu gsum kha tshar can gtong*/ rlung tshabs la/ a gar bco lnga dang so lnga/ 'ol se nyer lnga/ rgya ru bcu bzhi ar brgyad sdebs/ gur gum bcu gsum kha tshar can zab/ tsheg 'grim sogs mo nad spyi la/ gur gum zhe gnyis ma dang*/ mo btsun nyer 'tsho sogs zab/ khrag 'dril la/ rgya ru'i kha bsgyur ram yang na dkar po drug sbyor steng du/ star bu zi tsha sbrul sha bsdebs pas bshigs/ ma thub na gong gi steng*/ dur byed/ dung thal/ star bu/ sbrul sha bsdebs pas bung bskyed pa'i bshal gyis sbyangs/ 'byams te ma chad na/ khrag gcod spyi ltar dgos/ lar mo nad kyi rigs rlung tshabs ma gtogs gzhan la gtar kha dgos/ gyen log gsum las/ dang po brang tshad la/ gtso khyung ngam gam dmar zhad tsam gtong*/ rgyu gzer la snyag chung ngam thang nag /rgyu mar kha bsgyur la/ ma thub na/ gong sman la ga pur sbyar/ btsas ma thag rma gsar ltar bcos/ rlung gyen log la/ ma nu bzhi thang ar brgyad bsnan pa dang*/ a ru bcu gsum rlung nad spyi yi bcos tshul gang dgos byas chog /drug bdun dkar nag mtshams dang an stong bsregs/ sha gsar chang dang rus khu sman mar skabs bstun sbyar/ khrag gyen log la/ khrag thang bcu pa sogs dang*/ phye ma tsandan bco brgyad/ glang chen bcu gsum sogs khrag bcos spyi ltar dang*/ gtar kha grangs mang du bya'o// bang khrag lkug na/ bzung yul dang bstun te/ gang bab spyi sman steng*/ gze lcam sdig gsum/

spa yag /'bri rta/ g.yer ma zhad tsam star bu sbrul sha bungs bskyed la btang*/ tsha shas che na ga pur sdeb/ drod mi rung*/ tshad pa spyi bzhin/ sbrum ma grang rlung gtsor bcos dgos te/ dkar po drug sbyor steng du gang bab kyi gnyen po skabs dang sbyar chog /gnyan tshad srid gsum glo bur gyi nad bcos dgos byung tshe gzhung bzhin no// zla grangs rdzogs kyang skye ma nus par/ drug sbyor steng du sbrul sha sogs bsnan pa dang*/ mgyogs thang g.yer ma'i phye dang mde'u 'byin dgu pa btang na 'phral du bde ba ster ro// sha ma tsha thogs la/ gtso brgyad steng ga pur ram/ phyi rgyud ga pur nyi shu btang bas sel lo// grang 'thogs la/ zug med pa 'ong*/ de la dkar po drug steng du/ bul tog sum sbyor/ yang na sbrul sha bsnan pas sel lo// gdon nad bcos skor gzhung gzhan du gzigs/ ༈ gza' bcos skor la/ bsam 'phel nor bu/ khrag sbyor nyer lnga zab/ grib phog dus spos dkar gyi thang btang na bcos sla/ ༈ klu gdon gyi bcos la phyag rdor ril bu bsdu sgrub tshad ldan byas pa dang*/ khyung lnga kha tshar can/ rin chen sbyor ba sogs zab/ spyi la/ khong sman spang rtsi bcu gnyis/ ldum chen dgu sbyor/ gtso khyung sogs zab/ bcad sbyor lnga pa'am/ nyer lnga zab/ ༈ mgo chags la/ brtag pa dang po gces btus gzhan du gsal ba ltar dgos shing*/ brdab ma thag brgyal ba dang*/ tshon kan gyi rtsa rgyud bzhin dang*/ rus skyon yod na sna chu dang*/ klad skyon yod na khrag rnag nges par 'byung ba dang*/ tshab che na mgo 'khor sogs 'byung*/ dang po zhag bdun tshun chad khong srung gtso khyung gtong*/ de nas ljang gu drug sbyor/ stab seng thang gis 'phul/ 'bri gung 'tsho mdzad mang sbyor chang sha khu sogs kyis 'phul/ yang na 'od ldan bcu gcig man ngag ldan pa chang gar mos 'phul/ gzhan yang bdud rtsi dkar sbyor dmar sbyor zab gnad bla ma'i zhal gdams/

rus pa ma sdom mtho dma' byung na mtho ba ngos kyi steng nas me btsa' dang til mes bsregs pas sor chud/ mgo ma 'byor bar du khrag mi gtar ba zab gnad dam pa yin no/ ༈ /rkang lag sogs chag grum byung na/ gong gi ljang gu drug sbyor/ gong gi rdo rtsi ltag sprod gong bzhin chog /legs par 'byor tshe gtar ga dang chu tshan sogs 'phrod/ ༈ dpung pa bud na/ mi gcig gis rgyab nas dam par bzung*/ lha rjes lag dpung nas phyir 'then pas kim sgra grags na tshud rtags yin pas mgul du bcings la zas spyod gzab/ ༈ lag bud na/ khod snyaums pa zhig gi steng du phying ba bting la lag pa kha sbub nas drang por bzhag pas rkang pas brdzis pas tshud yong*/ ༈ rkang pa bud na sngar ltar btsud/ pus mo bud na gong ltar dang*/ thams cad la rjes gcod rngabs ru dang chu lum bya/ ༈ ma ne bud na sna nang du dud rgan btab pas sbrid pa byung na tshud nges so/ ༈ /thur sel gyi rlung log pa dang*/ grang gzhi sogs kyi gzhang lugs na/ sbrul zhags bcu gnyis dang*/ bco brgyad pa zab/ ༈ rma dang khrag shor sogs la rma chas bzo ba'i mdo ltar gces/ ༈ sbyar dug la/ rin chen grang sbyor/ dbang ril nyer lnga sogs zab/ brtags thabs ni gzhan la ltos/ kha zas ma 'phrod pa sogs dug tu gyur song na/ nad rtags nyes gsum sdong zla ltar ston/ rtsa phra la gting na grim/ chu dmar ser ram smug la ku ya dum bur chad/ tshab che na bsdu gso bshal gsum dgos pa gzhan la gzigs/ spyi la thang chen nyer lnga/ mang sbyor chen mo zab/ gi waṃ bco lnga zab/ ༈ sha dug la/ stong nag thang ser ma/ gser zhi/ zhi drug kha tshar can thang chen nyer lnga'ang zab/ ༈ khyi dug sogs dug rigs rnams gzhung gzhan la gsal/ reg dug la ra khrag bco lnga/ ༈ reg dug reg sman sogs zab/ rgyu rkyen rtags bcos sogs ma bris/ ༈ tshe bsring rgas pa gso ba ni/ spyir bshad rgyud nas gsungs pa'i spyod lam rnams dran shes bzhin du bsten cing*/

mi 'phrod pa'i kha zas bsrung ba dang*/ lus ngag yid gsum dman lhag log pa'i sbyor ba la mi 'jug cing*/ rtag tu nyams ldan gyi zas spyod tshul bzhin du bsten na nad gsar pa mi skye zhing skyes pa'ang rang sar zhi gsung pa ltar gal che/ man rgyud nas gsungs pa'i rtsi bzhi dwangs ma lnga'i bcud len/ 'ba' sam sman mar/ go yu bde ba'i dpag bsam/ 'jam dbyangs ril bu dang dbyangs can ril bu bstan na blo gros 'phel ba'i bcud len du 'gyur ro/ ༈ /ro rtsa stobs bskyed skor la/ da byid dgu sbyor/ da byid bcu gsum sogs gzhung sman rnams bsten na stobs bskyed kyi sman khyad par can du grub bo/ ༈ /da ni mkho gal che ba'i sman kha shas/ dug 'don pa la/ thog mar rin po che ni/ g.yu rnying gzi dang byi ru mu tig sogs gang yin khrob brdung byas pa'i ljid mnyam tshad tshwa la/ ze tshwa/ ze tshwe'i sum cha be ljang re ral/ gaṅgā chung*/ ltar bu'i khaṇḍa mang tsam/ a ru ra rus pa dang bcas pa/ mgron bu sbe can gyi thal ba tsha 'debs tsam/ gla rtsi dri thon bcas lo brgyad dri chur btab pa byi ru mdog 'gyur tsam du btso/ de rjes chang bzang bsnan nas btso/ de rjes chu grang gis dag par bkru/ de rjes chu gtsang nang du lan gsum btso la bshal lo/ ༈ /dngul chu btso bkru chen mo'i lag len gzhan na gsal/ 'dul snod dkar yol gyi gtun dang 'dul tho byung na legs/ kṣa ra sogs kyi skabs su dngul chu phra mo 'thor ba la/ chu tshan blugs la dkrugs te dwangs bcug nas yang yang bshal/ rjes su chu zad nas phyogs gcig tu 'dril yong*/ gnyugs bsring nas dngul chu phor re la chu phor rab nyer lnga/ 'bring bco lnga/ tha ma bdun gyis bshal na dngul chu de tshod mi gron/ btso bkru che 'bring chung gsum dus dngul chu ska ba dang*/ snum nag dang*/ tshil zhun sogs gting nas 'khar ba 'dres te chu tshan gyi mi dros 'byed dka' ba 'byung de la sa khu rnams chu tshan gyis bshal nas/
