snum nyung ngur zad dus/ bal tshi med kyi snum zhag thams cad phyi/ dngul chu'ang bal des dkrug pas snum bal gyis len 'ong*/ bal btsir bas dngul chu rdog che ba rnams snod du lhung ste 'dril/ dngul zhib bal la 'byar ba rnams bal dang bcas pa sa slang lta bur drod thum skam steng blug thal brgyab nas bal zhib tu bsed la lcags snod sogs 'jam por blugs te shug thal 'os tshod btab la dal bus sor rtses 'phur/ shug thal rnams phus gtor na shul du dngul chu rnams 'gril 'ong*/ btso 'bring skabs dngul chu rdzas ro dang 'dres pa lta bu phye dka'/ yang ras tshags la drang nas tsa lon las/ rdzas ro 'dul mnye mi rung ste dngul chu dang mu zi 'dres nas len rgyu med par sib ber 'gro/ tshag ras la gos pa chu tshan gyis 'khru ba sogs thabs gang drag dgos/ lcags brgyad thal bzo la/ gser gyi ljid las sum 'gyur mu zi/ nyis 'gyur tsha la chu bcad/ rang mnyam til nag bcas zhib btag zar chus sbrus pa byugs te chu tshod 10 20 tsam bsreg /dngul rang 100 mnyam tshwa la 100 nyis 'gyur mu zi 200 zar khu'i chus sbrus la byugs/ me dal bus chu tshod nyi shu bsregs na 'tshigs/ zangs rang dang ljid mnyam tshwa la nyis 'gyur mu zi'i rdzas kyi me ran pas chu tshod brgyad tsam du'o/ /lcags phye rang 100 mnyam a ru ra 100 nyis 'gyur tshwa la 200 sum 'gyur 300 mu zi bcas rdo gtun du bsnur te 'dam 'thag byas nas theb kyu byas pa skam nas sreg snod blugs te chu tshod nyi shu tsam bsregs pas grub bo// 'khar ba ra gan phye mar brdar te nyis 'gyur tshwa la/ sum 'gyur mu zi bcas chang skyur gyis 'dam thag theb kyu byas te chu tshod bcu tsam bsregs pas so// gsha' dkar ljid mnyam tshwa la/ sum 'gyur mu zi bcas kyi phye zhib a ru'i khu bas byugs la tshu tshod bdun brgyad tsam bsregs pas so// zha nye ljid mnyam ldong ros/

nyis 'gyur tsam mu zi ra 'os byugs/ me chung bas chu tshod bdun tsam na'o// sngo 'khyog ti tsha/ mchan/ bsreg rdzas bshad ma thag pa dang 'dra/ me cung che bas chu tshod dgu tsam la'o// gser gyi sbrang gshog tsam brdung*/ tsha chur btso/ sug pas mnye zhing dri ma bral nas gzod bsreg go /lcags 'om khu dang tshwa/ dngul tsha dang se 'bru'i khu ba'i nang*/ zangs mtshur nag star bu dar ba gsum nang*/ rag zangs 'dra/ gsha' zha nye gnyis dngul 'dra/ li gser 'dra/ rang rang g.ya' bton rjes su chur btso chang gis bshal lo// de ltar lcags brgyad bsreg snod me thab kyi rdza ha shig 'dres pa'i gwa'u gru bzhi kha chod nang du song ba kha mnyam pa 'dzer btab pa'i bu ga yod pa byas la/ gser dngul zangs gsha' zha nye ti tsha sbrang gshog tsam du brdung la sa sgam dang mtshams par dras/ rdzas rnams ka sla zho tsam byas te phyi kun tu khyab cing rdzas ma chad ma lhag par mnyam par byugs te rim skam bya/ rdzas kyi shul du'ang chu zhad tsam sbyar te khu ba sla mo'ang kun gyi phyi nang mnyam par byugs shing rdzas ma lhag par bya/ skam nas sa sgam nang du sol phye bkram pa sgam dang sbrang gshog phan tshun mi thug par gtsang ba'am/ zhabs su sol phye khod gcig btang nas sbrang gshogarnams ras dkar dri med kyis dril nas bzhag la/ steng 'og gi bar gseng sol phye cung tsam gyis bkang nas gzer btab/ kha srub bsdam par sa sgam gyi rgyu'i 'dag pas 'char/ de skam gas te kha 'phar na slar ras sam skud pa 'dag sbyar gyis bcad de me drod chung ngu sogs la skam thag chod nas sol mer bsreg /sbud pa ma chad par dal 'bud byas pas snod rnams dmar ltim mer song nas brtsam ste gong gi yun ltar bsreg /me ha cang drag na zhu ste 'dril/ me chung na yun ring yang mi tshig pas tshod zin par bya/ gser ni rang rdzas gzhung bshad las sum 'gyur tsam mthug po byugs la me shed shin tu che bas bar med kyis bsreg phyir mu zi'i dri sangs pa tshos tshad du gsungs kyang sgam la drod yod tshe kha bde na mu zi'i du ba 'khyil ba sngo bsangs 'thul sgyu yod kyang rdzas tshig ches pa mthong na/

mu zi'i dri sangs kho na la mi blta bar/ me snyoms shing yun gong ltar brtags/ tshig yod snyam pa'i dus sa sgam blangs shing grang nas kha phye la sol ba rnams thog mar mdzub mo sogs kyi lag nan ma shor bar yang ba'i tshul gyis chus bkru/ ras kyis dkris pa bsregs legs na sol phye dang ma 'dres pa len bde ba 'ong*/ ras tshigs thal ba dang sol phye dang lcags brgyad thal ba 'dres kyang chu blugs nas dkrugs te dwangs pa la chus bshal bas sol thal phyir 'gro/ lcags brgyad zhabs su snyigs 'ong bas chu sig yang yang bya ba gal che/ bsreg dus du ba shor mi nyan/ lcags brgyad thal ba mdzub mos bcag na shog bu 'dra byung na tshod zin pa yin/ shog thal lta bu byung na tshig ches pa y-in/ lcags dang 'khar rag rnams phye ma byas te rdzas sbyar theb kyu skam nas sa sgam gru bzhi'am gru gsum 'jung du blugs te bsreg /rdzas ro chu sig bya/ lcags brgyad thal ba rnams sos bsdad pas phye mar 'gro yang btegs tshe ljid tshad sngar 'dug pa yin/ khams bdun bsreg rdzas dang bsres te theb kyu byas pa gzhung ltar la sa sgam nang du blugs na phye ma gang bar bya zhing lcags kyi dkris nas phyi nas rdzas shed thub g.yog la mi 'gas pa bya/ bsreg dus sol me shed chung la drod rim pas 'phog yun ring ba byed/ thabs mkhas ma byas na ze tshwa 'phyur nas phag sgra bcas 'thor bas gzab/ lcags gzhan rnams phyi g.yog cher med kyang thub par snang*/ sngo 'khyog brdung mi gtub pa des lo/ bal po sogs stod kyi sngo 'khyog dkar shas che ba bzang*/ gsha' dngul mdog can bzang*/ 'tshigs mi 'tshigs sgyu mar brtag pa gal che'o/ ༈ /dngul chu 'dul lugs bco lnga tsam bshad pa gzhan la ltos/ mgyogs 'dul ni/ zha nye dang dngul chu cha mnyam/ de dang gsha' dkar cha mnyam pa lcags snod du mar khur bzhus la lcags thur gyis dkrug nas 'dres nges dus su phog la rdo grang steng blug pa dngul chu skag ste lag pas khyogs par 'gyur/

de kṣa ra lnga'am gang rung dang*/ star khu ze tshwa re ral rnams kyis khu bar bskol nas chus bshal la/ ljid mnyam mu zi dang sbyar te rdo gzhong du zhib 'dul phye ma sngon mo de dngul chu dang sbyor dgos pa'i bsil sman rigs dang bsre/ dug gtan nas med do// drag 'dul ni/ mu dngul ljid mnyam btegs lcags snod du mu zi bzhus pa'i nang du dngul chu blugs nas me shed che bar dal bus sbar te lcags thur gyis dkrugs pa 'dres nas grang bcug na/ yang drod cung bab lcags snod nas bkog ste rdo gtun drod phab par skam 'dul byas pas khra tshi gi ba dang*/ mu zi'i ser ljang mngon pa rnams gcig tu 'dres te sngon ltar 'byung ba ste/ slar lcags snod du zhu tsam byas nas dkrugs te/ phog la grang na sngo 'tsher 'byung ba de gar bzhag /dngul khyung sogs dang chu ser grang ba'i sman rigs la bsre/ 'di skabs me che mi rung*/ chung na yun ring yang mi skyon tshod zin na yud tsam gyis 'grub bo// tshul 'di byas na sha ltar zos kyang dug gtan nas mi 'byung ngo*// dngul chu dang sbyar ba'i sman gzhan las nus pa brgya'am 'bum gyis 'phel bar gsungs/ bcud len gyi dngul chu la btso bkru chen mo byas na rab/ de min kyang dug med par byed pa'i thabs kyi dam pa/ kā ma de ba'i mar ni/ a ru gser mdog 'bring ba gnyis/ dzā ti bzang po gcig /mu zi gser 'dra zho gang*/ ldong ros zho phyed bsags li shi bzang po zho phyed rnams bsags la/ dzā li gnyis rtsam pa rtsing po tsam du btags/ gzhan rnams zhib par btags/ de kun bsres nas dar dkar dri med zhing du sor bcu/ kyus mtho do yod pa la 'bri mar srang gcig mar khu btsag bcad grung po bya/ dbyar dus yin na mar khu'i bzhi cha tsam nang sman phye btab ste ras de'i phyi nang kun tu khyab par byugs/ rtse nas skam pas bzung la gsham nas me sbar mar lhag rim pas bsnan/

'og tu chu sder gang bzed de zhun thig gang bab bsags/ dgun dus yin na mar khu la ras de drangs nas mthil du sman phye mnyam la khyab pa'i tshul gyis legs par bkram/ slar yang mar byugs sman bkram rim pas sman dang mar khu rdzogs par bya'o// sna nas bsgril ba me sbar ba sogs gong ltar bya'o// zhun mar chu nang bab pa blangs nas ga bur thun gcig btab nas 'dres par sbyang bas mig la byugs la dngul dug srung*/ mar de rwa'am shing gi spar bur tshag bya/ dgos dus dngul chu thig pa re la ka ma de mar nyis 'gyur bsres la 'dres par mnye/ 'di kho nas dug med cing*/ gnyan nad gag lhog gzer gsum 'joms/ dug rigs thams cad dang khyad par dngul chu la sbyar ba'i dug khong du song phral mar de theb tshig tsam btang na mod la grol nus/ gzhan lugs kyi dngul chu dug bton zin rnams ka ma de mar dang sbyar nas bsten na bcud len gyi mchog tu 'gyur/ mig sogs dbang por mi gnod pa mar 'dis nus/ dngul chu dang mar de sbyar ba gnyan skrangs la byugs na gnyan gsod cing skrangs pa rnag tu 'gyur bar byed/ mdze la byug na mdze thub/ gzhan yang lus kyi phyi yi srin bu srung ba sogs yon tan ches mang ste 'di ni yid bzhin nor bu lta bu'i gdams pa'o/ ༈ /gnyen dang srin sogs gsod pa'i skabs su dngul chu star bus bshig pa zhes pa/ dngul zho gang*/ star zhun zho do'i nang du blugs la/ oṃ bha ra bha ra hiḥ bha ra kro dhī kā liḥ dngul ngar sodaḥ mtshal ngar sodaḥ dngul dug yal yalaḥ nyal nyal swā hāḥ zhes bzlas pa'i sngags mchil gyis mnye zhing 'dres par bya/ yang na ba chus mnye la sngags mchil lam sngags btab ste 'dres par byas pa ni dngul chu star bus bshig pa zhes bya'o/ ༈ /mar khu'i rigs ni steng gi bsreg rdza bya sgong dbyibs can du rdzas gang yin bcug par rdza smyug sbub kyi bar khrig 'dra ba bu ga mang ba can/

bzed rdza bsreg rdza 'dra ba dong du sba/ bar mtshams 'dag pas 'char/ steng rdza'i rgyab nas me 'bud pa spyi'i lag len no// bye brag mar khu rigs bcu gnyis bshad/ dri chen skam po dri chu sogs bran pa bsregs pa'i zhun bab bdud rtsi mar khu/ phug ron/ khyim bya mchil pa sogs kyi brun zhun bab bya yi mar khu/ ri phyugs lci ba las phyugs kyi mar khu 'om bu'i rtsa ba las shing sna'i mar khu sogs so// tsandan dkar dmar sug dmar sogs phab tsandan mar khu/ seng ldeng gi de bzhin shug shing ngam shugs lo rlon pa las shug pa'i mar khu bya'o// rus sna'i mar khu rnams kyis zha rengs dang rtsa dang lpags nad za phrug byung ba sogs sel ba'i nus pa so sor yod do/ ༈ /thar nu ni ri gzer pa 'bol byang bltas mthong ba sum ldan na ston dus brko rtsa ba sbom pa dang 'dzer lag rtsub pa can spang*/ rtsa ba phra zhing rkang gcig 'jam la ring ba/ bzang zhing rtsa ba ma snad zho ma bo gting thon brko dgos/ sa dregs chus bkrus nas rkang phyi lpags 'dor dgos/ thar nu dum bur gshag la gtub/ 'dul thabs bdun yod/ 'o mar btsos pa 'jam 'dul bad kan can la bsngags/ rno 'dul chang du btsos pa skran la bsngags/ bzang 'dul chang la sha chen btab bcos dug dang gag lhog la bsngags/ drag 'dul dge slong ngam lo brgyad chur btsos srin dang gnyan la bsngags/ myur 'dul ba chur btsos pa mdze dang dreg grum chu ser rkang 'bam sbyong*/ ngar 'dul ra sha yi khu bar btsos pa dug dang pho long srin la bsngags/ rgyas 'dul a ru'i khu bar btsos pa khrag mkhris 'dus nad sel/ de bdun po gang la'ang dug sel len ra sha dum gcig 'phen cing*/ 'tshod byed khu ba 'tshod bya'i brgyad 'gyur gyi chur ma tshig ma mkhregs par 'dul zhing khu ba phyed skam dus/ ra sha bton la sa 'og sba zhing srog chags kyi khar mi 'gro bar bya/ khu ba thag la rang thim bya zhing skam nas gang la yang rno 'jam myur ro// 'dul bdun cha mnyam ldan par kha bsgyur sman sbyar sbyor rung gzhan sman rigs 'dul thabs gzhung ltararo/

༈ /sman nag skabs/ thal sman lnga po dus gcig bsreg na/ sla nga che ba'i phyogs bzhi dbus lngar phag brun sogs sman lnga so sor bzhag pa'i steng du rdza phor lngas bkab la bar mtshams rnams tshwa 'dam gyis bkab/ de srid pa'i bye ma'am mi thub pa'i 'dam gyis g.yogs/ rlon pa de gar thab la btsugs nas me bus/ mthil dmar po dang skya har song nas phog la grang bcug /'dag zhal rnams dal bus bsil/ bsregs thal blangs nus bsregs mgyogs khyad dgos rigs de ltar bya chog ༈ reg dug sogs kyi bsregs sman rnams gzhan du gsal/ ༈ khaṇḍa dgos rigs la/ rtsa ba lo sdong gang yang sa dreg rdul sogs kyis ma gos par bkru/ phrum phrum brdung la chu gtsang nang du btsos nas khu ba thon nges dus snod gtsang mar tshags su btsag la bskol/ skya bas bar med du dkrugs shing*/ skyo ma sbu can du song skabs rdo 'khyag steng thig cig blugs pas ril bu dril gtub na phog /mtha' yi dreg pa rnams mi gtong*/ gzhan rnams grod pu sogs su blugs nas tshags bya'o/ ༈ /gi waṃ tshab/ deng skabs sa gi zhes pa na khron las byung pa'i ser po gtib pa lcags 'od byung ba de dang brag zhun gyi khaṇḍa/ 'dam skyes lug ru ser po sogs gar bder bya'o// yang na tshad ldan man ngag zur mkhar pa'i bzhed pa'i gi bzo ni/ gong bshad kyi sa gi ser po 500 la lug ru ser po/ brag zhun khaṇḍa/ gur gum dang skyer pa'i khaṇḍa bcas zhib par btags la/ glang bre dmar mig dmar gyis mkhris pa/ yang na mi dom gnyis kyi gtsos mkhris sna tshogs tshad bsags te sbrus la bsil skam bgyis pas rims tshad mchin dug dang rtsa kha bsdam pa sogs gi waṃ dngos dang mtshungs par som nyi bral ba'o// gi waṃ sngon bzo ltar na/ sa gi bzang po rdo las byung ba'i ci mang la gzhi byas te kha che dang*/ ma rnyed na gur gum gang rung*/ gser me/ skyer pa'i khaṇḍa/ sum tig de rnams khu ba legs par bton la tshags su drang*/

gong gi sa gi sa rdo ma 'dres pa zhib btags rnams bsres nas/ glang chen mkhris pa rnyed na bzang*/ ma rnyed na ba dang glang thug mkhris pa ran tsam btab nas legs par dkrugs/ me 'jam du dal skam byas pas/ gi waṃ gi nus pa dang ldan pa de kho bo cag gi lag len ma'o// man ngag kun gyis shes na mkhas pa gang na yod pa'i dpe bzhin nyar tshags dam par bya'o// / ༈ dpyad lnga'i nang tshan gtar ga brdeg thabs ni/ gtar rung ba'i nad gzhi/ 'gram 'khrugs/ rims/ skrangs pa/ rma dang*/ dreg nad/ surya/ me dbal/ chu ser la sogs/ tsha ba khrag mkhris las gyur pa'i nad rnams la gtar rung*/ mi rung ba'i nad gzhi ni/ gdon can/ zung zad/ sbrum ma/ skya rbab gcong can me drod nyams pa sogs mdor na bad rlung grang ba las gyur pa'i nad la gtar mi rung*/ 'on kyang ngan khrag zung khrag ma bye ba dang*/ rims ma smin pa dang*/ stong tshad dang*/ dug ma sod pa gnyan tshad/ lus zungs zad pa rnams ni tsha ba las gyur pa yin yang gtar mi rung*/ bad rlung dang khrag mkhris bsdong na gtar/ khrag rlung shed che na gtar nas lus zungs gso/ de nas sngon 'gro zhag gsum gong nas dbye thang gtong*/ nad khrag 'byed pa la 'bras bu gsum thang*/ rlung tshad 'byed pa la sle tres/ bad khrag 'byed pa sle tres ma nu/ 'thab dang 'dus nad 'byed pa la skyu ru ra/ khrag mkhris 'byed pa la ba le ka sle tres/ nad khrag rtsar drang pa la pi pi ling*/ myur du smin byed sle tres thang gtong*/ thang ma btang bar zungs khrag 'chor/ nad khrag mi thon zungs 'dzad nad ro lus gsungs pa ltar gal che/ de ltar gong du song nas da ni gtar dmigs nyung bsdus bstan pa ni/ mgo'i spyi gtsug ma yo ba nas tshon gsum gzhal ba sdud sgo zer mdun gyi skra mtshams nas gyen du sor bzhi bcal ba na mtshogs gsang zhes bya ste bad mkhris 'dom pa'i rtsa yin/ ltag zur g.yas g.yon gnyis nas mar la 'phar rtsa zug pa ni/

ltag rtsa nag po yin pa mkhal rtsa yin/ za 'gram g.yas g.yon gnyis na 'phred kyi 'khyugs rtsa 'phar ba gnyis bad kan gyi rtsa ring zhes bya ste bad mkhris 'dom rtsa yin/ mig zur g.yas g.yon gnyis nas gyen du rgyu ba'i rtsa ni mig rtsa 'greng bu zhes mchin rtsa yin/ dpral ba'i dkyil drang por gyen du rgyu ba'i rtsa ni dung rtsa zhes glo rtsa yin/ mig gi nang zur khug gnyis na mig gi rtse chung gnyis re mchin rtsa'o// de khug par bong ba'i rna rtse'ang mchin rtsa'o// sna phug gnyis kyi phugs su rngul rtsa nag po zhes don snod thams cad 'dus pa'i rtsa'o// lce rtsa ni mchin rtsa'o// ma mchu'i 'phar rtsa ni mtsher rtsa'o// 'gram pa'i zur nas 'phar ba'i rtsa ni snying rtsa'o// rtse'u chung ni glo rtsa'o// de las gyes pa'i rtsa ni rtse nag zhes glo rtsa'o// rtse'u chung gi mdun ngos nas mar rgyu ba'i rtsa ni rtse 'dra zhes snying rtsa yin/ ol gong gi steng nas mar rgyu ba'i snying rtsa me ru yin/ de nas lag pa'i rtsa la/ dpung pa'i snying steng nas mar la rgyu ba ni dpung rtsa zhes glo rtsa/ gru mo'i nang zur nas sor bzhi yar la bcal ba gru mgo mchin rtsa yin/ lag pa'i khug zur na snod ka zhes bya/ a so li ka zhes kyang bya ste pho ba'i rtsa yin/ khug drang po na snying gi a so li ka zhes bya/ kha cig glo snying 'dom rtsa'ang zer khug gi mar zur na glo ba'i a so li ka zhes glo ba'i rtsa yin/ snod ka zhabs kyi 'dom rtsa kha brag tu gnas te bad mkhris kyi 'dom rtsa'o// mchin rtsa las nang du gnas pa ni mkhris pa'i gser mdung ste/ mkhris rtsa yin gru mo'i gyen sor bzhi gzhal mtshams mchin pa'i ru thung zhes bya ste mchin spang chen mo'i rtsa yin/ de nas yar sor bzhi bcal ba na sha ru mon ru zhes bya ste spang chung dang gra lce 'dom pa'i rtsa yin/ de nas sor bzhi na phran bu zhes dgra lce'i rtsa yin/

mkhrig ma'i rgyab tshig thog la nye ba ni rgyab rtsa drug 'dus zhes bya/ theb chen zhabs nas 'phar rtsa sor bzhi bcal ba na skyor gong zhes glo bu'i rtsa yin/ de nas sor bzhi na gong rtsa zhes glo stod bu la nye ba'i rtsa yin/ de nas sor bzhi na sgang rtsa zhes rgyab phyogs glo mar nye ba'i rtsa yin/ de nas lag pa'i rgyab nas mar gyes pa ni/ glo ma'i rtsa yin/ lag pa'i thal gong gung mo'i steng nas mchin pa pho dong gi rtsa'o// mtheb chen gyi steng nas yar song ba mtheb skyor zhes glo bu'i rtsa'o// skad 'gags sel/ mdzub mo'i steng nas zur la song ba ni mdzub skyor zhes glo bu'i rtsa'o// skad la phan/ gung mo'i steng nas zur la song ba ni srin skyor zhes pho mtsher rtsa yin/ mthe'u chung steng nas zur la song ba ni mthe'u chung skyor zhes mkhal rtsa yin/ de nas rkang pa'i gtar rtsa bstan pa ni/ dpung tshigs nang zur mtho gang gyen la bcal ba'i nang man chod/ chag gang gyen la bcal ba na yan chod kyi bar gyi rtsa bo che'i gdab pa snod kun gyi rtsa'o// lham sgrog 'ching ba'i rtsa'ang snod kun gyi rtsa'o// de nas gyen nas ngar gdong nag po zhes bya ste mkhal ma'i gzhi che ba'i rtsa'o// long bu'i nang log gi rtsa ni long bu dpyang zhes long rtsa yin/ sgab khung byin pa'i steng nas mar rtsa gsum yod pa ni sgab rtsa nag po smad gsum zhes bya/ de'i dbus ma'i lham sgrog 'ching ba'i 'go byin snying gi mchin rtsa yin/ rting pa'i dreg mtshams nas gyen la mdzub gang bcal ba na byin mjug ces bya ste mkhal rtsa yin/ long bu'i phyi log nas tshur la 'khyud pa ni long bu'i phyi gra zhes mkhal rtsa yin/ bol gyi yob gong na mar rgyug pa ni yob gong zhes mkhal rtsa yin/ bol gong nas 'phred la rgyug pa ni bal gyi rtsa 'phred thag pa 'dra/ zhes de'ang mkhal rtsa'o/ rkang pa'i rgyu ma'i nang du bkug na rgyu ma kong du gnyer ma gsum 'byung ste/

gnyer ma dbus ma'i 'go ru rgyu ma khung gi rtsa nag ces bya ste mchin pa'i rtsa yin/ gdab thabs gnyis lag len ni thog mar pags pa dang*/ de nas rtsar gdab pa'o// mdzo sna ni lag pas dgag ste 'phred du thal mar phug nas rma kha nas khrag dbyung ngo*// mdung thabs ni/ g.yon gyi rtsa bgags la lag g.yas kyis mdung thabs su brgyab la gshog /dol chod ni gtsag bu bsnyal te mdzo sna bzhin tal gyis btang la so gyen la bstan te bcad pa'am/ rtsa phran lta bu 'drud nas bcad pa'o// glo phug ni g.yas g.yon phug pa'o// pho ba'i gong a so li ka 'phar rtsa yod pas ma bsnyal gong du thad la gdab/ gru mgo la'ang snying rtsa gdab/ gru mgo la'ang snying rtsa gzab/ glo ba'i skyor gong la gshongs gshongs por blta rtsa yod pas gzab/ pho gdung la gung srin bar na rmen bu'i gnad la gzab/ yob gong la snying rtsa yod pas gzab/ sgab rtsa'i skabs byin snying la gzab/ mig rtsa 'greng bu ni skra mtshams su stod la gdab/ de dmas na mig ce re long du 'gro bas gzab/ snying rtsa mo ru la gnyis len byas te pags pa phral/ rtsa mngon pa dang rgya khab bkug pas rtsa yar bslang la mdung thabs kyis bkal la gdab bo// rgyu ma khug gi rtsa nag la gtsag bur sor gcig gting du brgyab la khrag nag po bton la me btsas bsreg go /de ltar gtar dmigs mdor bsdus las gzhan rnams gzhung la gsal ba ltos/ ༈ dpyad lnga yi nang tshan gnyis pa me btsa' ni/ me gdab rung ba'i nad gzhi ni/ ma zhu ba/ me drod nyams pa/ skya rbab/ dmu skran/ grang mkhris sogs mgo nad dang*/ yan lag sogs chu ser gyi nad/ 'bras lhog /stong tshad/ smyo byed/ brjed byed/ rtsa nad sogs/ tsha rjes phal cher la gdab dgos/ mdor na bad rlung las gyur pa'i grang ba dang*/ rtsa nad chu ser rnams bsreg dgos te/ 'on kyang gnyan nad 'dzum bu ltag dgye dang*/ mkhris pa rtsar rgyug nad la 'bros 'phrang bsdam pa sogs tsha ba yin yang mes bsregs pa gnad yin no// me gdab mi rung ba'i nad gzhi ni/

mkhris tshad/ khrag nad thams cad dang*/ dbang po rnams kyi sgo dang*/ pho mo'i srid rtsa rnams su me gdab pa spang bar bya'o// de yang me dmigs la yang gnyis te/ nad kyis tshur bstan pa dang*/ sman pas phar btsal ba'o// nad kyis tshur bstan pa ni/ rkang lag tshigs dmigs sogs gzer mig gang yod pa dang*/ mnan na phan snyam byed pa dang*/ mtheb rjes 'ong ba/ rtsa 'khyug pa dang*/ rtsa nad gar langs na de'i dmigs su gdab par bya'o// sman pas phar btsal ba don snod rnams kyi gsang yin kyang*/ spyi rnams gzhung rnams su gsal bas ma smos/ 'dir nyung bsdus la tshigs pa drug pa'i phan tshun sor bzhi re gzhal par rtsa hreng yod pa de'i nang ldeb la me btsa' bzhag pas khrag rlung gi mgo bo na ba dang rtsa dkar la phan/ bco brgyad pa'i g.yas g.yon du sor gsum re gzhal ba dang*/ bco brgyad pa rang sto kha gsum du bzhag pas/ rlung grang ba/ sked pa na ba/ mkhal rtsa bral ba rnams la phan/ tshigs pa lnga pa/ drug pa/ bdun pa gsum/ mdun gyi dkar nag mtshams su me btsa' re bzhag pas khrag mkhris/ brang tsha ba dang*/ stod na ba sogs la phan/ stod 'tshangs la de steng sgo stong tsa ra khung du'ang gcig bzhag pas phan/ lhen rtse dbus su bzhag nas rgya gram sor gsum bsregs pas mkhris pa bad kan mchin skran rlung rnams la phan/ me mnyam gsang gi g.yas g.yon tshon rer tshugs re bzhag pas khrag rlung dang khrag skran la phan/ pus mor tshigs chu 'khor na me long ru bzhir tshugs re bzhag pa khrag rlung dang chu ser sogs sel zhing brkyang bskum mi thub pa la phan/ zhes sogs cha tshang gzhung la gzigs/ yang gal che mgo yi gsang gi lag len ni/ rus klad sha lpags rtsa yi gnas tshul bshad// blo dman don du lag len mdor bsdus tsam// zhal khrid lag len nyams su blangs pa ni// lpags rgya bzhi dang rgya rtsa bzhi// rus rgya bzhi dang ri chu gnyis// bya rog mig gnyis mig gsang gnyis// sdud sgo phyi nang rnam pa bzhi// phyi nang bad rlung gsang rnams bcas// dpral ba ltag pa srad bus thig gis bskor// sdud sgo dpral ba'i bar der gzhung thig gdab// gtsugs nas rna gong g.yas g.yon phrad thig gdab// gtsug gi rgya gram tshangs pa'i bu ga zhes// dpral thig rna gong skor thig 'dzoms pa'i sa// 'di dag shin tu gnyan pa'i sgo bzhi yin// lpags rgya bzhi yang 'di la zer ba yin// ltag pa'i chu ba'i zur nas rna bug thad// tshon re bcal ba phyi yi ljon shing dang*// rna ba nang du tshon gang nang ljon shing*// rtsa rgya bzhi zhes zer ba ljon shing bzhi// mtshog gsang g.yas g.yon tshon re bya rog mig

/de nas gyen du tshon gang mig gsang yin// gtsug nas ltag par sor bzhi re chu phyi// de nas thur la tshon gang re chu nang*// mig gsang gnyis nas phyi la tshon re dang*// re chu phyi nas phyi la tshon re ni// 'di la rus rgya bzhi zhes zer ba yin// sdud sgo g.yas g.yon tshon re sdud sgo'i nang*// de nas g.yas g.yon tshon re sdud sgo'i phyi// gtsug nas mtshogs ma'i bar der srang ba'i tshad// bkug pa phyed cha sleb pa bad rlung gsang*// gtsug nas ltag pa de bzhin bad rlung gsang*// rlung gi mgo 'khor 'gyel bub nad la gdab// 'di gsum bad rlung mgo 'khor nad la gdab// sdud sgo nang nas phun gang phyi nang mtshams// 'di gnyis bad rlung gsang du bshad pa yin// phun ni tshon phyed don la sor gcig yin// gtsug nas mdun rgyab g.yas g.yon tshon re'i sa// shin tu gnyen pa'i rtsa ni re thag bzhi// 'di bzhi rus pa'i srub ni yin par bshad// sdud sgo gsum ni ltag pa spyi bo 'tshogs ma gsum// bzhi ni rna gong gnyis dang ltag pa mtshogs ma bzhi// 'di rnams shin tu gnyan pas rdo dbyug phog mi rung ngo*/ ༈ /sman mar skabs/ dang po 'ba' sam sman mar bkol tshul ni/ a ru ra zho sum cu/ ba ru ra zho nyi shu/ skyu ru zho bcu bcas/ rtsa ba lnga re re a ru ra dang mnyam bkyag dgos/ sram sha ci snyed dang*/ sbal gtsang sha ci rigs sbyar ba chur bkol la khu ba bsags/ phye mar a gar so lnga sogs gang 'phrod rigs pas dpyad/ chu bre gsum/ 'o ma bre gsum/ chu bcud 'o mar/ 'o bcud mar la gdus zhes so// gong gi sman 'bras bu gsum dang*/ rtsa ba lnga dang*/ phye ma rnams mnyam du bsres par/ sman zho gcig lta bu la/ mar zho bcu drug 'gyur zhes thugs rigs dpyad dgos/ kha tshar gang 'phrod gzhung dang bstun/ 'brong lugs so// yang sman mar bkol tshul mi pham phyag rgyun ni/ dang po sman mar bkol ba'i gzhi sman rnams gtsang mar bsdu/

de'i rtsa ba'i sman rnams phram phrum brdung nas 'bru tsam bya/ snod la gzhal te/ de yang dkar phor gang lta bu la mtshon na/ lan gsum bzhi bar khu ba lon nges su yang yang snod rdza ma lta bu g.ya' rgyu med pa zhig tu khu ba bton pa der bsags/ de ltar bzhur ba'i snyigs ma ro bro ba med pa zhig byung na sman ro dor/ sman khu bsags rgyu de snga ma'i gzhal phor de'i gsum las mi mang bar thag bcug par dkar phor gsum du nges par bya/ de yang dang po dkar phor gsum bkol snod du gzhal/ de la thur mas tshad nas sman khu slebs mtshams su ri mo bya/ de nas ri mo'i mtshams la ma thug bar bcug pas tshod shes sla/ de'i nang 'o ma bskol ba 'o rlon bzhos dron tshe/ dkar phor brgyad blugs gsungs kyang*/ 'o ma rul 'gro bas 'o ma chur bsres la dang po zho lta bur ma red bar du thag bcug /'o sman gnyis lhan du bsres la/ thun tshad gzhal ba'i phyed tsam ma thug bar du/ bskol tshe dkrugs brad bar ma chad par bya/ 'o sman bkol thag de la/ zur du mar rnying pa ma rul ba'i rgyu legs par mar khu btsag thag chod pa ma tshig pa/ gong gi dkar phor de'i brgyad tsha mer blugs nas me dal bus gnyug bsrings ste chu tshod bar du dwangs snyigs phye nas/ snyigs ma mdzub mo'i dril gtub cing mar khu mer btab na tshag sgra med pa dang*/ mdzub mo cung tsha zhing*/ ma tshigs par byug na/ phog nas khol zhi ba dang*/ snyigs ma dor/ dwangs ma rdza snod gzhan du bzhur nas bzhag /de'i mtha' nas skag shom gyi/ skya shar chags dus/ kha tshar gyi sman phyed zhib btags tshags la/ rtsa ba'i sman bre brgyad la/ kha tshar gyi sman bre phyed re'i tshad tsam du btab pa ste/ 'dir rtsa ba'i sman dkar phor gang la cha bcu drug bgos pa'i cha gcig gi tshod tsam btab/ mar khu bre gang la/ sman rta bu ram lug ril tsam khrob brdung byas pa/ sman mar khu ba dkar yol gang la bur gor bzhi cha tsam blos dpyad pa dang*/

ka ra sbrang rnams gang 'os nad khams dang gzhung la bstun nas btag ste cung zad dkrugs la skag bcug /mi pham rin po ches/ mar khu dkrugs mi thub par ma gyur bar/ rgyun chad med par dkrugs dgos gsungs/ yun ring nas lbu sob 'byung zhing dkar 'jam kha ba bsgongs pa lta bu yong ba de sman mar gyi lag len rnams yin gsungs/ bsten dus kyang dbyar la mi 'phrod/ ston rgyab dgun kha sogs legs zhes gsungs so/ ༈ /rgyun du nyer mkho'i sman sbyor la/ a gar brgyad pa/ a gar bco lnga/ a gar so lnga/ 'brong tshal ar brgyad/ sems kyi bde skyid/ ko byi bdun pa/ ko byi bcu gsum/ ge sar nyer lnga/ tig ta brgyad pa/ gi waṃ dgu pa/ mkhris las rnam rgyal/ mkhris phye bdun pa/ brag zhun dgu pa/ gser mdog lnga pa/ padma 'dab brgyad/ tsandan bco brgyad/ sga lo/ thang chen nyer lnga/ ༈ bdud rtsi sum sbyor/ cong zhi dgu pa/ cong zhi cur nis/ zhi byed drug pa/ bde byed snyoms ldan/ ru rta drug pa/ g.yu dril bcu gsum/ dpa' bo nyer lnga/ 'phrul thal/ se 'bru nyi shu/ ril dkar/ skyu ru nyer lnga/ zla shel/ man bsil/ ko la bco lnga/ nor bu bdun thang*/ gtso brgyad/ sprin zla/ gtso khyung*/ khyung sngon dgu pa/ spang rtsi bcu gsum/ sleb chog /sman nag /spru nag so gnyis/ brag khyung*/ sngo ril/ rta zi dmar po/ rgyal blon bcu bdun/ rnam rgyal dgu pa/ ༈ a bhi drug thang*/ 'bol sman bdun pa/ dwa li bcu drug /bde byed 'bring po/ chu rtsi nyer lnga/ kun phan/ glang chen chu bsgyur/ chu 'dren/ bong dkar bcu pa/ lcags phye bco lnga/ ༈ spos ring*/ lug mur bdun pa/ 'khrugs glo kun sel/ spang rgyan bco lnga/ gtso bo nyer lnga/ spang rgyan nyer lnga/ ga bur nyer lnga/ tsandan bco lnga/ cu gang nyer lnga/ blon po sum sbyor/ gur gum bcu gsum/ gur gum mchog bdun/ ko la bcu dgu/ a ru bcu pa/ a ru nyi shu/ a ru nyer lnga/ go yu dgu sbyor/

sar khyung*/ nyi zla gyen ldog /nyi dkyil/ rtsa thag bcu drug /spyi 'joms/ phan pa kun ldan/ be khrag nyer lnga/ se 'bru dgu pa/ rdo thal nyer lnga/ ༈ mgo thang bcu gsum/ gser mdog bcu gcig /tsa rtsi rdo sbyor/ tshangs pa dbugs sel srin bdug /gar khyung*/ ༈ khyung lnga/ spos dkar bcu pa/ spos khyung*/ bong khrag nyer lnga/ seng ldeng nyer lnga/ chos nyid dgu pa/ gser thang bco brgyad/ klu bdud bco brgyad/ bsam 'phel nor bu/ da li bcu drug /ra mye bcu gsum/ star bu bcu dgu/ rgya ru bcu bzhi/ smyug rtsi nyer lnga/ rin chen pha lam/ ser mo bcu gsum pa/ 'dab chags bzhi pa/ ༈ rma sman/ mgo sman gsum pa/ rtsa dkar byugs pa/ 'gyur byugs/ stab seng 'bam sbyar/ reg sman/ bor byugs gnyan 'byar/ rlung byugs/ gdon byugs nyer lnga/ gdon bdug nyer lnga/ rdzas srung nyer lnga/ rta dug sman/ ༈ oṃ āḥtha/ 'dir nyer mkho'i sman btu dgos rigs la zla ba gsum pa'i nang*/ bdud rtsi lo ma bya ma grags gong btus pa/ kham bu'i me tog chu sman skor la/ puṣpa/ a lakta/ ni li/ mdog can gnyis bya ma grags gong*/ mdangs med pri yang ku/ sga tig /lha lung*/ chab 'dren byi ru'i phreng ldan rnams nyi ma ma ldog gong*/ gzhan yang rtag ngu*/ srad dkar/ chu ma rtsi/ sngo spyi bzhur/ rkyal ba chu thub sogs/ zla ba bzhi pa'i nang*/ se rgod bar shun/ skyer shun/ kaṇḍa ka ri/ da lis/ 'om bu'i lo ma sogs/ zla ba lnga pa'i nang*/ rims de wa/ dug nyung lo ma/ 'dzim pa/ ba sha ka pri yang ku/ parpa ta/ snyag lo/ rkyang shog /'di skyugs sman tshe kha 'bus dgos/ 'dam bu ka ra/ dbyi mong*/ sur dkar/ re lcags me tog /se ba'i me tog /stong zil/ rtsa mkhris/ 'bu su haṃ/ ༈ zla drug pa'i nang*/ spang tsi/ lcags tig /bya rgod spos/ srol gong pa/ utpal/ bong dkar/ g.ya' kyi ma/ lug ru ser po/ smug po/ lcags kyu/ ser can/ brag lcam/ bre dgu/ 'jam dbyangs rtag ngu'i rtsa lo/ ra dug me tog

/a krong*/ lug mig /byi tsher/ mtsher ldum/ zangs rtsi/ a bi ṣa/ mdel 'byin/ rta lpags/ khrag gcod sog le kha/ mdzo mo shing*/ gur tig /klu bdud rdo rje/ tsher sngon/ 'bu su hang*/ rtsa a wa/ phur mong lo ma rgyas dus khaṇḍa/ glang sna dmar po/ zla ba bdun pa'i nang*/ hong len/ kyi lce/ sum tig /gzer 'joms/ 'ug lag nag /ming can rtsa lo/ tang kun/ shug tsher/ bye'u la phug /sro lo dkar po'i rtsa lo/ sardzi ka pha ba dgo go /zla ba bdun pa'i mjug tsam du/ 'ol mo se/ spang rgyan dkar po/ sngon po/ lug sho/ nad ma 'byar ma/ sgang thog /skyi ba/ lcam pa/ go snyod/ phang ma/ byi rug /bre ga rnams kyi 'bras bu/ tshar bong*/ spa yag rtsa lo/ ug chos rtsa 'bras/ thang phrom nag po/ dres 'bru/ dwa ba/ re ral rtsa ba/ ha lo rtsa lo/ gla sgang rtsa lo/ bong nga dmar ser rtsa lo/ zla ba brgyad pa'i mjug dang dgu pa'i mgo la/ lug mur/ ga dur/ ru rta/ lca ba/ ra mye/ nye shing*/ myang rtsi spras/ khur rtsa/ chur rtsa/ lcum rtsa/ shwa rtsa/ snya lo'i rtsa ba/ chu ma rtsi/ dbang lag /bong nga dmar ser gsum/ spang spos/ star khan/ sro lo/ dmar po/ spru nag /re lcags/ spang rtsi/ khrom bu rnams kyi rtsa ba kho na'o// zla ba dgu pa'i nang thar nu mthong ba sum ldan gyi rtsa ba gal che'o// gzhan yang btsal dgos rigs la/ cong zhi/ cu gang*/ go thal/ brag zhun/ thang khrag /smyug rtsi/ ze tshwa/ spang tshan dmar po/ mtshur ser nag /rdo rgyus/ rdo dreg /ha shig /char nyung*/ rtsa rma bya/ chu sbal sngon po/ gri sha/ gri snying*/ gri khrag /gri tshil/ gri rus/ ri bong snying*/ wa glo/ spyang lce/ sbrul sha/ rgod dang go bo'i gre ba/ spyang ki'i pho ba sogs/ ༈ lha lung khug tu rtse skya ral pa can/ ༈ 'dzing du ba spu/ 'brug rus/ mu zi ser/ ༈ hor smad phyogs su/ ma nu/ 'u su/ yungs dkar/ be khrag /'bru shing shun pa/ 'bras bu/ gze ma/ 'bri rta sa 'dzin/ g.yer ma/ sgog skya/ seng ldeng*/ sbrang rtsi/ ha bo/ re ral/ stab seng*/

yu gu shing khaṇḍa/ lcang ra las ming can nag po/ lang thang rtse/ phur nag /rab brtan du/ gser me/ wa ral/ sga tig /gaṅgā chung*/ ༈ lho khog nas/ rgyam bye/ stag sha /gang thang phrom sogs dang*/ mu zi nag po/ rdo sman sbal rgyab/ mdung rtse dkar smug /khab len/ pha bong long bu/ ༈ 'bri spo bo/ cong zhi dmar po dang*/ mtshal rdo/ ༈ rdza rgyud nas/ 'brong snying*/ 'brong khrag /gtsod khrag /rtsi dmar rkang gcig /shing mngar/ zi ling nas 'byung*/ ༈ chab mdo nas/ ba bla/ ldong ros/ rgun 'brum/ bse yab/ se 'bru/ me tog /ha lo/ ram sogs dang*/ skag zhun kyang yod/ ༈ dar mdo hor sogs nas/ sga skya/ pho ril/ gsha' dkar nag /dngul chu/ mtshal/ su ru pañtsa/ dom mkhris/ 'bri mog /phag brun/ phag khrag /phag tshil/ ༈ byugs pa rgyan 'khor nang rdzas 'dzom dka' gras/ khyi rgya bo'i tshil/ bya rgod tshil/ dri chen/ rma bya'i mdangs/ rgya spos/ brag spos/ gser dngul zangs lcags/ gsha'/ 'khar/ khro/ mu tig /byi ru/ mu men/ sbur len/ g.yu/ dung mgron shel sogs/ bdug pa rgyan 'khor nang*/ nya mkhris/ rta bon/ khyi rgya bo mig bzhi'i snying spu/ 'dog pa rgyan 'khor nang*/ gla ba/ sran ma/ mkhan dmar zo she 'ug pa dang ra mig /bya rgod mig /ke shing*/ lcags shang phye ma/ rbab rdo/ dur rdo/ thog rdo/ thog shing*/ thog rus/ gri lcags/ sbrul dang sre mo'i pags pa bcas so// gso bya gso tshul ma log gnad 'bebs pa'i// rnam dpyod blo dang rtag tu mi 'bral shog /bdag kyang ma 'ongs skye ba'i phreng ba kun// dam pa'i rten thob gzhan phan rtse gcig tu// bsgrub la snying stobs nus pa phul phyin te// rgyal sras spyod pa pha mthar son par shog /rje btsun g.yu thog byang zur sngon byon dang*// phyis byon mkhas pa sde srid del dmar dang*// mi pham mkhyen nor rnams kyi phyag len nas// rang gi lag len nyams myong bdud rtsi ni// khung dag bum bzang phan thog che ba rnams// nor 'khrul med par phyogs gcig 'di na bkod/// /

ces gangs gze sman pa kun dga' tshe dbang gis sman pa gsar bu rnams la phan pa'i blos shing glang zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes dgu 'phrod sbyor me gnyis nyin dbu brtsams te/ zla ba dgu pa'i tshes bcu dgu 'phrod sbyor me rlung nyin legs par grub pa don ldan du gyur cig// / ༄༅// gso rig rgya mtsho lta bu'i nang nas nyams myong nges rnyed chu thigs lon pa bdud rtsi'i bum bzang bzhugs so// ༄༅// dus gsum rgyal ba'i thugs rje las// baiḍūrya zhes grags 'bar ba'i// gzhan phan phrin las gdugs dkar pos// sa gsum dge mdzad mgon de rgyal// dpal stug kun gyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje// gsang gsum za ma tog tu yongs bsti ba'i// sangs rgyas rnam thar gtsang ma'i phrin las kyis// 'gro ba smin mdzad sman gyi bla mar 'dud// bskal mang goms pa'i thugs bskyed smon lam las// mkhyen brtse'i gzi byin 'bar ba'i 'od rlabs kyis// gso rig nyin mo'i snang ba 'byed mdzad pa// yon tan mgon po'i bka' drin srid 'dir lhag /rgyu 'bras zug rngus mnar ba'i nyams thag 'gro// phan pas skyongs la mi skyo'i snying stobs can// 'phags bod gnyis su dngos brgyud drang srong gi /zhabs rdul tshe rabs spyi bo'i rgyan du mchod// sman gyi byin rlabs snod bcud dngos rdzas kun// bdud rtsi sman gyi rang bzhin 'ba' zhig pa'i// rnam grangs mchog dman khyad par dbye ba'i tshul// bzhed gzhung nyams med snying por bsdu la spro// skabs don ni/ de yang thog mar nyes gsum gso ba'i skor la/ dang po rlung nad kyi sman skor/ shing kun nyer lnga'i sbyor ba ni// shing kun sha chen li shi dzā ti dang*// shing tshwa sga pi pho dang gu gul gnyis// se 'bru sgog thal sug smel a ru'i mjug /bi ṣa go snyod a gar tshil chen dang*// ru rta ma nu sle tres rgya skyegs dang*// dri chen nus bsregs thal

shu dag rgyam tshwa bcas pa rnams// shing kun gtsor byas nyer lngas phyir rlung sel// sha chen gtsor byas nyer lngas nang rlung sel// li shi gtsor byas nyer lngas gsang rlung sel// 'don bzhi'i rta la bskyon nas tho rangs btang*// sha lpags rtsa rgyas zhugs pa phyi yi rlung*// don lnga snod drug la zhugs nang gi rlung*// srog rgyu 'dzin pa la sogs gsang ba'i rlung*// stod smad bar gsum zhugs pa'i rlung la sogs// rlung rigs sman sbyor gcig gis 'joms par byed// sman rgyal gnyis pa g.yu thog mgon po'i lugs// a gar so lnga'i sbyor ba ni// lci snum bsil ba'i a gar rigs gsum dang*// khyad par bsil la brtul ba'i tsan dan gnyis// 'du ba cha snyoms bzang drug 'bras bu gsum// sbyor ba 'di la rab tu gces pa'i gtso// blon 'bangs 'khor gyis bskor ba'i nyi shu gcig /ma nu 045 kanḍa ka ri 025 sle tres 075 dang*// tig ta 025 hong len 030 sga skya 015 ba sha ka 025 /gu gul dkar 035 nag 035 gla rtsi 010 ko byi la 035 // sha chen 015 'dzin pa 050 tsher sngon 045 snying zho sha 020 /nā ga ge sar 025 ru rta 020 a byag gnyis so sor 045 se 'bru 020 sro lo dkar po 030 ka ra sbyar/ sbyor ba 'di la a gar so lnga zhes// tshang zhing 'dus pa la tshad du sbyar ba'i phye// tshangs pa chen po'i tshe yi rigs byed las// rigs ldan drang srong zhal nas snyan khung brgyud// gong sman bla ma'i zhal lung bdud rtsi'i bcud// mi brjed snying la son pa'i 'tsho thabs las// glo skam theng po grum bu warta dang*// stod tshad smad grang stod smad go log dang*// bla gnyan 'thor nad gnyen po bcos mi len// ma smin stong tshad 'og 'grims rkun bu'i nad// gang la gang 'tshams rta yis bsgyur byas na// dman lhag log pa'i nad kun 'byung mi srid// gong bshad nad la theng pas chog pa yin/ a gar bco lnga ni// a ga ru dang dzā ti snying zho sha

/cu gang spos dkar ru rta a ru ra// nā ga ge sar ma nu bzhi thang dang*// tsandan dmar po ba ru skyu ru ra// sbyar bas sman mchog a gar bco lnga pa// 'gram 'khrugs smyo lkug nu mchin gzer ba sogs// khrag rlung stod 'tshang nad la thengs mchog yin// ko byi bdun pa/ ko byi sha pho ru rta a dkar nag /cu gang gur gum a ru gser mdog dang*// spos dkar ka ra sbyar ba'i ko byi bdun// ngan khrag stod du rgyas pa'i nad rigs dang*// dbugs 'thim dbugs 'dril nad chen stod brgyang dang*// 'gram 'khrugs rlung gis bus pa'i nad la bsngags// phyi rgyud a gar brgyad pa ni/ a ga ru nag po 200 dang dzā ti 010 snying zho sha 010 cu gang 010 spos dkar 010 ru rta 010 a ru ra 010 nā ga ge sar 010 ka ra sum sbyor sbyar/ a gar brgyad pas snying la mtshon phog dang*/ 'gram 'khrugs smyo lkug nu mchin gzer ba 'joms// snying nad cis kyang ma thub na// a gar rdo rje'i ri bo ni// a gar snying zho dzā ti cu gang gur li// 'bras gsum ma nu ru rta kha ru tshwa// shing kun gu gul sha chen tsan dan gnyis// gi waṃ hong len bong dkar stag sha dang*// gla rtsi re kon tsher sngon brag zhun dang*// ba sha sle tres sgang thog 'dzin pa rnams// gtso bo cha bskyed gi waṃ yan mang zhing*/ de man chu nyung sbyor ba tshad ldan sman chen dang dngul chu grang 'dul sogs phri bsnan gang dgos nad babs dang bstun/ mchan/ pa/ ko byi snying sna sbyor bsnan bcas pa yi// a gar rdo rje'i ri bo zhes bya ba// ngan khrag stod rgyas rlung khrag 'thab pa dang*// dbugs 'thum dbugs brgyang 'gram 'khrugs rlung gis 'bud// de la sogs pa'i nad rigs mtsho rlabs bzhin// gyen du phyur bar 'joms pa'i dpa' bo 'di// sngon med ma ti'i blo mtsho las byung ba// phan bde'i 'od stong drwa ba 'gyed pa 'di// yon tan gling bzhi'i khrod du rnam par grags// li shi dzā ti snying zho sha dang ni// go yu a gar sha chen shing kun sbyar// snying la rlung zhugs yid mi bde ba sel// a gar ko byi la dang a ru ra/

ru rta spos dkar tsher sngon gur gum dang*// tang kun bcas la 'chi med a gar brgyad/ spyir sha chen bzang*/ srin la byi tang*/ gnyan la gla rtsi/ khrag la ba sha ka dang hong len/ mchan/ zer/ sbyor ba gang 'os stod 'tshang 'phral du sel// stod kyi rlung khrag 'khrugs pa las gyur pa'i// nad rigs kun sel bdud rtsi lta bu'o// a gar 'bras gsum dzā ti snying zho sha /li shi ru rta bde byed brgyad pa zhes// rten snying 'bum gyis sngags la rgyun tu bza'// rlung lnga'i nad du gyur tshad 'dis sel zhing*/ 'du ba log snyoms shin tu yid bde 'gyur// rlung 'khrugs ngos ma zin pa'i nad kun sel// a ga ru dang snying zho ru rta dang*// a ru skyu ru gur gum sha chen bcas// stod du rlung 'khyil sel ba rnam bdun yin// 'gag sel 'khyil ser gcig sbyar sman bcu gsum// khong par mi bde sman gzhan mi phan pa'i// nad rigs du ma 'di yis bde bar gso// snying nad gso dka'i sman mchog khyad par can// btsan dug bzang po 'bri tshil ma// myos byed nying khu'i nang du sbang*// bzhi'am drug 'gyur a ru sha /lhan gcig 'dres nges 'dam thag bya// a gar dzā ti li shi dang*// snying zho sug smel go yu dang*// shu dag gla rtsi ru rta rtsa ba'i sman// 'di yis snying nad drung nas 'byin// de steng rlung nad shing kun dang*/ kha ru tshwa dang sha chen dang*// sga skya bsnan na lhag par 'phrod// srin la byi tang ma ru rtse// khrag mkhris tsha bar skyu ru ra// tsan dan dmar po brag zhun dang*// gur gum bsnan la btang bar bya/ ༈ /stong nag man ngag thang rgyal bde byed khyad 'phags ni 'di lta ste/ nor bdun steng dmar gsum tsan dan gnyis/ ba sha ka seng ldeng mdzo mo shing*// hong len/ gri sha /gu gul/ ko byi/ snying zho sha /li shi/ nā ga ge sar/ dzā ti zhad tsam/ khrag sman gzhon nu/ khrag phrog pa'amakhang thog skyes/ mchan/

bung bskyed/ khrag rlung 'khrugs pa/ grib rigs kun dang*/ rgyal gdon gyis srog rlung la cher bsngags/ de steng ar nag /gri snying*/ ne tso'i snying dang*/ sha rgyal/ te lo/ pu shud/ sre mong gsum mo// gsum spyi bzhin skabs dang sbyar bas/ gi waṃ a gar 'bras gsum tsan dan gnyis/ cu gur utpal gser me ba le ka ma nu 'u su pri yang ku// tig ta re kon kanḍa ka ri dang*// sle tres ru rta spos dkar snying zho sha /tsher sngon ba sha ka dang ka ra sbyar// glang chen me tog nyer lnga zhes bya bas// stod nad smad du 'bebs pa'i dam pa'o// 'bam gyi rigs la thengs chog bdud rtsi yin// tsan dan dkar dmar gur gum hong len dang*// ba sha ka dang ko byi ru rta dang*// spos dkar a gar a ru byi tang ka /ma ru rtse dang tig ta bcu gsum sbyar// ya ma nag po'i rlung khrag stod rgyas sel/ yang snying rlung la/ a gar brgyad steng*/ gri sha /'brong snying*/ ri bong snying*/ rus bcud gsum gyis phul/ ༈ mkhris nad bcos skor la/ dang po tig ta/ 100 gser gyi me tog 080 bong dkar/ 080 ru rta/ 050 rtsa mkhris/ 080 hong len/ 050 parpa ta/ 040 skyer shun/ 070 ka 'di steng g.ya' kyi bsnan pas man ngag zab ra sbyar ba'i tig ta brgyad pas/ mkhris tshad mig ser sha mdangs ser ba 'joms/ tig ta nyi shu rtsa lnga'i sbyor ba ni/ tig ta rigs gsum gser me dug mo nyung*/ rgun 'brum gyi lce bong dkar dzā ti dang*// a ru ru rta cu gang a krong dang*// shu dag ba sha ka dang se 'bru dang*// gur gum sug smel pi ling rgya skyegs dang*// dom mkhris li shi seng phrom dkar po dang*// shug tsher ka ra sbyar ba'i nyi shu lnga// don snod mkhris par babs pa'i spyi sman yin/ tig ta stobs chen bco brgyad ni/ tig ta gi waṃ dom mkhris gser me dang*// dug nyung skyer shun rtsa mkhris g.ya' kyi ma// gur gum skyu ru hong len ba sha ka

/gu gul shu dag phag brun thal ba dang*// ru rta byi tang ka dang ma ru rtse// tig ta stobs chen bco brgyad ces bya bas// mkhris srin gdon bskyed rtsa nad kun tu rgyu// me ltar tsha 'bar zug rngu drag po can// gsod pa'i gnyen po 'di min gzhan du dka'// gzhan yang rims nad mkhris pa rtsar rgyug dang*// gnyan nad rtsa byer mkhris ldan ma nges nad// kṣa ya la sogs mkhris pa'i nad rigs la// thengs pas chog pa mi pham pa yis so// grang mkhris skabs/ gser zhi/ ga pur nag po/ se ba'i me tog gtong ba phyag len no// tsan dan bco brgyad sbyor ba ni/ tsan dan gi waṃ bzang po drug /a ru gser mdog sum cu tig /ru rta rgya skyegs pri yang ku// hong len re skon ba sha ka /btsod dang 'bri mog ka ra sbyar// brag zhun thang gis phul la btang*// phan yon 'khru skyugs 'dril ba dang*// rtsib log ro stod gzer ba dang*// snying rlung rgyu ba ngan pa dang*// rtsa tshad rtsa 'drul sha 'phrig dang*// mgo bo na zhing mig mi gsal/ kha lce skam zhing gre ba tsha// mchin mkhris pho ba rgyu ma la// rmugs shing tsha ba byer pa dengs// me dbal chu yis gsod dang mtshungs// gu gul cu gang utpal ba le ka /tig ta brag zhun a ru mtshe ldum ka ra sbyar// gur gum mchog bdun mchin nad gsar rnying dang*// mchin pa snad 'gram khrag rgyas mig ser sel// gi waṃ gur gum utpal ba le ka /tig ta brag zhun ru rta ba sha ka /gser gyi me tog ka ra gi waṃ dgu// mchin pa snad 'gram mchin khrag rgyas pa sel/ zhes so// de'ang gur gum mchog bdun dang tig ta brgyad pa bsres pa gur tig /gi waṃ dgu pa dang tig ta brgyad pa bsres pa gi tig /bdud rtsi sum sbyor dang tig brgyad bsdeb pas bdud tig sogs mchin mkhris khrag mkhris bad mkhris sogs la zab par gsungs/ ༈ gser mdog lnga pa'i sbyor ba ni/ gser mdog 130

se 'bru 030 gser me tog 043 /brag zhun 037 phag ril thal ba 130 lnga// ka ra sbyar ba chu bskol phul// ma zhu mig ser mkhris nad dang*// mkhris pa snod lhung sha mdangs ser// tsha grang mkhris pa'i nad yul 'byin/ /ces so/ /tshe bhrūm̐ lugs kyi gar nag bco lnga ni/ gar nag 100 gu gul 050 gla rtsi 051 sngo sga 050 dang*// byi tang 050 lang thang ma ru par pa ta// tig ta gser me bong dkar rtsa mkhris dang*// ru rta hong len skyer shun sbyar ba yis// bad mkhris mgo na khrag mkhris srin bsdong ba'i// mgo bo gzer la slebs chog bdud rtsir mtshungs/ zhes so// a ru gser mdog se 'bru dang*// skyu ru dug nyung gser me tog /dzā zi ra dkar po gor brag zhun gur gum dang*// ru rta se ba'i me tog rnams// ka ra sbyar ba chu bskol phul// gser mdog bcu pa'i sbyor ba 'dis// bad mkhris mig ser sel ba'i mchog /brag zhun gla rtsi gur gum sug smel dang*// dom mkhris bong nga 'jib rtsi a ru ra// ga dur ka ra cha mnyam brag zhun dgu// pho ba'i khrag mkhris tshad pa sel bar byed// dom mkhris gser gyi me tog dug mo nyung*// gla sgang bong nga dkar po ba le ka /re skon ka ra sbyar ba'i mkhris phye bdun// rgyu long nad 'gram khrag mkhris tsha 'khru gcod// mkhris par a ru'i gser bshal ni// gser mdog bzang po sum cha ste// gcig ni ba chu phul gang du// btsos pa chu de bstims nas bton// gcig ni bag zan nang du btum// sla ngar du ba ma shor bsregs// zan tshig a ru ma tshig tshad/ gcig ni bco lnga'i zla ba'i dus// 'khar gzhong nang bzhag nam langs bsdu/ kha bsgyur thar nu dur byid gnyis// zho re bra ba'i ril ma tsam// rgya tshwa srang gsum thar nu bdun// srod la slong byed thun gcig btang*// nam gung 'khru byed thun gcig btang*// tho rangs sbyong byed thun gcig btang*// tshad ni sum cha sum gnyis dang*// phyed bcas btang ba thun tshad lags// btso bsregs rjen gsum sbyor ba ni// mkhris nad dug dang smug po la// 'di las lhag pa'i sbyong gzhan med// ces so/

༈ /bad kan skya bo'i sman skor/ bde byed snyom ldan zhes bya'i sman mchog ni/ se 'bru/ 06 bzang drug / cu gur gnyis/ 018 li sug dzā ko bzhi re/ 010 a ru/ 03 shing tsha/ 042 da li/ 060 tsha ba gsum 006 dang*// gangs kyi thig 060 tshwa la 060 la phug thal ba/ 010 ma nu pa ru rta tra dang*/ 010 puṣa dkar dngos/ 010 hong len dang tig ta/ 010 cong zhi/ 200 rnams zhib par btags pa'i phye// sman rta gtso bo bzhi 'gyur sbyar nas ni// tho rangs dus su sing po gsar 'jam phul// sha gsar chang 'jam mal gos dro bar bya// sman yun bsring zhing btang ba'i phan yon ni// bad kan skya smug la sogs bad kan rigs// kṣa ya mig ser la sogs mkhris pa'i rigs// lhan dang lcags dregs ma zhu ba rnams dang*// dug ro la sogs pho ba mchin pa'i nad// smug po gab 'gyings chu ser lpags nad rigs// za phrug skyigs bu la sogs gong bshad nad// phyi yi nad rnams sbrul lpags bshus pa ltar// nang gi nad rnams ba mor nyi shar 'dra// kun la phan pa'i sman mchog dam pa yin// phag mo grub pa'i sbyor ba ni/ bdud rtsi

cong zhi bzang po nas tsam brdungs la sla ngar brngos rjes chang gar ma bre phyed blug la khu ba rang thim drod 'jam tsam la phog / cong zhi phul gang gzhir byas la// ha la'i kha 'dzin rnam par rgyal ba/ 100 /mchin pa'i kha 'dzin gur gum/ 010 shing tshwa/ 010 mkhal ma'i kha 'dzin mdangs bskyed sug smel/ 010 pho ba'i kha 'dzin drod bskyed se 'bru/ 020 grang ba'i kha 'dzin na le sham pi ling*/ 010 rlung gi kha 'dzin sga skya mtheb tsam/ rlung khrag kha 'dzin sha pho ru rta/ spyi yi kha 'dzin rgya tshwa shwa tsam/ 'du ba cha snyoms brag zhun nyid bcas// bur dkar rta la bskyon pa'i phye mas// ma zhu ba dang bad kan skya smug /lhan dang lcags dregs mchin pa'i nad gzhi// skran dang dug ro rtsa la zhen dang*/ khong sgreg bad kan pho ba 'khren pa// yar la skyugs dang mar la 'joms pa// khyad par bad kan smug po'i nad la// rdo tshan kha ba babs ltar 'joms shing*// stobs 'phel lus kyi gzi mdangs rgyas byed// gong smos kun la ba mor nyi bzhin/ sel byed man ngag kun gyi yang snying*/ dbang gsal rgas sra bcud len mchog yin// bdud rtsi chang gi gnyen po byed na// bag med 'thung yang 'di nyid thun re'i// mod la 'thung zhing myos par mi 'gyur// sman nus 'dzin phyir gsang ba'i sman mchog /karsha pa ni sbrum ma 'jug cing*// so skyes brjod dka' gdams pa'i nus mthu/ lce brgyas bskal pa stong phrag du mas// smras kyang zad par nus pa ma yin// thams cad mkhyen nyid brjod pa'i gnas yin/ de steng kha che utpal skyu ru/ pri yang ku dang ba sha ka bsnan// bad smug nad la bdud rtsir mtshungs so// zhes so// cong zhi 'o mar 'dam thag grib skam bya// gi waṃ bzang drug utpal tsan dan gnyis// gla rtsi gser gyi me tog dug mo nyung*// tig ta bong dkar a ru ba sha ka /ru rta pi pi ling dang ka ra sbyar// cong zhi bsil sbyor dug dang smug po dang*// gab tshad tshad rnying ma lus sel bar byed/

se 'bru/ 100 080 shing tsha/ 010 sug smel/ 080 pi pi ling*/ 080 bur dkar sbyar ba'i se 'bru bzhi pa ste// pho ba'i gzhi 'dzin me drod gso bar byed// nad gzhi ci las gyur kyang dang ga 'byed// de steng dong grwa bsnan pas tshad ldan sbyor// se 'bru lnga pas bad kan zas mi 'ju// pho ba'i grang skran skyugs dang yi ga 'chus// snying rlung mkhal sked nad la mchog tu phan// yang na gur gum bsnan pas se 'bru lnga// tsha grang 'thab tsha na gur gum grang na dong gra zho re bsnan/ pa'i kha 'dzin me drod gso/ ༈ /bad kan smug po'i nad skor la// glang chen rgya mtsho mtha' yas ni// glang chen bcu gsum steng du ko byi la// dug nyung li shi hong len cu gang dang*// tsan dan dkar dmar 'bri mog btsod tshos dang*// ga dur snying zho ka ra sbyar ba yis// glang chen rgya mtsho mtha' yas zhes bya 'dis// 'dus nad smug po byer rgyas tsha srin bsdongs// dug smug mchin mkhris skran dang khrag gzer 'phyo// stod smad go log dri chu khrag tu 'gyur// srin rigs long bub mkhas pa phug rdugs la// 'di las zab pa 'dzam gling khams na med// g.yu thog mgon la ye shes mkha' 'gros gnang*// man ngag gsang sman gzhan la ma spel cig /spyi 'joms sman dmar chen mo ni/ khyung drug /bsil gsum/ mi thod/ 'brug rus/ sro lo/ spang rgyan/ tsan dan dmar/ lug mur/ sho mang gnyis/ spa yag /ar nag /snying zho/ gri sha /tig ta/ shun khan/ gser me/ skyer shun/ gi waṃ/ bsil smyug /rma bya/ re ral/ 'om bu/ snya lo/ dug nyung*/ ba sha /hong len/ bong dkar/ sug smel/ mkhal zho/ brag zhun/ spru skya/ phur nag /spang lce/ kyi lce nag po/ dmar gsum/ zhu mkhan/ chu rtsa/ re lcag /thar nu cung tsam/ de rnams phye ma mtshal gyi mdog bsgyur/ gnyan dang tshad pa khrag mkhris dug dang smug po/ stod smad don snod gar bab 'di yin pas// man ngag gam phye dmar po 'brong sman lugs// thang ni nor bu bdun steng*/

dmar gsum/ tsan dan gnyis/ mdzo shing thun cher/ chu rtsa/ 'u su/ ba sha /hong len/ tig ta de rnams bya// zla shel bsdus pa/ cong zhi/ lcags phye dang*/ ma nu 'u su star bu sbyar ba yi// bad smug nad la zab cing skya rbab sel/ ༈ /thang chen nyer lnga ni/ kha che gur gum thang gi gtso bo la// a bar skyur gsum ma nu ma nu dngos pa tra dang*// ma nu puṣkar khams rus hong len tig ta dang*// kyi lce bong dkar 'u su parpa ta// rgyal ba'i lug mig spyan can 'khri 'om bu shing pa dngos sam gser me gang rung to la// ldum bu re ral phag khrag gaṅgā chung*// utpal tsher ma dar 'joms ba le ka dang pri yang ku/ brag zhun sug smel se 'bru bse yab rnams// sbyar bas thang chen nyi shu rtsa lnga pas// dug dang smug po tshad rnying byer ba sdud// 'du ba tsha grang cha snyoms dang ga 'byed// rlung mi skyed cing bad mkhris gnyis ka sel// des na sbyor ba kun gyi rgyal po bshad// ces so/ ༈ /byer sdud sman skor/ 'bras gsum bsil gsum brag zhun a ga ru// ma nu bra ga sle tres sga skya dang*// re ral gser me skyer shun ba sha ka /tig ta kyi lce 'bri ta sa 'dzin dang*// shing mngar lcam pa tshos btsod zhu mkhan dang*// se rgod phag khrag lcum rtsa spa 'bru bcas// sdud thang nyer lnga nor bu'i zhags pa 'dis// dug dang tsha ba khrag mkhris tshad smug 'bam// la sogs nad kyi rigs su gyur to cog /stod smad don snod phyi nang rtsa yan lag /gang du byer kyang nges par sdud par byed// 'di yi phan yon lag tu blang pas gsal/ ༈ /skyu ru nyer lnga'i 'phrul 'khor can ni/ skyu ru ba sha ba le spri yang ku// 'u su hong len brag zhun utpal sngo/ spang rtsi gur gum gi waṃ tsan dan gnyis// btsod tshos spu shel 'bri mog li ga dur// tig ta a bar gser me ru rta dang*// ma nu kanḍa sle tres star bu ste// ka ra sbyar ba'i skyu ru nyer lnga 'dis/

khrag shed ma lus gcod pa'i spyi sman yin// gtar dgos gtar mi rung la sman 'di bsten// gtar mi dgos pa drang srong phyag len yin// phan yon brjod 'das bye brag kha bsgyur mtshungs// spyi yi phan yon mdo tsam brjod pa ni// stod gzer khrag 'khrugs tsha ba stod rgyas dang*// smug po khrag rgyas mchin dri ro stod rgyas// brang tsha chu skyur mkhris pa rgya brgyal dang*// khrag rul dud khu skyugs dang pho mchin na// ro rgyab rtsib gzer khrag mkhris pho bar lhungs// smug po rgyas gab 'khrugs dang gnas zhen dang*/ byer 'thab snying sogs 'dus nad smug po'i rigs// 'joms pa'i mchog yin khyad par kha bsgyur ni// gyen brdol khrag skyugs sna khrag lud rigs la// mkhan skya dom mkhris sran ma sardzi ka skyer pa rdo dreg mtshal dkar mtshe yi thal// spru ma'i 'bu bsdeb ba sha gur gum dang*// rgya skyegs spu shel tsan dmar bskyed pas gcod// thur rdol khrag 'khru de steng re skon dang*// da trig bya rkang mon cha ram pa bsdeb// rlung shas che na a gar dzā ti dang*// sha chen gur gum rus bcud gsum gyis phul// glo 'khrugs che la cu gang shing mngar dang*// a krong sro lo rgun 'brum bsdebs pa dang*// star bu ga dur ru rta 'bri mog bskyed// mkhris shas che na dug nyung g.ya' kyi bsdebs// tig ta a ru gser mdog bskyed pa gces// smug tshad che la bse yab re skon dang*// tsandan dkar bsdebs gi gur spang rtsi bskyed// bad grang che la se 'bru bzhi pa dang*// rgyam tshwa sga bsdebs skyu ru 'u su bskyed// pho bar 'gyings shing dngas mar skyugs pa la// se 'bru bzhi pa dang ni la la phud// nā ga puṣpa ge sar sga shing mngar// bur dkar bsdebs shing gi waṃ gser me dang*// ba le pri yang 'u su bskyed par bya// tsha grang 'thab la se 'bru sug smel dang*// pi ling byi tang ka dang re skon pa// go brun bsdebs shing skyu ru pri yang ku// 'u su ba sha ru rta spu shel bskyed// smug skran 'gying na re lcag tshwa la dang*// sbrul sha rgya tshwa byang ba dung 'gron thal// bsdebs shing star bu ru rta sbyar ba bskyed// stod gzer che la li shi ge sar gsum// gu gul a byag gla rtsi tsher sngon bsdebs/

utpal ru rta ma nu 'bras gsum bskyed// srog snying gzer zhing 'phyos na dzā ti dang*// ar nag gu gul li shi sga skya dang*/ spos dkar ge sar ri bong tsitta dang*// shing kun zho sha bsdebs shing 'bras gsum bskyed// de ltar sman no cog gi yang snying bcud// skyu ru nyer lnga'i 'phrul 'khor tshe yis gsos// 'chi med bdud rtsi mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan sman// drang srong snying nor rig pa'i rtsal gyis gter// nad do cog gi 'dus chen smug po'i gshed// nyes gsum las gyur tsha grang gang yang rung*// don snod phyi nang dbang po'i nad kyi rigs// brgyas bshad stong lhag bcos dgos brgya rtsa sogs// nad gdon che phra spyi dang bye brag kun// skyu ru'i 'phrul 'khor rig pas bskor shes na// mi sel 'chi ba'i dus la babs las min// ces pa mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan rgyud 'dzin bu// a tsar ka ru ṇa yi phyag len yin/ ༈ /khrag nad kun sel zhes bya'i sman mchog ni/ gi waṃ gur gum utpal ba le ka /tig ta brag zhun ru rta ba sha ka /gser me cong zhi 'bri mog ma nu dang*// cu gang skyu ru shing mngar re skon dang*// tsandan dmar po mdzo mo shing dang ni// hong len star bu ka ra cha bskyed pa// gi waṃ dgu steng khrag 'khrugs kun sel sman// bsnan 'dis mchin pa nad 'gram mchin khrag rgyas// mchin tshad bad kan smug po rgyas pa sogs// khrag 'khrugs khrag nad mtsho rlabs ltar phyur ba// thams cad zhi byed 'joms pas nad mi dkrugs// gtar dgos nad la gtar kha'i go chod 'gyur// 'di steng zhu mkhan tshos btsod sle tres dang*/ kanḍa ka ra pri yang ku dang ni/ sro lo dmar po dang bcas nyi shu bdun// khrag mkhris 'khrugs dang khrag nad rol du lhag /stod 'bam glo rdol smug po'i tsha ba sogs/ mdor na khrag la brten pa'i nad rigs la// slebs chog bdud rtsi mngon gsum 'di ldan na/

khrag gtsos gdug pa'i nad rnams shin tu sla// de steng a ru ba ru a ga ru// li shi bsnan na shin tu 'jam zhing 'phrod// nyes pa gsum ka gang yang sel bar byed/ ༈ /zla shel ril bu spyi dang khyad par sbyor tshul bdud rtsi'i myu gu zhes bya ni/ de nas sman dngos kyi sbyor ba la/ cong zhi 'dam thag srang bcu'i tshe/ gi waṃ slad med/ 035 cu gang*/ gur gum/ li shi/ dzā ti/ sug smel/ ka ko la bcas bzang po drug so so nas/ 015 tsandan dkar po/ 015 tsandan dmar po/ 021 gser me/ 020 rgya gar dug mo nyung*/ 041 sum cu tig ta/ 020 'dzom na rgya gar bong dkar dang ma rnyed na sngo bong dkar/ 031 ba sha ka 031 rgya gar ru rta/ 041 lcags phye 001 skyu ru ra/ 030 se 'bru/ 220 brag zhun/ 051 pri yang ku/ 051 gangs thig 042 gu gul nag po/ 231 chu rtsa/ 244 ma nu/ 077 ko byi la/ 023 hong len/ 080 lug ru smug po/ rgya gar dang bod kyi utpal 'dres pa/ 072 gla rtsi zol med/ 006 dri chen/ 004 mi yi sog thal/ 010 a ru ra/ 101 pi pi ling*/ 020 dom mkhris slad med/ 020 dngul chu 'dul ma/ 200 bcas sman sna sum cu rtsa bdun po zhib par btags la dar tshags su drangs// de nas a ru ra'i phye mas lcags g.ya' babs pa'i khu ba nag po blug la drod cung zad phab ste zhag gsum lnga nam zla dang bstun la kheb dang bcas bsnyal/ de nas 'dam thag them par bya/ 'byor na phab gta'/ rin chen/ tsha sbyor/ grang sbyor/ mang sbyor/ snga ma rnams kyis tshad ldan sbyar ba'i zla shel sogs dkar yol gtsang mar chu gtsang gis sbyar la btab/ de nas kha cig gis ring bsrel/ zol med kyang btang lugs 'dug pa phun sum tshogs pa'i yan lag yin cing phab btab/ ma 'byor na'ang 'gal ba med/ dmigs gsal dug la gla rtsi dang bse ru dkar po thal tshan du rtsi hrog bsregs nas chu 'dur byas pa'i khu ba dang*/ tshad pa dang*/ rus chags la spyi zhur khu bas 'dam thag bya ba gces/ gang ltar gar sla gtor zan rtsam du dril/

dar ras kyi lding khri lta bu cung zad bkod/ rjes thog dar ras nag po'i khug mar ril chags bya/ cung zad skam pa dang lhung bzed lta bu'i snod du ril chags legs par bya zhing*/ sman bla'i gzungs dang rten snying brjod la rab tu gnas shing shis pa brjod/ skam nas rlung mi 'chor ba'i snod du bcang bar bya/ phan yon ni/ dharma swā mis/ dug dang smug po khrag tu 'khru skyugs dang*// gab tshad tshad rnying 'gram 'khrugs 'thabs pa dang*// ma zhu glang thab srin dang chu ser skran// ldan 'dus nad rnams 'joms pa'i rdo rje ste// zhes gsungs pa'i yon tan rnams ldan cing*/ khyad par 'dus nad smug po'i rigs la lhag par zab/ de'ang pho bar thog mar ma nu bzhi thang drod 'joms lan gnyis gsum btang nas bsdus te/ se 'bru lnga pa dang ltag pa sprad/ pho ba 'khrog pa dang 'khru snyam byed na lus zung bzang ngan dang bstun te ril bu rim gyis bskyed pas rang bshal byung na gzhi med du dngas// rgyu mar babs tshe gser mdog lnga pa dang ltag sprad gtong*/ smug po byer ba'i rigs la thang chen nyer lnga dang ltag sprad gtong*/ smug po byer rgyas 'gying 'dril gang la'ang se 'bru kun phan sbyor ba tshad ldan byas pa dang ltag sprad du btang bas lhag par zab bo/ ༈ /zla shel bdud rtsi ril bu'i sbyor ba ni/ rgyal po cong zhi btsun mo brag zhun cha gnyis/ blon po rnams cha re re/ 'khor 'bangs rnams cha phyed re sbyor ba ste/ de'ang cong gzhi 'dam 'thag srang bzhi'i tshad/ brag zhun lhad med srang do/ a ru ra/ rgya gar ru rta ma rnyed na khams rus/ hong len/ utpal/ ma nu/ pri yang ku/ ba sha ka /lcags phye dug phral rnams srang gang re/ bzang po drug a gar nag po/ tig ta/ pi pi ling*/ ba ru ra/ sle tres/ dngul chu 'dul ma/ rgyam tshwa/ ming can nag po/ gla rtsi/ gu gul nag po/ da li'i me tog /srad nag /nyi dga'/ li ga dur/ dpa' bo dkar po/

byi'u la phug /spos dkar/ thal rdor/ so ma ra dza rnams so so nas zho lnga zhib par btags/ a ru ra dang gla rtsi gnyis zur du so sor phyes la 'dur/ se 'bru dang skyu ru ra srang do re star khan srang gang spyi zhur zho lnga bcas thang tsam brdung nas khu ba yang yang phab/ snyigs ma la sman gyi ro med par yong tshe snyigs dor ba'i khu dwangs nang gong gi a ru ra'i phye ma btab drod cung zad phog par byas nas lcags snod du zhag gsum bzhi bsnyal/ de nas sman phye byings btab la 'dam thag nyi ma phyed tsam du byas la zhag gcig bsnyal ba'i phyir nang rdo gzhong du blugs la gla rtsi phye ma chu nyung tsam la sbyar ba dang*/ phab gta' yod na'ang blug la 'dam 'thag legs par byas te ril bu dril/ rab gnas shis brjod byas te za ma tog bzang por bcang*/ dgos dus lnga bdun dgu sogs nad stobs dang sbyar nas btang bar gsungs/ 'di yi phan yon ni/ bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rnams ma lus pa// 'di yis mi sel ba ni ga la yod/ khyad par khrag mkhris bad kan smug po dang*/ rmu 'or skya rbab dreg grum tsha ba rnying*/ rtsa dkar chu ser dngos dang sbyar dug rnams/ sel byed 'chi med bdud rtsi mngon sum mo// ces gsungs pa che brjod tsam ma yin par don la gnas pa'i phan thogs che zhing*/ zla shel chen mo las kyang rno la zab pa dang*/ bad kan chu bzhi/ smug po dang 'dres pa'i tshad rims gsar rnying rnams la shin tu zab pa lag blang ma'o/ ༈ /rje g.yu thog pa chen po'i ye shes kyi sku yi rjes su bzung ba kun gzigs 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'i dgongs pa'i rgya mtsho las rdol ba'i// sman sbyor ratna gsar pa'i do shal las// baiḍūrya rin thang dang bral ba ste rgyal ba rnams kyi thugs rje gdul bya'i dus las yol med du 'jug pas 'di yang don chen po dang ldan par nges pa rnyed de gzhan phan gyi btsas su bkod pa'ang*/

sman sbyor zla ba gsar ba'i bdud rtsi yis/ lus can nyes pa'i tsha gdung rab bcil nas/ bden don kun dga'i myu gu ci yang 'phel/ 'chi med rtag pa dam pa'i dpal ster shog /ces pa'ang mdo smad nor 'dzin yangs pa'i khyon du gtsug lag zung gi phrin las gzhan dring mi 'jog par skyong ba/ mi rje spyi khyab chen po tshe ring dpal ldan dbang gi rgyal po'i 'phongs pa rnams la ring 'tsho'i sbyin pa bstsal ba'i thugs bskyed khyad par du 'phags pas/ sman sbyor phyag len bstar gnang ba'i cha rkyen du lnga rigs smra ba gu ṇa sa mu dras nyag smad ri rgyal dga' ldan kun khyab rdzong du bris pa dge'o/ ༈ /zla shel bdud rtsi ma zhes bya ba nad brgya sman gcig ngo mtshar can mi pham rnam par rgyal ba'i khyad chos las/ mchin nad gtsor gyur nad rigs kun 'joms ni/ lcags phye a ru'i bzhus pa

100 brag zhun 050 kha gur ram bal gur 050 pri yang ku 050 cong zhi 'dam thag 050 ma nu 050 ru rta 050 dang bdun no// 'di la zla shel chos sman thun re 'debs pa zhal shes/ dug dang smug po glo tshad gzer gyi rigs// mdor na tsha grang nad rigs gang la yang*// brtag pa mi dgos btang bas chog pa yin// bdud rtsi mngon sum 'di nyid lag tu long*// dhīḥ yis ḍākki bsgrub pa'i dus su bris// gzhan yang 'di yi yon tan ni// nad rnying rtsi ltar zhen pa dang*// zungs bdun skyon bral 'du ba snyoms// mig gsal yid bde gdon kun zhi// rgyun du bsten na bcud len 'grub// lus kyi nad ro gyur to cog /gang la btang yang nges par phan// drang srong rig 'dzin thugs rje'i mthus// sman gzhan rdugs kyang 'di yis 'dul// 'di la yon tan tshad med kyang*// bshad kyang phal pa yid ches dka'// tshig chung don che gzhan las 'phags// bden rdzun lag tu len bgyis na// ngo mtshar mthong ba'i lam du gsal// rdzas kyi nor bu sngags kyi byin rlabs nas// dad pas bstan na lha yi bdud rtsi mchog /mi yi lag na mngon sum thogs pa 'dra// de phyir 'di nyid gcig pus 'gro don gyis// yan lag brgyad kyis bsdus pa'i gso rig ces// dgos pa sman mchog gcig gis 'grub pa 'di// 'jam dpal rdo rjes skal bzang gdul bya'i ched// legs par bkod pa dus gsum dge gyur cig ༈ /rga lo pa yi sman dmar ni/ 'bri mog sum gnyis cong zhi cha// khrag gi nad la ba sha ka /gzer la ma nu ru rta bsdeb// bad khrag nad la mchog tu bsngags// skyu ru kha tshar bsdeb pa'ang zab// ces so/ ༈ /man ngag bsil sbyor zhes bya ni/ tsandan dkar po 010 dmar po 010 bzang po drug so sor 005 a gar nag po 010 utpal 010 ru rta 010 a ru 010 ba ru 010 ba sha ka 010 gser me 020 pi pi ling 030 tig ta 001 dug nyung 010 bong dkar 010

se 'bru 010 skyu ru 010 gla rtsi dri thon tsam/ gcong nad kun zhi cong mdzo 'os 'dam thag cong zhi kun dang bung mnyam zhi sman gyi rgyal// rtsi bzhin btags te gur gum gi waṃ gnyis kyi ser po 'ong ba gser 'od 'bar bar 'gyur// chang ngam sing po dag gis phul la gtong*// man ngag bsil sbyor zhes bya'i sman mchog 'dis// dug smug mkhris pa mchin par zhen pa dang*// gab tshad tshad rnying rtsi ltar zhen pa dang*// 'khrugs dang khrag rlung stod du 'tshang ba dang*/ mdor na mchin mkhris bar gyi bad mkhris sogs/ 'di ni stod smad kun la thaings chog yin// gnad kyi gdams pa bla ma'i zhal las byung*// zhes cong zhi mdzo 'or 'dam thag cha gnyis se 'bru a ru skyu ru gsum sman gzhan las mang tsam bya gsungs/ ༈ bdud rtsi sum sbyor ni/ rdo yi tshil bu cha gsum la// 'jib rtsi cha gnyis ma nu gcig /bdud rtsi gsum sbyor zhes bya ste// zhib btags gar chang rta la bskyon// stod du bad khrag rgyas pa dang*// smad du mchin khrag lhung ba dang*// mgo dang yan lag la sogs kyi// rus chag lugs su 'dzud pa dang*// bad mkhris zag khu gcod pa'i mchog /ces so/ ༈ /smug po g.yul las rnam rgyal ni/ stod lugs cong zhi nyer gcig ces grags pa/ cong zhi 004 se 'bru 100 sug smel 050 pi pi ling 030 ma nu 030 'u su 004 utpal 004 pri yang ku 030 bse yab 080 star bu 100 skyu ru 070 ba sha ka 004 a ru 070 gser me 050 dug nyung 030 bong nga dkar 020 gi waṃ 050 tig ta 050 ru rta 080 tsandan dmar 080 brag zhun 100 la sogs sbyar thabs mthong brgyud dam// zhal shes bzhin tu ma nor bsten gyur na// brang tsha chu skyur mkhris pa rgya bshal skyugs/ pho mchin ro rgyab sbrags shing tshigs pa na// khrag mkhris pho bar lhung ngam stod du gzer// smug po rgyas dang gab cing 'khrugs pa dang*// rang gzhan gnas su zhen cing rnying pa sogs// 'dus nad smug po'i rigs kyi sman gcig yin/

༈ /cong zhi nyer lnga'i sbyor ba ni// cong zhi bzang po drug dang tsandan gnyis// gi waṃ ru rta gla rtsi pi pi ling*// a ru skyu ru lcags phye gser me tog /tig ta utpal sngon po dug mo nyung*// ma nu 'u su bse yab star bu dang*// ba sha bong dkar a ga ru dang sbyar// ril bu legs dril chu bskol phul la btang*// sman mchog 'di yis phan yon bstan pa ni// bad kan skya smug ser gsum ma zhu ba// tsha ba byer ba rnams la mchog tu phan// zab dang rno ba phyag len mdzod dang gsal// ces so/ ༈ /glang chen bco brgyad sbyor ba ni/ rgyud kyi gi waṃ dgu steng du/ ma nu/ 010 'u su 010 skyu ru ra 017 cu gang 024 li shi 010 a dkar nag 010 tsandan dmar 010 re skon 010 sbyar ba yis/ smug po kun sel 'bam nad 'joms zhes gsungs/ gi waṃ 070 tsandan dkar 013 dmar 018 ar nag 050 sum tig 050 sha chen 005 re skon pa 010 skyu ru 017 utpal 010 gser gyi me tog dang 001 ma nu 010 'u su 010 pri yang 010 brag zhun 030 ru rta 010 cu gang 034 gur gum 050 sbyor ba yis/ glang chen me tog bco brgyad ces grags pa/ ༈ /mchin khrag smug po rgyas pa sel ba'i mchog /ru rta skyu ru se 'bru ba sha ka /sug smel pi pi ling drug steng nyid du// pri yang 'u su utpal re skon pa// sga dang go thal byi tang bcu gsum po// 'di ni bar sman rgyal po'i sbyor ba ste// g.yu dril bcu gsum smug po spyi sman yin// khyad par tsha grang 'thab pa'i gnyen po'o/ ༈ /smug po spyi sman a ru brag zhun dang*/ cu gang gur gum se 'bru pi pi ling*// utpal bse yab star bu 'u su dang*// ma nu pa tra cha mnyam sbyar ba yi// smug po ma lus 'joms pa'i spyi sman yin// cong zhi cha mnyam a ru brag zhun dang*// ma nu shing tsha pri yang cha gnyis pa// ka ra sbyor ba chu tshan phul bas btang*// khrag rul dud khu skyugs dang zas mi 'ju// khyad par lus stobs chung la mchog tu bsngags/

pho nad tsha grang ma lus pa// spyi 'joms bde ba'i myu gu ni// a ru gser mdog brag zhun mnyam// de gnyis dang ni star zhun mnyam// pi ling gur gum utpal mnyam// sle tres skyu ru ba sha ka /ru rta rgyam tshwa ma nu dang*// cong zhi lcags phye dā li dang*// sbrul lcags sbrul gyi sha rnams thun bzang re// ril bu sran tshad chu bskol phul// khrag mkhris pho bar lhung ba dang*// smug po'i khrag skran 'dril ba dang*// me nyams ma zhu gsar rnying sogs// pho nad tsha grang mtha' dag sel// zhes so/ ༈ /ka ru kha sbyor zhes pa ni/ dkar po drug sbyor dang ru rta drug pa dang ltag pa sprad pa'o// 'ga' zhig gis zhi ru kha sbyor byed par snang*/ glang chen bcu gsum sbyor ba ni/ gi waṃ dgu steng 'u su pri yang ku// skyu ru ma nu glang chen bcu gsum ste// gyen thur gnyis su smug po'i mtsho rdol nas// zla re zla gnyis khrag lam ma chod cing*// sman dpyad gzhan gyi gso bar ma nus na// chu grang gis phul sman thun lnga yi chog /ces gleng*/ ༈ bco lnga drag po'i sbyor ba ni/ cong zhi bslad med phul do dang*// lan tshwa bslad med phul gang gnyis// sla nga'i nang du legs par brngos// tshos tshad 'bru gsum nas dang sbyar// chang rgan nying khu'i kha phru 'debs// rlangs pa mi 'chor bkab par bya// su dkar gzhon nu chag pa do// brag skyes dbyi mong spar ba do// de gnyis du ba ma shor bsregs// 'di bzhi rtsa ba'i sman nag yin// pi ling pho ril bdun nam dgu// dzā ti pha la bzhi gshag gcig /rgya tshwa rgyam tshwa sran ma tsam// kha ru tshwa ni nas 'bru tsam// bca' sga skyes pa'i sen mo tsam// 'u su thun tshad khyad par med// ma nu lug gi ril ma tsam// ze tshwa thur mgo sum ru gcig /mang sbyor bco lnga drag po zhes// 'bring sbyar rtsa ba'i sman bzhi'i steng*// dzā ti 'u su ze tshwa dang*// tshwa sman gsum dang bong nga dkar// pi pi ling bcas gong tshad bya// nyung sbyor rtsa ba'i sman bzhi'i steng*// drod sman rdog bdun sbyar ba'o// gong sman steng du dug mkhris kyi/

kha gnon dpa' bo dkar po sdeb srol bcas// thal sman rgyal blon 'bangs gsum gyis// phan yon bsam gyi mi khyab ste// khyad par pho gcong nad la shis// bad kan smug po khrag skyugs dang*// rgyu nad rtag tu 'khru ba dang*// sgregs pa mang zhing zas mi 'ju// pho ba stong sdeb byed pa dang*// pho log pho ba spu byi dang*// pho sul lcags kyi dreg chags dang*// pho ba dug thab mchin nad dang*// mchin pa rgyas dang 'phyang ba dang*// mchin chu blugs dang sgregs pa bcas// rgyu gzer grang ba dug thab rigs// 'gril bcas gru gu bsgong pa dang*// mdor na pho long rgyu gcong la// sman sbyor 'di las lhag pa med// rno ba spu gris gcod dang mtshungs// sman nag thugs kyi dkyil du chongs// mnyam med dwags po'i dgongs pa yin// so nam kun gyi spyi nor lags/ ༈ /cong zhi 'phrul thal sbyor ba ni// pho cong rta so srang gang la// a ru gser mdog tshwa la dang*// rgyam tshwa bong dkar la bong dkar dngos dgos pi pi ling*// 'di lnga zho ni re re la// mu zi lhad med zho phyed sbyar// 'di rnams thang tsam brdung bar bya// 'di ni 'phrul thal chung ngu yin// ma zhu bad kan lhen tshad dang*// lcags dreg rdo dug dbyig dug sogs// bad mkhris dang ni smug po'i skran// pho nad tsha grang med pa 'joms// de steng bzang drug rgyam tshwa pri yang ku// bsnan pas cong zhi thal sman 'bring po ste// ma zhu la sogs stobs rgyas nad tshad 'joms/ chen po gong steng a ru tsha ba lnga// rgya tshwa rgyam tshwa thal tshwa kha ru tshwa// mdze tshwa ze tshwa lan tshwa 'gron bu dang*// bya rgod gre ba sram dang chu bya dang*// nya rus kun gyis nyis 'gyur cong zhi sbyar// gong bzhin bsregs thal grang skran thal bar brlag /zhi sa'i kong rdza snod dkar po bur blugs la 'dam gyis sbyar// sol ba'i me dbus bcug la tshos par bya// mu zi dri sangs tshos pa'i tshad yin no// thal ba zhib par btags la ka ra sbyar// lag len mthong rgyud gzhan nas longs// sbyor ba 'di yi phan yon ni// ma zhu lhen dang lcags dreg dang*// pho mchin me nyams dbyig dug dang*// bad kan skya smug skran la sogs// mchin pa'i khrag skran rnying pa dang*// pho nad tsha grang med pa 'joms// nad tshabs shin tu che ba la// dang po'i 'phrul thal 'bring ba bsten// nad rnams brko zhing bshig par byed// zhig nas nad ro bshal gyis sbyangs// 'di yang dharmā swa ma'i lugs/

༈ /bad kan tshwa la'i 'phrul bshal ni// tshwa la thun bdun dan rog legs pa bdun// bul tog thun gsum dur byed mtheb tsam gcig /rgyam tshwa sbrul sha pi ling dung thal rnams// thun re star bu'i chu yi 'dam thag bya/ ril bu sran ma 'phos pa tsam du dril// bdun dgu la sogs lus zung nad stobs sbyar// sngon 'gro rjes gcod ltor sbyong spyi dang mthun// phan yon ma zhu lhen dang lcags dreg dang*// mchin khrag pho bar lhung dang pho rlung sbos// 'or dang grang skran rigs rnams gang la yang*// tsha la'i 'phru bshal gdams pa 'di nyid mchog /ces so/ ༈ /bad kan mgul 'gag sman skor las/ spang rgyan dkar po 030 ar nag 008 snying zho sha 010 tsandan dkar po 010 dzā ti 010 cu gang 010 sro lo 010 gur gum 011 'bras gsum ar 010 bar 010 skyur 010 sle tres 011 tig ta 066 li shi 006 shing mngar 066 ༈ spang rgyan bco lnga 'dis// glo nad gre bar babs dang mig mi gsal// bad kan stod brgyang mid 'chus sel ba'i mchog /spang rgyan nyer lnga'i sbyor ba ni/ spang rgyan dkar po tsandan gnyis// a ru sle tre ba le ka /kanḍa ka ri 'bras bu gsum// tig ta hong len skra bzang dang*// ba sha ka dang gur gum dang*// shing mngar sro lo kyi lce gnyis// bong dkar stong zil khrag rkang ser// gang chung rtsi dmar dmar po khrag rkang rkang gcig dang*// brag spos dmar po spa yag rtsa ba yar 'dren rnams// gtso bo cha gsum 'khor cha re// mkhris pa che na lci 'bru dang*// za ba g.ya' kyi zangs rtsi bsdeb// rlung la dzā ti ru rta bsnan// bad kan star bu 'u su sbyar// tsha ba 'gram 'khrugs rims dug dang*// khrag nad gre ba 'gags la mchog /gtar ga mi dgos khyad chos yin// sman mchog mkha' 'gro bcu yi sbyor ba ni/ cong zhi gser mdog shing mngar brag zhun dang*// sga skya se 'bru sug smel pi pi ling*// byi tang rgyam tshwa bur dkar rta la sbyar// bong nga nas tsam gsang sman zhal shes yin// rgod g.yag khrag phul mgul 'gags 'joms pa'i mchog

༈ /yang cig mkha' 'gro bcu yi sbyor ba ni// 'di na mkha' 'gro'i gsang sman khyad par can// dom mkhris gla rtsi rgya tshwa gser mdog dang*// bzang drug g.yag rgod rakta chang sbyar phul// thun gnyis kyis kyang nad las grol lo skad// sbyar thabs btang thabs man ngag gong du bstan/ man ngag gud sbas ni/ sman kun bungs mnyam thun gsum bcad// gcig g.yag rog dar ma'i khrag phor gang gis phul/ gcig chang rgan nying khus phul// gcig chu bskol tsha mos phul ba man ngag zab bo// : mid 'chus spyi sman rdo thal bzang po drug /gser mdog gla rtsi dom mkhris rgya tshwa dang*// da li ma nu 'u su skyu ru ra// hong len ba sha ka dang tsandan dmar// tig ta gser gyi me tog dug mo nyung*// cong zhi bul tog gangs tig tshwa la dang*// brag zhun gi waṃ rgyam tshwa pi pi ling*// se 'bru sbrang sbyar ril bu sran 'phos dril// tho rangs btang bas mid 'chus pho bar babs// gre thog pho thog spu thog tsha 'gag rnams// 'di yi mi sel nad ni yod ma yin// nyang ral gter ma phyag len myong bas grub// ces so/ ༈ /be khrag nyang gter nyer lnga be khrag bya khyung lnga// bzang drug rgya ru bse ru sha ba'i rwa// rgya tshwa rgyam tshwa kha ru tshwa dang ni// tsha ba gsum dang cong zhi spang rgyan dkar// bya rgod go bo la sogs ol mdud ni// tshogs tshad legs sbyor rgod g.yag khrag rtar bskyon// mgul 'gags gre thog pho nad nges par 'joms// bad kan mgul 'gag pho thog sogs kyi skabs thang ni/ ༈ nor bu bdun steng 'u su pri yang ku// dmar gsum snying sman li shi ar nag snying zho gsum/ dzā ti gri sha gu gul 'brong snying ba sha ka tig ta mi rus/ ske dang go yu bzung na sro lo spang rgyan rigs gsum spang lce// tsandan dmar po gsang sman gnyis ni sro lo dang khur rtsa gnyis kyi khaṇḍa thun chen btang*/ lug mur skyor thun bcas btang*// skyugs na rta spangs sngo leb thang btang*/

༈ /phye ma glang chen bcu gsum ni// gi waṃ dgu steng ma nu 'u su dang*/ star bu pri yang ku bsnan glang chen bcu gsum zhes// smug po khrag tshad rgyas par bdud rtsi 'dra// de'i steng re skon/ cong zhi mdzo shing*/ dmar gsum/ 'bras gsum/ bsil smyug /re ral/ 'om bu/ yungs ba skyer shun bsdeb/ ༈ mid 'chus nad la 'brong khrag drug pa ni/ gser mdog gla rtsi gu gul dang*// li shi dom mkhris 'brong khrag drug /bad kan mid 'chus nad la bdud rtsi yin// brgyad pa de steng cong zhi spang rgyan dkar// bsnan pa yin ces sgra 'dzin thos snyam sems// 'brong khrag a ru gser mdog dom gyi mkhris// gla rtsi gur gum pi ling pho ba ril// gu gul dkar nag sbyar ba'i 'brong khrag brgyad// zhes so/ ༈ /go gre ma nu 'bri rta sa 'dzin dang*// yu mo ol krong da li cu gang dang*// gur gum li shi shing mngar spang rgyan dkar// ru rta a ru rgun 'brum tsandan dmar// se 'bru utpal pi ling ka ra sbyar// go gre bcu bdun bad kan ske nad dang*// pho ba'i nad sel lag blangs shin tu zab/ ༈ /yang cig man ngag go gre bcu gsum ni/ go gre ma nu dā li dang*// 'u su ko la sug smel dang*// gur gum gser me re skon pa// pri yang dngul chu mtshal sbal rgyab// legs sbyar phyi mas bad kan mgul 'gag nad// mid 'chus mid 'byar ske nad ma lus sel/ ces so// se 'bru nyer lnga'i sbyor ba ni// se 'bru bzang po drug dang tsha ba gsum// rgya tshwa rgyam tshwa ze tshwa 'gron thal dang*// ka bed shing tsha ma nu na le sham// kha ru tshwa dang tig ta 'bras bu gsum// hong len ru rta ka ra'i rta la bskyon// phye ma chu bskol dag gis phul bas na// ma zhu bad kan pho ba'i me drod nyams// grang ba'i nad la me dpung dag dang mtshungs// zhes so// se 'bru dar gdug gzhung du gsal// 'di la 'dra min 'dug pa 'di lta ste// pho ba'i gzhi 'dzin

rgyud kyi se 'bru bzhi pa se 'bru dar gdugs gur gum can// a ru li shi cong zhi pa'i sngags kyi rang sgra la// 'u su ka ko la pho pho ril bar skyugs sogs pho ral zhi// khyad 'phags 'di 'dra gzhan la 'dug gam ltos// na le sham bsdeb lhag par me drod skyed// rgya tshwa rgyam tshwa kha ru tshwa dang bsdeb/ khyad par ma zhu 'ju bar byed pa yin// thal sman thal sman lugs mang yang*/ dung mgron gnyis har bsregs/ sha ru rtsi hrog tsha bsregs/ dngul chu'i thal ba sogs la bsdeb/ bsdeb pa'i skran rnams thal bar rlog ༈ /zhi byed drug pa'i sbyor ba ni// ma nu sga skya a ru lcum rtsa dang*// cong zhi bul tog rim bzhin cha re bskyed// ma zhu pho sbos glang thab dang*// thur ser rlung log bu sha 'thog /gshang 'gags sogs la phan zhes bshad/ ༈ /dkar po drug gi sbyor ba ni/ byang gi bul tog rnying pa dang*// tshad ni bzhi gsum dag dang sbyar// cong zhi la ni bzhi cha ste// bya rgod thal ba cong zhi'i phyed// ma nu tsha la sga skya gsum// go thal phyed phyed re btang la// rgyam tshwa zeg tsam ci 'byor btang*// bse ru dag dang bsres pa na// tshad pa rnying pa thams cad dang*// kha zas dug thab nad la bsngags// gi waṃ gtso cher btang gyur na// tshad pa gsar pa kun la phan// ka ra dkar po'i mgo bsdus la// chu bskol tsha mo'i phul la btang*// ma zhu ba dang mig la skya rib 'byung*// me drod nyams dang bad kan smug po la// thengs pas chog pa'i sman mchog rgyal po'o// dung ru bco brgyad sman bzhi'i 'dab 'phar 'phri// gsungs pas sbyar tshe res chad res lhag gis// kun kyang mgo rmongs 'di na 'khrul med bri// cong zhi bul tog rgod brun go bo'i thal// sga dang tsha la rgyam tshwa se 'bru dang*// sug smel pi ling ma nu gur gum dang*// ru rta skyu ru a ru ba sha ka /lcum rtsa de steng dug la bse ru dang*// tshad par gi waṃ bung cher bsdebs pa yang*// dung ru bco brgyad ces bya'i sman mchog 'dis// smug po grang can dug thab yul nas 'don// zhes tshe dpal gyis so/

༈ /rnam rgyal ril bu zhes bya ba// a bar skyur gsum spyi bzhur dang*// cong zhi brag zhun ko byi la// dom mkhris gangs tig gla ba'i rtsi// bzang drug dang bcas zhib par btags// se 'bru khu bas ril bu dril// man ngag gnad dang ldan gyur na// dug rigs pho mchin nad la bsngags// ces so// bad kan skya rbab 'or dmu chu sogs skrang rigs sman skor la/ de yang 'jam mgon bla ma rjes/ gsang sman rnams ngos 'dzin ma 'khrul bar dus su btu gsungs pa ltar/ 'bri lugs ra mo che sman gnyis chab 'dren rnams cha mnyam gyis/ khaṇṭa bzo ba shin tu zab tshul gsung rgyun ltar ngos 'dzin ni/ tho kar smug po zhes pa spyi khyab tu chab 'dren g.ya' spang mtshams su skye ba'i me tog mthing ga dang*/ rgya kha shar ba gnyis rigs gcig pas zla ba drug par btus pa dang gcig /mdangs med mu zi zhes pa dang*// srad nag 'brug ma grags gong ngam bya rje ma slebs gong btus pa dang gnyis/ yang sngon ma dang dbyibs 'dra ba la bong tshad de las shin tu thung ba'i dbyibs byi'u srad chung ba dang gsum/ spang du skye ba'i chu de ba dang bzhi/ sga tig nag po zla ba lnga par btus pa dang lnga/ byu ru'i phreng ldan zhes pa zhing gi mu 'gram la sogs skye ba'i rkang ring po me tog dang gong bu srad ma ji lta bar yod pa dang drug /srad dkar nyi ma ma ldog gong btus pa dang bdun/ byi'u srin nam rkyal pa chu thub grags pa rgod g.yung gnyis las lag len skabs g.yung ba de phyag rgyun legs pa dang brgyad/ chu ma rtsi dang dgu/ chab 'dren a lag rta zhes pa me tog rgya kha can sran ma ji lta ba ston dus 'bras bu'i mtha' la tsher ma yod pa bcas chab 'dren bcu po'i khaṇḍa tshul bzhin byas pa chu thag chod khar kha tshar gsang ba sbug 'dren du yod pa rnams btab nas legs par dkrugs/ chu thag chod pa dang snod du bcangs la/ slar tsha grang ldan 'dus gang yin gyi chu sman steng du bsnan nas btang zhes dar phug em chis gsungs pa dang*/
