'chi med nor phreng lhan thabs las/ a lag rta ni/ yu mo mdel 'byin lta bu brag log la skye ba'i me tog skyes pa dong ral btags pa 'dra/ mu zi mdangs med/ byi ru'i phreng ldan ni srad ma nag chung na khar skye ba'i me tog dang gong bu srad ma dang 'dra zhing rkang ring ba de gsum zhal rgyun gyi sman mchog dang*/ gzhan yang chu ma rtsi yongs grags zla ba drug par btu/ srad nag khu byug ma slebs gong btu/ pri yang ku bya ma grags gong btu/ glang sna dmar po me tog shar ma thag btu/ utpal zla ba lnga par btu/ nyi dga' zla ba drug par btu/ gur gum ni bal gur dang*/ skyu ru ra 'bras bu dor/ ces sogs gsungs pas 'phros don lags/ ༈ skya rbab nad la lcags phye bco lnga ni/ lcags phye lcags phye dang a ru gnyis skam btags rtsi bzhin lcags 'od med nges kyis chog / a ru ra dang tsha ba gsum// da li shing tsha se 'bru sug smel dang*// gser bye gze ma lcam pa sdig srin rnams// gtso bo lcags phye thun gnyis tshad du sbyar// tsha chu shas che 'bras gsum gze lcam bskyed// grang chu che na tsha ba gsum po bskyed// chu sman gzhir bzhag bzhi cha mnyam par gces// skya rbab 'or gyi dus su chu sman phri// chu yod 'dren cing chu med skem par byed// glang chen gaṅgā chu bsgyur 'dra min ni// gi waṃ dgu steng 'bras gsum srad dkar nag gze ma// lcam pa sdig srin 'u su sbyar ba la// glang chen gang ga'i chu bsgyur zhes bya ste// lud pa mang na mtshal dang cu gang dang*// tsandan bsnan pas smug po byer chu dang*// dug nad rus zhen dmu chu mchin rgyas nad// rkang 'bam dbugs thung nad kun 'joms par byed// ces dang*/ ༈ glang chen dgu steng skyu ru srad dkar dang*// glang sna gze lcam gser bye 'bu skyogs dang*// 'u su bsnan pa glang chen chu bsgyur 'dis// chu nad rigs kun sel byed mchog tu'o// zhes dang*/

༈ glang chen gi wang 'u su skyu ru ma nu pri yang ku// rgya tshwa gser bye sdig srin gze lcam gnyis// spos dkar sbyar bas glang chen bcu gsum zhes// sman gyi cha tshad gi waṃ mdog gyur la// chu sman rnams dang skyu ru bungs cher bskyed// chu bskol ngad yal phul bas tsha chu'i rigs// kun sel mkhas pa'i man ngag zhal rgyun lags// zhes dang*/ ༈ zur mkhar khyad chos glang chen chu bsgyur ni/ glang chen kha che gur gum gnyis// tsandan dkar dmar ba le gsum// gser mdog ba ru skyu ru gsum// utpal gser me pri yang ku// 'u su tig ta brag zhun gsum// cu gang rgya mtshal ru rta gsum// bse ru gla rtsi bong dkar ba sha ka /glang sna srad dkar lcam pa gsum// dug nad rus la zhen pa dang*// smug po rtsa la zhen pa dang*// tsha chu tsha grang sbos pa dang*// khyad par rkang 'bam nad la bsngags// zhes dang*/ phye ma gur gum 050 dang ni pri yang ku/ 016 utpal 023 gser gyi me tog 008 bong nga dkar/ 004 ba sha ka 045 dang skyu ru ra 011 sbyar ba/ gur gum bdun nam 'bol sman bdun pa ste// chu mdog ljang na pi ling a ru bsnan// ser na kyi lce dug nyung bsnan// dkar na ru rta ba lu bsnan// sha lpags bar gyi chu lhag la// nyi dga' 'u su pañtsa bsnan par bya// chu bskol a bhi drug thang gang rung phul// tsha chu'i rtags che yun ring bsten// de yi dri chu bungs che pho ba bde// tsha ba'i chu de ldan nam grang chur bsgyur// ma 'gyur srid kyang tsha chu'i rlabs 'dis chog /ldan nam grang chu la yang zhag 'ga'i bar// thog mar sman 'di btang phan myong bas grub// kha tshar gong gsal btang pas gur kum chu 'bebs so/ ༈ /da li bcu drug sbyor ba ni/ se 'bru shing tsha pi pi ling*// sul smel gur gum rnam pa lnga// lus spyi'i 'du ba snyoms par byed// sha pho ru rta li shi dang*/ ar nag dzā ti snying zho shas// thor ba'i rlung rnams sel bar byed// rgun 'brum shing mngar cu gang dang*// ga dur glo ba'i nad rnams sel// da li sdig srin sbyor ba yis// chu ser skya rbab nad rnams 'joms// sbrang dang bur dkar rtar bskyon pas// sman nus myur du 'byin par byed// kun gyi phan yon bstan pa ni// ma zhu glang thab pho ba sbos// tsha grang 'thab pa'i nad rnams dang*// stod 'tshang bad rlung mgo 'khor dang*// glo lu skad 'gag lus po skrang*// skya rbab sa chu ma thub la// sleb pas chog pa kho bos mthong*/

༈ /cu gang bde byed che 'bring chung gsum 'bri lugs ni/ bsil gsum utpal se 'bru pi pi ling*// shing tsha ka ra bzhi 'gyur cu gang bdun// tsha grang cha mnyam dang ga 'byed par byed// gong steng skyu ru bungs mnyam bde byed chung*// de steng gser bye sdig srin nyi dga' ba// 'u su shing mngar bkra 'bum gces bsdus las pri yang ku shing mngar man mdzad 'dug / gze ma de kun dang*// skyu ru bungs mnyam bde byed 'bring po yin// de steng dung 'dra 'bu skyogs 'khor los sngon mo chab 'dren srad dkar bsgyur// a bhi bungs mnyam chen po yin// phye ma 'u skyur lha mo yin// thang gi phul btang tsha grang mnyam// rtsa sbug 'gag las sbyang byer 'dzag /lhan pa la sogs chu rigs kun// gsang ba'i lam du 'dren pa'i mchog /'bri gung lugs te bkra 'bum gces bsdus las/ grang bas brlan cing zug rngus gzer ba na/ pañtsa pi ling rnon po gsum rgya tshwa sdig srin gser bye gyis myur du 'bigs// tsha ba'i gzer gyis gdung ba'i nyams thag la// sman gyi lha mo bu dang skyu ru lcam pa 'u su mthun grub bya// mtsho mo yul du 'drongs pa thag chod do// shing mngar 'u su lcam pa dang*// srad dkar skyu ru glang sna drug /'di la a bhi drug sbyor zer// tsha chu rtsa lam 'byed pa'i mchog /sman nag chu sman ni/ rlung gi phag nag snyigs ma phul gang la// grogs bzhi srad dkar/ hong len/ de ba/ spyi bzhur/ phul phyed so sor nus ldan bsregs// gnyan rims pho bar babs la bdud rtsi yin// dmu chu bcos pa'i thabs bstan pa/ nad rigs ji ltar gsungs na yang*// snying po chig chog rgyal po ni// dur byed khaṇḍa mtheb tshig tsam// sga tig khaṇḍa de nyis 'gyur// ba chu'i khaṇḍa dur byed mnyam// a ru gser mdog sran ma tsam// bod kyi gur gum thun chung gcig /'di rnams zhib btags chang dang sbyar// ril bu lug ril tsam re dril// lnga bdun dgu sogs hub res phul// rgya mtsho lta bur 'drongs par the tshom med// dpyad sogs mi dgos mkhas pa'i lugs// gdams ngag srog gi man ngag khyad chos yin// chig rgyud ma gtogs mi spel bka' rgya can// thams cad mkhyen pa mtshungs med gu ṇa la// rtsa ri ru rta ye shes mkha' 'gros phul// ddharma swā mi'i khyad chos 'di kho na// nyams yig ba chu'i 'phrul sbyong ni// dmar zal ba chu'i khaṇḍa bya// rtsi bcud ldan pa dang ga'i 'khor lo ni// rnam pa bdun du btang bar bya// dan dra rog po lnga nyid la// me taug glang sna lcam pa dang*// tri byi rta rnams btab la btang*// lcags ni ba chu dag gis byed// lan gcig lan gnyis sbyong bar bya// rtsa dal mig sprin dkar ba dang*// skom dad che zhing skrang mgo chag

/chu sogs mang du 'byung ba'i dus// tsha chu'i tshad mgo chog rtags yin// 'di rnams nam byung dus su ni// bcud len kha zas yan la gtad// 'di ni mkhas pa'i man ngag yin// mi mkhas rmongs pa'i lha rje yis// rnying skyur rul gsum bcud rnams dang*// rgya tshwa'i sbyor sde btang ba yis// 'chi bdag kha ru tshud snyam pa// bla ma brang ti chos rgyal bkra shis dang*/ gong sman dkon mchog dge legs/ rnam gnyis gsung na re// gong sman nyi ma shar ba na// 'chi bdag dmu chu gso ba la// 'di las zab pa yod ma yin// de skad bla ma gong mas gsungs// chu sman bde ba'i 'khor lo ni// gser bye 'u su byang pa dang*// sdig srin gze ma skyu ru ra// a shwa dwangs ma gnas 'jog dang*// glang sna byi'u sran srad dkar rnams// cha mnyam zhib par sran tsam dril// lnga bdun tsha grang rta yis bsgyur// skom du dar ba bstan par bya// rkyang pa ldan dus phyi nang nad// chu rigs tsha grang mtha' dag 'joms// phyis nas mi ldog sna dgag ni// sgrog rus gshang dang rmen sna'i rtser// lte bar bzhi sgrom tshig dang po// bcu gsum bco brgyad la sogs pa// chu gsang rnams ni me yis sdoms// zhes so// 'bu skyogs bdun pa dung 'dra nyi shu gcig /gla rtsi chang sbyar nang 'tshod dug phyung dang*// sdig srin zangs dreg chu rtsi lcam 'bru bzhi// zho phyed re dang thar khan zho do dang*// byang pa bar gshog blangs bcas sman sna dgu// chu phor gang bsdus khaṇḍa'i ril bu dril// nad stobs sbyar btang tsha chu'i rigs dag gi /chu sbyong bla med grang chur spang zhes gsung*// se 'bru bzhi steng gser bye dang*/ sdig srin 'u su lcam pa'i 'bras bu bsnan/ skyu ru ra ni kun dang mgo snyoms sbyar// chu rigs bco lnga 'dren cing skam par byed// dwangs ma chu 'dren zhes bya'i gdams ngag go /tsha grang skem byed byug pa'i sbyor ba ni// sman chen chu rtsa bul tog kyi lce dang*// brag zhun re lcag dud pa cha gcig la// rgya zhun sga tig gang rnyed zhib btags la// la phug khu ba sbyar byug nyi mar bsro// dmu chu dreg grum chu ser rtsa dkar gza'// rengs 'khum kun dang khyad par skya rbab dang*// 'or nad ma lus 'joms pa'i byug sman no// zhes so/

༈ /da ni tsha ba'i sman gyi sde tshan ni/ ma nu bzhi thang ni/ ma nu 20 kanḍa ka ri 100 sle tre 200 sga skya 050 thang gis rims tshad smin par byed/ bad kan skya smug stongs tshad khrag gzer sel// nor bu bdun thang de steng 'bras gsum po cha mnyam bsdeb 300 bsdus grang thang gis khrag rlung 'khrugs gsum la// chu dwangs nor bu chu gting bzhag pa bzhin// nad rnams ma lus rang sar dwangs par 'gyur// gtso brgyad bdun thang bsres pa'i sprin zla zer// rje'u gtso bo brgyad kyi sbyor ba ni/ bsil gyi gtso bo gi waṃ tsandan dkar// rtsi yi gtso bo cu gang gur gum gnyis// thang gi gtso bo tig ta ba sha ka /sngo yi gtso bo hong len bong nga dkar// ka ra dkar po bzhi 'gyur rta la bskyon// don snod glo mchin khrag mkhris 'khrugs rim kyi// tshad pa gsar rnying ma lus sel bar byed// ces so/ shin tu zab pa'i phur thang bcu gcig ni/ sngo skya bo spru ba'am sngon mo 'brog dus thun lnga/ gu gul/ gla rtsi/ shu dag /ru rta/ dres 'bras/ phur nag thun gsum/ phur khra mkhan phur bcas sbyar ba'i thang 'dis/ tshad pa'i nad rigs srin dang gag pa/ gzer thung mo nad gdon rnams la 'phrod che zhing*/ gal te gtan nas ma 'phrod kyang*/ sman nyes gtan nas med par snying du 'chang bar bya/ mgo gzer la mgo thang gsum thog zangs rtsi nag po'i khanḍa zab/ lce la spyang lce skyer shun gros 'dabs zab/ snying la snying sman gsum dang gri sha zab// gzhan la kha bsgyur rig pas 'phrul shes par bya/ gtso brgyad dang ar brgyad bsdeb pas bsil bcud bco lnga/ gtso brgyad nor bdun thang bsdeb pa sprin bral zla zer ces so/ ༈ /be do bcu gcig sbyor ba ni/ be do

spang rtsi bong dkar par pa ta// kyi lce hong len rtsa mkhris dang*// rgod spos lcags kyu stag sha dang*// a byag gzer 'joms re skon sbyar// bcu gcig 'tshogs pa'i sman mchog ni// tshad pa'i nad rnams thams cad la/ 'di las lhag pa'i sman gzhan med// de steng 'dzin pa bsdeb pa yang*// be do bcu gcig grags pa 'dis// rims tshad gag lhog rgyu gzer dang*// mgo 'khor rgya nad mig ser dang*// 'brum bu be ge rnams la mchog /'khrugs tshad khrag mkhris 'gram tshad dang*// dug tshad mgo tshad rgyas tshad dang*/ shu ba ling tog rnams la phan// steng 'khrugs rlung 'gram dbyig dug dang*// grang rims rnams la btang mi rung*// don snod dreg grum tshad pa rnams// rang rang kha 'dzin man ngag gnad// gter ston dkon mchog skyabs kyi lugs// zur lugs spang rtsi bcu gsum ni// spang rtsi bong dkar stag sha par pa ta// 'dzin pa rnams ni thun tshad cha mnyam la// bsil gsum tsandan dkar dmar brag zhun dang*// gla ba gu gul rnams ni dri thon tsam// rims tshad stobs chen 'joms pa'i gnyen po yin// gnyan tshad ma lus sdud gsod byed pa'i mchog /zur lugs spang rtsi bcu gsum sbyor bar grags// gtso brgyad khyung lnga bsdeb pas rim tshad sel/ gtso brgyad steng tsandan dmar po dang*// shing mngar ru rta skyu ru ra sbyor bas// 'khrugs tshad sel byed dgongs pa yang dag lags// gnyan rims sogs kyi sman skor/ dang po thang gi sbyor ba la/ bdud rtsi bum chen gyi sdud pa nor bu sbyar len ni/ a ru/ tshos/ rgya skag /'bri mog /phag brun/ tshwa la/ stag sha ba/ sle tres/ gla rtsi/ spang rtsi/ gu gul/ zhu mkhan bcas bcu pos ma smin smin par byed/ byer ba sdud/ don snod yar mar rdzong sgo bkag cing 'di la bskol thang thang nag ma zhes zer/ de steng gri sha bsnan pas glang thab ma gtogs nad thams cad la phan pa lag blangs/ a ru ba ru skyu ru/

ma nu/ kaṇḍa ka ri dang*/ sga skya'i thang gis rims tshad sdud par byed cing gnyan tshad gsar rnying 'khrugs sogs la phan nges de'ang glo bur thog bab byung ba'i rims dang gnyan tshad la/ gong steng klu dug phur nag sman bzhi stong zil gu gul/ par pa ta nag po/ zangs rtsi nag po/ g.yu thog ldum bzhi gaṅgā chung lcags tig /'dzin pa stong zil/ mgo thang gsum mi thod/ 'brug rus/ tig ta/ lhog pa'i me tog gsum kyi lce/ spang rtsi/ spang rgyan dkar po/ inḍa bzhi dug nyung*/ bong dkar/ ba le ka ga dur/ bcas bsnan/ yang cig la gangs thig dom mkhris bzhed do// 'di'i skabs gaṅgā chung ni 'dzin lo ma byed/ yang gcig la gang thig /gri sha /dngul chu/ a ga ru/ gaṅgā chung bzhed/ 'dzin lo bong nga dang mang dgos/ snya lo/ lcags kyu/ ming can/ dkar mo lug dug /de rnams thang du btang ba tshan mor gtong*/ nad dreg shin tu thu na thang gi sman thams cad 'dzin pa dang cha mnyam byas pa'i thang yang yang gtong*/ ༈ gam phye nad ngan spyi 'joms ni gtso brgyad steng du utpal ba le ka brag zhun ru rta gser me bsnan pas gi waṃ dgu tshang*/ rtsa mkhris par pa ta skyer shun bsnan pas tig ta brgyad tshad/ dom mkhris dug nyung gla sgang re skon bsnan pas mkhris phye bdun tshang*/ khyung lnga bsnan zhing 'dzin pa bong nga mang che dgos/ phag brun bsregs thal/ sman bzhi/ ldum bzhi ind+ra bzhi thang*/ g.yu thog ldum bzhi/ mi thod gsum pa/ gag pa'i me tog gsum ste/ spang rtsi/ kyi lce/ warta/ gnyan thub gsum/ dkar mo lug dug spyang lce warta che dgos par bshad kyang da lta'i skabs warta che na mi legs pas zhad tsam dgos/ gu gul shugs tsher/ ind+ra bzhi/ snya lo de rnams gcig tu bsre/ nad ngan spyi 'joms yin pas bzi shin tu che/ des mi thub pa'i nad gang yang med/ nad thams cad la nag po sum 'dril 'di dang ma bsdongs pa'i nad mi srid/ nad gzhi thams cad spyi bcos kyi sman yin/

sib 'brum pa thams cad la phan/ nad ngan kyi sman 'di dang po nas yun bsrings/ na lugs sna tshogs ji ltar byung rung sman 'di za dgos/ nyin phyed gi khyung thun che ba re za/ gam phye chu tshan dang thang gnyis lan res byas nas bzi yal ma bcug na phan che bas lan mang bskyar/ thang ni phur nag gla nag gu gul nag /stag sha ming can lcags kyu nag /btsod mdud phag brun shu dag nag /gnyan srin gdug pa'i tshogs thams cad// thang sbyor 'di yis rgyun lam gcod// ces so/ gi waṃ dgu steng khyung lnga phag brun dang*// gu gul phur nag sbyar ba'i bcu bdun pa// gi dgu khyung nag ces grags dus ngan gyi// gnyan tshad mkhris pa rtsar rgyug la sogs pa// kun la zab khyad lag len myong grub bo/ ༈ /spru nag nyer dgu'i sbyor ba ni/ spru nag 200 'dzin ra dug pa pa 100 bdud rtsi 'dzin dkar lo ma 100 sman 'bri tshal ma chen/ 100 /gar nag 050 phur khaṇa 050 nim pa 050 sum cu tig 050 /tsandan 050 gi waṃ 050 cu gang 050 gur gum 050 /ga dur 050 de ba 050 brag zhun 050 parpa ta 050 // bong dkar 050 gla rtsi 050 gu gul 050 stag sha 050 a gar 050 gri sha 020 shu dag 020 mu zi ser 020 // a byag tsher sngon 050 ming can nag po 050 li shi 050 gser me 050 spru nag nyer dgu'am// chig rgyud bong dkar dang*/ hong len/ spyi bzhur bcas pa'i sum cu rtsa gnyis po// 'chi bdag g.yul las rgyal ba'i pha lam ste// sle tres thang ngam chu tshan tsha mos phul// sbyor tshad rang rang nad kyi kha bsgyur sogs// zab mo chig brgyud gdams pa'i ngag la nyon// bal nad rgyu gzer gag lhog 'brum nag dang*// mkhris pa rtsar rgyug gzer thung sum 'brel sogs// dus ngan gnyan rims par pa ta zhes pa// bcos dka' 'gro srog myur du len byed pa'i// gnyan tshad rlung gsum 'thab pa'i nad kyi rigs// mi byer bsdu gsod ma lus byed pa'i mchog /byis pa rgan po zung zad ma gtogs pa// sman sbyor log pa'i nyes pa 'dir mi 'byung*// de phyir nad brgya sman gcig bzung yang rung*// zhes so/

༈ /khyung chen nyer lnga'i sbyor ba ni/ sman chen 010 gla rtsi 003 ru rta dang 010 // shu dag 010 a ru ra 010 dang lnga// rgyal po khyung lngas gdan sa gnon// chu rtsa thar nu khrom bu dang*// dur byid dan rog rnam pa lnga// dmag dpon khyung lngas dgra rnams 'ded// bod kyi sdig pa rgya skag dang*// dom mkhris spang spos shing kun lnga// btsun mo khyung lngas 'jam bsdeb btsal// gi waṃ tsandan dkar dmar dang*// mtshal dkar rgya tshwa rnam pa lnga// blon chen khyung lngas kha lo bsgyur// dzā ti sha chen ba sha ka /'dzin pa nag po gu gul lnga// 'bangs kyi khyung lngas lasakun bsgrub// thun tshad sman chen zho phyed do// a ru ra ni zho do sbyar// gla rtsi thun chung gzhan zho do// lo brgyad dri chus 'dam btags bya// ril bu che chung sran ma tsam// thun tshad na so lus stobs sbyar// nad rigs gzhi brgya rtsa bzhi dang*// gdon rigs sum brgya drug cu dang*// khyad par mdze nad gza' klu'i gdon// gag lhog gzer gsum gnyan ya ma// kun la phan pa khyung chen yin/ ༈ /gung ba'i pra thang khyad 'phags ni// sngo yi rgyal po bdud rtsi gang sham pa gnyen 'dul ba// ma gi ta gla rtsi dang spur dug stag sha ser/ a ru ra/ /ra rlon bong nga g.yul ngor dar thod can/ tsher sngon/ /kha skong cu gur gi gsum bsnan// stobs can zungs bzang phal cher la// sngo bzhi tig ta/ hong len/ ba sha /bong dkar/ dag kyang bsnan pa'o// gnyan tshad rims sogs kun la bsngags// zhes sogs phan yon rgyas pa gzhung du gsal/ ༈ /gtso brgyad g.yu ral sbyor ba ni/ gtso brgyad steng du a ru ba le ka /gu gul sman chen dngul chu bcas pa yis// tsha ba khrag mkhris 'gram 'khrugs rims nad dang*// sa gsum nad gdon zhe sdang 'byung po'i tshogs// skad cig nyid la 'joms pa'i dpa' bo ste// rig byed rgyal po gzhan na yod min pa'i// rin chen srog sbyin yin zhes snying la chongs/

༈ /khyung lnga mdog bzhi byed pa'i skabs/ sman chen 200 a ru 200 ru rta 050 shu dag 020 gla rtsi 011 a ru sman chen lo brgyad dri chus bran// nyin gcig 'dam thag kha dog smug po yong*// ru rta btab nas nyin gcig nag por 'gyur// de rjes dngul chu tsha 'dul 050 'debs// nyin gcig 'dam thag byas pas smug nag 'gyur// shu dag btab nas 'dam thag sngo sangs 'ong*// kha tshar bzang drug chu ser sman gsum rnams// thun bzang lnga yi tshad tsam zhib btags btab// gu gul bzang po zho gang chu skyogs gang*// bskol nas phyed bsdus bran te 'dam thag ni// nyin gcig byas pa'i ram gyi mdog thon dus/ gla rtsi chu sbangs yud tsam dkrugs la bsnur// ja yun gcig tsam 'thag nas ril bu dril// 'jam mgon dharma kā ra'i phyag len lugs 'dis nad rigs gang la'ang phan zhing khyad par gnyan rims srin glang thabs/ rma thor/ mkhal rked rkang nad/ gag lhog /chu ser sogs dang snyigs dus ngos bzung dka' ba'i nad rigs gang la'ang sman gnad thon tsam lan 'ga' re btang bas phan pa myong grub ma'o// ༈ 'bri lugs sman nag 'phrul 'khor chen mo'i phyag len chu 'bebs su bkod pa/ oṃ a thā/ dpal ldan rgyud dang dwags po'i dgongs pa dpal 'bri gung pa'i lugs kyi sman nag 'phrul 'khor chen mo la/ gtso bo ga pur nag po phag brun puṣkar mu la khams rus tig ta/ a ru ra/ grogs la srad dkar/ hong len/ sngo de ba/ shing spyi bzhur/ lcum rtsa/ chu rtsa/ sho rtsa/ snya lo'i rtsa ba ste/ gtso grogs dgu po so sor po nus bsregs bcas sman sna bcu gnyis rtsa ba'i sman steng kha bsgyur/ de ba/ gser me/ parpa ta/ ga dur/ a ru ra ste de ba lnga/ mi thod rnying pa/ 'brug rus/ tig ta/ g.ya' kyi/ a byag gzer 'joms tsher sngon 'dres pa mgo thang lnga/ dug nyung*/ bong dkar/ ga dur/ ba le ka ste inḍa bzhi/ dom mkhris/ gser me/ dug nyung*/ gla sgang*/ bong dkar/

ba le ka /re skon te mkhris phye bdun/ ma nu/ kaṇḍa ka ri/ sle tres/ sga skya ste ma nu bzhi/ tshos/ btsod/ shug pa tsher can te dmar po gsum/ gso dka'i nad kun gyi gnyen po/ dngul chu grang 'dul/ hong len/ ba sha ka /bong dkar/ tig ta ste khrag mkhris gnyen po bzhi/ gla rtsi/ shu dag nag po/ gi waṃ ste 'brum pa'i gnyen sman bzhi dang*/ gsang sman/ rta bon/ a ru ra/ 'dzin pa/ kyi lce/ hong len ste chams pa'i gnyen po bzhi/ gla rtsi/ gu gul/ rta bon gyi thal ba ste nywa lhog gi gnyen po gsum/ stag sha /gu gul/ 'dzin pa bcu bdun gag pa'i gnyen po gsum/ gla rtsi/ gu gul/ 'dzin pa ste gnyan tshad spyi'i sman gsum bcas/ spyir sman sna drug cu rtsa gsum/ sngo de ba sogs ldab 'phar nyi shu phri bas bzhi bcu rtsa gsum/ de steng kyi lce/ spang rtsi spang rgyan dkar po ste lhog pa'i gnyen po gsum/ ming can nag po/ rgod spos nag po spru ma nag po ste khyad par gyi sman gsum bsnan pas lnga bcu tham pa/ kyi lce gong du song ba 'phri bas/ bzhi bcu rtsa dgu'o// yang gzhung du/ brag zhun/ bong dkar/ 'jib rtsi/ gser me tog bsnan pas pho bar khrag mkhris lhung ba sel/ zhes pa bong dkar/ gong du song ba'i 'phros sman gsum bcas nga gnyis/ de lta bu'i sman rnams las ga pur nag po/ gnam ma mthong bar nus bsregs thal/ srang bcu drug /khams rus srang bzhi/ sum cu tig dang lcags tig 'dres pa srang do/ a ru srang gang*/ thal sman brgyad bsregs thal ba ngo ma sogs gzhan thams cad srang re brtsi dgos pas srang bzhi re bsregs na srang gang yar mtho tsam 'byung bar snang*/ ldab 'phar rigs phal cher mang po gtong ma dgos kyang phyag len la cung zad re btang srol ltar zho lnga re tsam dang khyad par thal sman du yod pa'i de ba lta bu ni zur du ma bsregs pa'ang srang re btang na legs/ bdud rtsi lo ma sum cha gnyis dang*/ 'dzin pa nus ldan sum cha gcig gis rtsis byas te gnyis ka bsdoms pas cha mang nyung sna tshogs bshad kyang sman gnad thon pa re/

gla rtsi dri thon tsam bcas zhib btags/ brag zhun khaṇḍa srang gang*/ phur mong nag po'i lo ma rgyas dus kyi khaṇḍa srang gang*/ ba dmar zal gyi chu sman gyi tshod dang sbyar ba bcas kyis 'dam thag nyin gnyis byas te ril bu sran 'phos tsam du dril cung zad skam nas ril chags thim par byas la byin gyis brlabs/ rlung mi 'chor ba'i snod du bsil sman gyi dri dang bcas te chags bya/ 'di ni tshad pa gsar rnying byer gsum gag lhog cham gsum 'brum rigs rgyu gzer dmar bshal gtsor gyur gnyan rigs bco brgyad la phan zhing gzhan yang dmu chu sogs khongs nad rigs thams cad kyis mtshon nad rigs thams cad la phan pas 'chi med sman nag 'phrul 'khor spyi sman chen mo ngo mtshar srog gter zhes yongs su grags/ sman dmar gam phyi dharma rā dza ni/ cu gur li dang tsandan dkar dmar gnyis// gi waṃ mtshal dang dom mkhris gser me tog /dmar po gsum dang ru rta skyu ru ra// hong len ba sha ka dang bong nga dkar// a gar nag dang ga dur snying zho sha /a ru ra dang mo sman dpa' bo dang*// utpal tig ta brag zhun ba le ka /shu dag gu gul gla rtsi zhad tsam sbyar// 'di dag sbyor ba zhib btags chu yis 'phul// spyi bo'i gtsug nas rkang mthil yan bar gyi// gzer thung sleb chog g.yu thog mgon pos gsungs/ ༈ /nywa gas ske skrang la sogs sman skor la// rgya nag rgyal po'i sbyor ba ni/ rgyal po nyungs dkar zho do la// blon po sman chen zho gang 'di la man ngag sman dmar gsum/ shug tsher/ gla rtsi bsnan ces chos nyid dmar por grags/ sbyar// zhib tu 'thag pa shin tu gces// ril bu bra ba'i ril ma tsam// nad stobs che chung dag dang bstun// sman mchog 'di yi phan yon ni// 'jang gi sha ser mig ser dang*// rgya yi 'dzum bu ltag dgye dang*// bod kyi gnyan lhog bdun drug dang*// gag pa lhog pa chams pa dang*// btsan dug ma mo'i dal yam sogs// thams cad sel bar the tshom med/

༈ /zur mkhar ba yi spru nag sngo ril ni// spru nag gla rtsi mu zi ser// gu gul shu dag sman chen dang*// a byag thar nu a ru ra// ldong ros mtshur ser yung ba rnams// brag zhun chu yis 'dam 'thag bya// rtsa ba'i sman sna bcu gsum yin// de la kha tshar btab pa ni// gi waṃ kha che sgog gcig dang*// shing kun ba bla mu zi nag /brag zhun chu yis 'dam thag bya/ gsang sman lcags kyu/ spang spos/ shug tsher/ sbyar tshad zhal las spru nag rtsa ba'i sman bcu gsum cha mnyam des sman gcig gis nyes 'gyur yong ba kha tshar rnams cung zad btab la brag zhun chus 'dam 'thag bya/ shes/ ril bu byas pa'i phan yon gyis// gnyan lhog gag lhog rma rnying skrang*// stod zer stod 'tshang smad gzer dang*// gnyan tshad khrag dang mkhris pa dang*// sbos dang ma zhu glang thabs dang*// skyugs dang nywa log glo bur 'khru// 'dzum bu ltag dgye 'brum nag dang*// thor rigs dmar bshal lud pa dmar// ser dang dud khu yong ba dang*// rgyun skyugs 'dril dang spyir dug nad// nad rigs kun la phan pa yin// ril bu bra ril tsam btang tshad nyer lnga sogs chu grang gis 'phul rgas gzhon brtag /glo bur drag po'i nad dag la// sum cu rtsa lnga tsam re btang*// rta la bdun re zan btum byin// zhes so/ ༈ /par ṇa sha ba ri'i ril bu la/ sman chen/ gla rtsi/ shu dag /a ru gser mdog /ru rta/ sha chen/ dri chen/ gi waṃ/ cu gang*/ byi tang ka li shi/ sug smel/ sdig srin/ stag sha /bu ram/ shing kun/ gu gul/ thar nu/ ma nu/ 'di rnams zhib par btags la dge slong gtsang ma'i dri chus ril bu sran ma tsam dril la spyir du nad rims gang la btang kyang chog /bye brag tshad nad gnyan nad mgo gzer dang*// gag lhog rims dug rma ngan skrang 'bur rigs/ chams pa tsha ba'i nad la phan pa yin/ thun tshad ril bu gcig lhag gtong mi nyan/ chu bskol drod 'jam gyis phul/ ༈ gnyan tshad rma thor rta yi sman/
ar rgod zhes pa'i ril bu la/ mo byung rdo ba dkar rtse steng*/ rin chen bzhi pa'i shes rab nang*/ sman chen

100 dri glang 010 zhib btul myos byed bcud kyis brlan/ rgya zab phub ma bsregs byed sbar// phyi 'bang sgro yi dri bzhin g.yob// drod byung gzugs med sgrib shing gis dkrug /mdangs lnga'i bsteg byed kyis g.yab mos dug phyung*/ brda yig sngags kyi rgyas gdab/ zlum po bra ril bzhin du bcos// khyu mchog gnyan rgod dgrar langs pa'i// slar skyes mdzod du sbas nas nyar tshag bya// rma gsar sbrum ma dag la spangs// de steng nad la bdud rtsi 'dra// sro ma rta ri'i bshal sman ni// a ru sman chen shu dag nag /chu rtsa 'jib rtsi gu gul dang*// stag sha thar nu bong nga dkar// kyi lce dkar po sug smel rnams// thun tshad zhal shes ltar sbyar ba// glo tshad gzer thung dmar bshal skabs/ sman bungs dang mnyam pa'i thar nu'i khaṇḍa dang*/ 'dam 'thag gi khu ba lcags kyi dri chur 'tshod pa'i khu ba bya/ zhib par btags la lo brgyad chus// 'dam 'thags legs par byas pa'i rjes// ril bu sran ma 'bring ba tsam// nad tshod nad kyi stobs dang sbyar/ ༈ /sman mchog sro ma rta ri 'dis// stod du bab pa'i tshad rims dang*// smad du bab pa'i rgyu gzer dang*// lhog pa dang ni gag pa dang*// khyad par gnyan tshad rims la bsngags// chams pa'i nad la bdud rtsir mtshungs// khong du gsum gsum btang ba yis// rdo rje'i go khrab lus la thebs// smin long med pa'i tshad pa la// nyin zhag dgu nas dus su smin// ces so/ ༈ /gnyen sbyong drag po bcu gsum ni/ gi waṃ 2 gur gum 1 cu gang 1 gsum/ gri sha 1 shog shing 1 shu dag 1 gsum/ gla ba 1 gu gul 1 sman chen 1 gsum/ dur byid 1 thar nu 1 chu rtsa 1 gsum// a ru ra dang 5 bcu gsum mo// gnyan tshad gdug pa gsod sbyong byed// de phyir 'di nyid gces par zungs/ ༈ /mgo gzer mgo thang gsum pa'i steng*// gur gum g.ya' kyi a byag 'dzin pa dkar// bong dkar dom mkhris gangs thig gser me tog

/thang phrom dkar po rdo dreg sbyor ba 'di// man ngag gur gum bcu gsum zhes grags pa// khrag mkhris mgo nad ya ma dkar nag dang*// klad pa'i tshad rigs mtha' dag 'joms zhes bshad/ ༈ /'brum bcos skabs kyi sle tre bdun thang ni// sle tre 'bras bu gsum dang li ga dur// tig ta ba sha ka sbyar bdun thang gi /bdun po de steng rtsod tshos zhu mkhan// lug chung sgang thog lug sho phag ril phul// ba spu'i sgo 'byed 'brum pa phyi ru 'dren// phyi 'phul thor ba snga mas 'bur ba'i tshe// bsil lnga tsandan dkar po/ gur gum/ cu gang*/ gi waṃ/ gla rtsi/ rdo sman bzhi sbal/ mdung*/ gangs/ mtshal/ dang 'ju byed tsha la btul ma gcig /gnyan 'joms dngul chu mu zis bshig pa khog srung stag sha gsang sman 'dzin pa khyad 'phags a ru ra gcig /bco lnga'i 'brum bu g.yul las rgyal// 'brum gcod slar yang phyi ru drangs pa ni// tsha 'dzim ra dug pa'i rtsa ba dkar po rus thang gis 'phul/ ༈ /dngos gzhi'i sman ni gnyan tshad skabs su/ sib thang ni/ skyu ru hong len ba le ba sha ka'i// bzhi thang bstan pas/ thang nag btang ba shin tu zab/ ma nu bzhi thang tshad pa'i skabs su 'ong*/ ༈ /gnyan rims lce 'bab gag pa'i sman skor la/ phan pa kun gag pa'i ldan sbyor ba ni// dkar po chig thub zho bzhi la// gu gul 'dzin pa a ru ra// yung ba stag sha shu dag dang*// rgya tshwa me ru byi tang ka /sman chen rnams ni cha re re// sbyor bas rnam rgyal dgu pa zer// ser po rta sdud gnyis kyang tshang*// 'di ni gag lhog cham pa sogs// log 'khreb khong shor khyi chu thab// ya ma kha med gnyen dang ni// lce 'bam 'joms shing khyad par du// sman btang gnyid log rnag tu 'gugs// gag pa'i skrang ro gcod pa'i phyir// sga skya shu dag mtshur nag dang*// me tog gsum pa mu zi'i phye// gre bar 'phul btab bdud rtsi yin/ ༈ /spyang lce bdun pa'i sbyor ba ni// spyang lce skyi 'bru sga skya dang*// sgog gcig rgya tshwa shu dag nag

/g.yer ma zhib btags lce steng byug /dar dmar gyis bkab yun ring bzhag /lce skrang 'joms pa lag len yin// shu dag rgya tshwa sbal nag sha /thar nu sbyar btang gag pa gcod/ ༈ /spyang lce bcu gsum sbyor ba ni// spyang lce shu dag a ru ra// cu gang 'dre gu gul 'jigs ma gi ta// gla rtsi spang rgyan spang rtsi ngang pa gser// sgong yung ba ru rta ldong ros dang*// chig thub warta phye ril gang rung bya/ ༈ /sbyor ba 'di yi phan yon ni// gnyan nad gza' dang bsdongs pa dang*// gag pa lhog pa spun dgu dang*// ya ma dkar nag ol 'gags nad// de rigs kun 'joms bdud rtsi 'dra// 'gro ba sems can nad grol shog ༈ /sha gnyen lhog pa'i sman skor la/ dmar chen ril bu sbyor ba ni// dang po nyung sbyor bdud rtsi sum sbyor ni/ glang chen smyon pa thang phrom dkar cha bzhi nag po gcig /stag sha cha gnyis lan tshwa thur mgo gang*// 'bring sbyor ba bla cha glang chen smyon pa sogs sman bzhi po gnyis dang*// spang spos de ba gnyis po cha gnyis bsdom re sbyar/ ༈ /mang sbyor gla rtsi gu gul kyi lce ba// lcags kyu spang rgyan dkar po cha gcig sbyar// gser mdog dang bcas zhib btags zar khu'i rtsi// sran 'phos tsam dril mtshal gyi na bza' gsol// zangs lcags gwa'u'i nang du bcang bar bya// rma gsar sbrum ma mkhris nad can ma gtogs// bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rnams ma lus gnyan dang lhog pa la bzang*/ grang rlung la mi btang*/ 'joms/ ༈ /lhog pa cis kyang ma thub na// dngul chu bshig pa sran ma tsam// sman chen ru rta a ru ra// gu gul gla rtsi sbyar ba btang*/ gnyan nad thams cad 'joms par byed// ces dang*/ brag skyes rgya rtsi dug lo dang*// gnam gyi ma mthong btus la bskams// de nyid la ni cha gcig bya// 'dzin pa'i myu gu cha gcig bya// a ru ru rta gu gul gsum bzhi cha// shu dag phur nag stag sha ba// cha gsum ldan pa 'di nyid ni// sngon mo lhog gzan ces bya ba// lhog rigs thams cad 'joms pa'i gshed// bu min gzhan la bka' rgyas gdab// chig brgyud snying khrag rgya/

༈ /bye rags khyung bshal 'di lta ste// a a byag gzer 'joms gang rung chu rtsa sho rtsa re lcag stag sha gcig bsad// kun kyang khyung 'di dang mnyam pa'i khyung lnga btang gi zos pa la// rang mnyam gshog pa myur bskyod nas// gag lhog gzer gsum gdug pa'i sbrul// zos ro chu yis nang du bsgyur// gong ma lnga dag khyung la mnyam// de dang thur rgyug thar nu rkyen dur byid gnyis mnyam// gu gul chu yis 'dam thag bya// chu bskol ngad yal gyis 'phul bas// gag lhog gzer dang gnyan tshad kyi// spyi khrus lag len e ma ho/ ༈ /glo sman tsandan bco brgyad ni// tsandan dkar po brag zhun a gar nag /li shi skyu ru a ru ba ru ra// gser gyi me tog gur gum sro lo dkar// gi waṃ cu gang ga dur spang rgyan dkar// rgun 'brum star bu shing mngar ru rta rnams// cha mnyam zhib btags chu bskol 'phul la gtong*// glo tshad gsar rnying kun sel dang ga 'byed// glo 'khrugs rims dug tshad pa gsar rnying dang*// glo mang sur zhing glo 'gog dka' ba dang*// lud pa dmar ser dkar nag rnag khrag 'gag /byang khog thig zag gzer nad ma lus sel// shin tu zab pa'i man ngag zhal gdams 'di// mang por spel na bka' las 'gal bar 'gyur// snod min rnams la mang du bstan pa na// mkha' 'gro gdug can seng ge'i gdong can dang*// bse khrab bgegs 'dul nag po'i tshogs su rol/ ༈ /yongs grags tsandan bco brgyad sbyor ba ni/ tsandan gi waṃ sum cu tig /gser gyi me tog dug mo nyung*// ru rta rgya skag pri yang ku// 'bri mog btsod dang ba sha ka /a ru ra dang bzang po drug /brag zhun dang bcas phye ma 'dis// srin dang mchin pa mchin dri dang*// rtsib log ro stod gzer ba dang*/ snying rlung rgyu ba zhan pa dang*// rtsa chad rtsa 'gril sha 'gul dang*// mgo bo na zhing mig mi gsal// kha lce skam zhing gre ba tsha// pho ba rgyu ma la sogs par// rmugs shing tsha dbal byed pa sel/

༈ /gsal byed nyi zla'i 'khor lo zhes bya ba// 'dzam gling skyes bu dam pa'i dpal du shar// mun pa'i gling du nyi ma shar ba bzhin// sbyor ba 'di yis stong gsum mthong bar 'gyur// lcags zhun brdar ba'i phye ma srang gang la// gser mdog srang phyed rdo gzhong bzang po'i nang*// nyin zhag lnga bar drod dang ma bral bar// lcags phye sngo mthing 'od 'tsher gyur pa'i tshe// sla ngar blugs la chu thag lan gsum bcad// dro sar dong brus dbyar dgun gsum la bsnyal// de nas 'don la 'dam thag nyin phyed bya// g.yu rnying byi ru mu men mu tig bzhi// sbal rgyab mdung rtse dmar po mtshal dkar rnams// gzhi ni bzang drug thun bzang utpal sngo// zho phyed gi waṃ dom mkhris gla rtsi dang*// nag chung gser mdog lcags sbrul thun lnga lnga// bse ru tsandan dkar dmar a ga ru// cong zhi brag zhun gangs thig pri yang ku// se 'bru pi pi ling dang thun lnga drug /gsang sman skyu bar sha zho gsum thun gnyis te// sbrang dkar zho phyed ka ra zho gnyis rnams// se 'bru sbangs pa'i khu ba zhal skyems drangs// 'dam thag zhag gsum bar du brtson par bya// ril bu sran 'phos tsam du snyoms par dril// dar sngon btum la dal bus gnyug bsrings dkrugs// de nas dkar yol nang blugs skam thag bcad// byin 'bebs shis pa brjod la mi yal 'chang*// phan yon mchin rgyas mchin rgud mchin bsnad dang*// mchin smug mchin dug mchin rlung mchin skran 'joms// mchin nad skya rib sngo rib bar 'grib dang*// nang 'grib spos dang ling ro srod long sel// byang khog rnag khrag dmu chu skams pa dang*// glo zing rgyu long don lnga snod drug gi /tsha smug 'gying 'dril 'thab pa thams cad sel// long ba mig 'byed stong gsum gsal bar 'gyur// nad med bsten na 'du ba snyoms pa dang*// 'phel zad 'khrugs gsum nyes pa ma lus sel// gnod bya'i khams 'phel gnod byed cha snyoms shing*// dbang po kun gsal lus stobs bskyed par byed// rgas pa gzhon nur byed pa'i gdams pa mchog

/gnod bya gnod byed 'khrugs pa mtha' dag sel// 'di ni mkhas pa'i zhal gdams ma nor ba// kha che mngon par dga' bas bgyis pa'o/ ༈ /drang srong mu khyud 'dzin gyis gsal byed ni// mig gi gsal byed sum cu rtsa gsum gyis// nang gi don snod dbang po'i rtsa khams kun// stobs rgyas 'gyur bas mthong byed dkyil 'khor yang*// nyes chu 'dzag dri mas dben pa'i phyir// sbyor ba 'di la 'bad pa don ldan 'gyur// bzang po drug gis don snod spyi stobs rgyas// rgya ru bse ru kha sha sha ba'i ras// byang khog stod kyi rtsa spyi rgyas par byed// rag rdo ti tsha sbal rgyab gangs thig bzhis// mig gi rtsa gso gsal byed dbang stobs bskyed// lcags sbrul go snyod a ba mdung rtse bzhis// mgo yi rtsa gso chu ser skem par byed// tsandan dkar dmar seng ldeng dbang lag bzhis// yan lag bzhi yi rtsa gso mnyen par byed// 'bras bu gsum gyis 'du ba snyoms shing sman// lcags phyes pho ba'i lcags dred bzhu zhing 'gag /gi waṃ tshad 'joms dom mkhris rtsa kha bsdam// gla rtsis gdon srung mig smin sangs rgyas skyabs// gsal byed dkar po chig thub rdo mdung rtse dkar po sman kun gyi// thun ldab stobs bskyed nyis 'gyur med mi rung ba'i rdzas// zhal shes la shing mngar bong chen bsnan rlung shas che na a gar bsnan// gsal byed sbyor ba sum cu rtsa gsum 'di// mig nad sum cu rtsa gsum gnyen por gsungs// sbrang dkar sbyar ba'i lde gur sbyar ba'am// mngar gsum sbyar ba'i ril bu/ mig nad tsha 'grib sha mdzer thor ba dang*// rab rib mchi ma 'dzags pa la sogs pa// mdor na mig nad stong gi gnyen po yin// mkha' lding bya rgod lta bu'i mig 'thob 'gyur/ ༈ /rna ba'i sman skor la/ ug chos 'bras bu gla rtsi sgog skya dang*// la phug ru rta sbyar ba'i ug chos lnga// shing kun rma bya'i sgro gzhob sga skya dang*// rgya tshwa gur gum zhib btags ug chos bcu// tsha na rang chu grang na 'bru mar khur// rna bar btigs pas 'on pa sel ba'i mchog

/gur khyung mo nad skabs su gsal// ces so/ ༈ /sna nad sman skor sna sman nyes sel ni/ rgya mtshal tsandan dkar dmar a ga ru// dzā ti li shi ko la nā gi dang*/ gla rtsi phur slebs spang spos bse ru dkar// bong dkar cu gang gur gum gi waṃ dang*// 'bras gsum 'u su sug smel ru rta dang*// ka ra sbyar ba'i sna sman srang re dang*// sna tha srang do re bsdeb dri 'dzin gsur// ya ma dkar nag gre 'dzer lu ba'i nad// kun sel gnyen po mig dbang gsal bar byed/ ༈ /be ji'i mtshal lud kha bsdam ni/ mtshal rang byung dkar dom mkhris nag chung sran ma'i me tog / gser mdog a ru sa 'dzin 'bri rta gur gum kha gur rnams// phye ma dmar gsum rgya 'bri/ btsod/ khrag zag them kha brdzang dang mtshungs// mtshe ldum khur mong rtsa mkhris spru lo dang*// mkhan lo ram rol skyer shun khrag gcod dang*// kun byed rgyal po tshos btsod 'bri mog nag chung sran nag me tog dang*// gzig brun yin nam dpyad dang rta sbangs btsir ba'i khu ba rnams// dom mkhris mkhris chen bu ram dang*// 'gron bu za 'og gzig gi spu bsregs dang*// rma bya'i mdongs bsregs sngags btab khong du gtong*// bu ga dgu nas ji ltar khrag 'ong yang*// nges par 'chad la the tshom mi dgos te// sna khrag srin bal la brkus phugs su gteg /sman dri tshor ba tsam gyis sna khrag 'chad// rma la srin bal bkus dkris 'jag par bsdam// thun mong ma yin shin tu zab pa'i gnad/ ༈ /sngags ni/ oṃ khrag nyag a raṃ rbad: sha sa na ma na: sa na ba sha hung kra rakta rbad: ces so// dom mkhris/ skyu ru/ gu gul/ ba sha ka sro lo/ shing mngar/ bse ru/ hong len/ mtshal/ tshos/ btsod/ gi waṃ/ brag zhun rnams cha mnyam sbyar ba'i gi waṃ bcu gsum gyis khrag 'khru skyugs dang*/ zla mtshan dus min 'dzags pa sogs bu ga dgu nas khrag 'byung ba 'chad nges so/ ༈ /khrag gcod gur gum brgyad pa/

gur gum 100 dom mkhris 100 gser me 080 tsandan dmar po 070 rgya mtshal 050 gser me 050 'bri rta sa 'dzin 070 pu shel rtse 070 rnams sbyar ba gang 'os 'phul/ smug po gyen rdol thur du ral ba rtsa chen mtshon gyis bcad pa sna khrag rdol ba sogs khrag shor thams cad gcod pa'i man ngag go ༈ /li shi drug pa ni/ li shi cu gang shing mngar spang rgyan dkar/ ru rta a ru ra dang ka ra sbyar// li shi drug pa lo brgyad dri chus 'phul/ glo nad gre ba tsha skam skad 'gags sel// de steng khyung lnga bsnan pas li khyung zer/ 'brong spang bsdeb pa gong du song*/ snying sman ni gong gi khrag rlung skabs su song*/ ༈ /glo sman tsandan bco lnga ni/ gtso bo tsandan dmar po sum cha la// gur gum de yi tshad du sbyar ba dang*// ru rta star bu sum cha a ru ra// spa yag sro lo rgun 'brum shing mngar dang*// cu gang spos dkar skyu ru 'bri mog dang*// hong len ug chos tsandan bco lnga zhes// glo tshad gsar rnying glo rnag khrag rgyas dang*// glo 'khrugs lu ba lang dang skrang 'or la// 'di nyid zab cing man ngag kha bsgyur ni// rtsi dmar ga dur tsandan dkar po dang*/ a krong dom mkhris la sogs kha tshar ni// gang la gang dgos rig pa'i mda' yis dpyad/ ༈ /gtso brgyad nor bu bdun thang tshul bzhin steng*/ star bu rgun 'brum shing mngar li ga dur// spang rgyan dkar po spa yag rtsa ba dang*// a krong wa yi glo ba zi ra dkar// bdud rtsi lo ma sbyar ba nyi shu lnga// tshad pa che chung glo dang rus la zhan// glo chen 'gog dka' dbugs thung gyer mi pher// glo rnying brgyal zhing 'tshang nas dbugs sdud dka'// mgul na glo skyugs byed cing nyal mi bde// lud pa mang du lu zhing sna chu 'gags// ro stod tsha zhing lci la gyong zhing khengs// tshad gzer tsha sub bad khrag rgyas la sogs// glo nad brgya la sman 'di slebs pas chog

༈ /glo sman dkar po yar 'dren ni/ sro lo dkar dang spang rgyan dkar// zi ra dkar dang rnam pa gsum// de steng tsandan dkar dmar gnyis// cu gang gi waṃ gur gum dang*// utpal shing mngar a krong dang*// spa yag

rtsa ba star bu sman kun sum cha gcig pa yin/ sbyar ba yis// glo ba'i rtsa sbub rnag rnams sel/ ༈ /zangs thal nyer lnga'i sbyor ba ni/ zangs thal bse ru gi waṃ mtshal// gwa dor rgya ru bzang po drug /tig ta hong len ba sha ka /tsandan utpal ge sar gsum// ug chos ga dur ba le ka /sro lo shing mngar rgun 'brum sbyar// glo tshad nad rigs thams cad dang*// khyad par dbugs 'tshang glo nad sel/ ༈ /bse ru nyer lnga'i sbyor ba ni// bse ru gwa dor shwa ba'i bog rwa 'bras gsum gtso bo la// se 'bru bzhi dang tsandan dkar dmar gnyis// de steng cu gang gur gum li shi dang*// sle tres ka ko la dang ba lu ka / dom mkhris ga dur ru rta star bu bya rog nor bu dang*// glang chen bya rkang rgya skag hong len sbyar// sro lo thang gis phul ba'i yon tan ni// glo nad kun sel zangs thal dang dngul dug phra bsnan rnag skam mchog 'dren skam byed pa'i mchog /rgun 'brum cu gang gur gum shing mngar dang*// gla sgang shing tsha se 'bru ka ra sbyar// glo ba'i nad dang dbugs mi bde ba sel// spang rgyan bco lnga gong du song*/ ༈ /glo sman bdud rtsi 'chi sos ni// tsandan cu gang gi waṃ gur gum dang*// rgun 'brum shing mngar star bu a krong dang*// ga dur se 'bru sro lo zi ra dkar// ru rta shing tsha hong len spa yag rtsa// utpal 'bri rta sa 'dzin sbyar ba'i phyes// glo gsar glo rnying glo lu dang*// skya sob rnag tu lu ba dang*// kun la bdud rtsi nyid dang mtshungs/ ༈ /spang rtsi 'bras gsum tshos gsum ba sha ka /'bri mog bre ga hong len sro lo dkar// ga dur sbyar ba'i 'khrugs glo kun sel zhes// glo mchin mkhal rtsa 'gram dang 'khrugs shing gzer// khrag tshad gsar rnying ma lus rol du gsod// ces dang*/ ༈ tsandan brgyad pa dang ar brgyad bsres pa rma bya mjing bsnol te glo snying gzer ba la phan/

༈ mchin nad sel ba'i sman skor ni/ g.yu rnying nyer lnga'i sbyor ba ni/ lha lung mkhas pa'i g.yu rnying nyer lnga ni/ g.yu rnying mu tig byi ru mtshal dkar bzhi/ rin chen rnams zin tig gzhung ltar dug 'don dgos/ /gser mdog lcags phye skyu ru brag zhun bzhi// tsandan dkar dmar ba le stag sha bzhi// ru rta bong dkar ge sar rdo dreg bzhi// bse ru a gar 'phur sleb gi waṃ bzhi// dzā ti li shi cu gang gur gum bzhi// gla rtsi sbyar ba nyer lnga de steng du// chos sman sug smel sbyar ba'i nyer bdun pa// zhib btags spyi bzhur khu bas 'dam 'thag bya// ril bu dril ba bskol grang phul ba yis// le brgan rgyas dang ldan 'dus dug 'thab dang*// chu shor rgun bu 'or lhung kha lud dang*// gzhung rengs mchin 'brum nag po hal skems dang*// mchin dri dkar nag mchin gnad rtsa byer 'joms// rjes su mchin rtsa pho mdud gtar bar bya/ ༈ /glang chen bco brgyad steng gla rtsi bsnan pas// mchin pa khrag gis gzer ba la phan pa myong grub bo// mchin mkhris gnyis ldan la ghi dgu dang tig brgyad sbyar ba gser bya mjing bsnol zer/ zla shel dang glang chen rigs sogs smug po'i skabs su yod/ ༈ mtsher nad sman skor ni// a ru ra dang li shi gser me tog /spang spos nā ga ge sar pi pi ling*// ka ko la sogs sbyar ba'i a ru bdun// mtsher pa snad 'gram tsha rgyas sbos gzer 'joms/ ༈ /byang lugs ko la bcu dgu ni/ ko la cu gang ba sha ka /gur gum tig ta gser me tog /nā ga ge sar a ru ra// 'om bu rgya skyegs 'bri mog dang*// sug smel ru rta bong nga dkar// bre ga brag zhun 'jam 'bras dang*// skyu ru spang spos zhib btags pa// rnam grangs bcu gsum sbyor ba 'dis// mtsher nad tsha grangs med pa sel/ ༈ /mkhal nad gso ba'i sman skor ni// slob dpon padma sam bha was/ chu sman gtso bo dngul chu

ral gri khyung gi khyung lnga tshad ldan mchu// so ma thal rdo rwa g.yas g.yon// seng ldeng spos dkar sder mo la// bzang po drug gi gshog pa ste// sa bcud mu zi ser 'dre gu gul nag po 'jigs spyan mig go /yongs rdzogs dngul khyung me dbal can// gnyan lhog sa gdon zas su za// gza' dang sde brgyad ar la gtad// bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i g.yul ngo bzlog /ces so/ ༈ /a ru ra dang gur gum sug smel dang*// brag zhun tig ta mkhal ma zho sha dang*// seng phrom btsod dang rgya skyegs shugs tsher can// ka ra sbyar ba'i a ru bcu pa ste// mkhal ma snad 'gram chu sri sked pa 'khor// bshal 'bras mkhal tshad ma lus sel bar byed// de steng 'bras sna gsum dang gser sdig gnyis// ardza ka dang gla rtsi sman chen rnams// sbyar bas a ru bco brgyad pa zhes bya// phan yon mkhal rtsa 'gram byer dang*// tsha bas grang ba smad byer dang*// khrag tshab sked pa 'khor ba dang*// smug po mkhal mar babs pa dang*// chu ser grum bu'i nad rnams kun// sel byed 'di ni drang srong lugs// a ru bcu pa dang khyung lnga bsdebs pas ar khyung zhes gnyen mkhal mar babs pa'i rigs la phan ces so/ ༈ /gtso bo bya khyung lnga pa'i lus po la/ mdog ldan rgya lcam ha lo / 020 nya phyis 020 gu gul 020 mchu ru bskyon/ /zhu mkhan 026 tshos 040 btsod 014 gshog sgro rgyas pa// gur gum 012 dom mkhris 100 rgya snag 050 mjug ma btags// mtshal dang 064 sug smel 025 mkhal zho dkar po 026 sder ldan 'di// sa ris bya khyung 'dzag bsdom zhes bya ste// phal cher chu bskol grang rlung myos khus 'phul// mkhal ma'i tsha grang nad rigs yin cog dang*// srin glang la sogs gnyan rigs kun la bsngags// khyad par sa bon 'dzag pa gcod pa ste// sman nad thon nges lan 'ga' bsten pa yis// dwangs ma 'dzag gcod min kyang na zug gcog /༈ /dzā dngul rgyal po'i sbyor ba ni// bug pa med pa'i dzā ti gcig

/khong pa brus pa de'i nang du// mu zi gser 'dra zho bzhi dang*// dngul chu zho drug steng du ni// dzā ti'i phye ma gang shong blugs// de nyid thang phrom 'bru yi phye// 'dam 'thag byas pa legs par dril// de yang bag zan sla mos dril// mar nag khol ma'i nang du btso// bag zan nag por song ba dang*// mar nag khol thag chod pa'i tshe// dzā ti mu zi dngul chu gsum// 'dam 'thag legs par byas pa la// la la phud dang ka ko la// sug smel zi ra dkar nag gnyis// bre ga ze tshwa kha ru tshwa// sbyar ba 'dam btags bu ram gyis// ril bu sran 'phos tsam du dril// lnga lnga gar chang bzang po dang*// a rag gis 'phul ngo mtshar sman// thig le 'dzag pa nges par gcod/ ༈ /se 'bru nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ni// se 'bru lca ba sug smel ra mnye ba// shing tsha nye shing ba spru pi pi ling*// gze ma gur gum sbrang gis ril bu dril// 'phul byed chu bskol lam ni skabs 'gar chang*// ma zhu grang skran skya rbab 'or dmu chu// mkhal ma'i drod shor sa bon nyams 'dzags dang*// chu sri mkhal sked lgang pa chu ser zug /za phrug chu thor rlung 'tshubs brlan grang sbos// grang snyam grang srin grang ba'i grum bu sogs// grang nad kun la dus mtha'i me lta bu// khyad par pho ba'i me drod chu lam 'byed// dwangs ma gnas 'jog chu ser rang sar skem// lus stobs bskyed cing tshe ring bcud len 'gyur/ ༈ /mkhal ma'i nad gso go yu dgu sbyor ni// gtso bo mkhal ma go yu bzang po gcig /zho sha brag zhun gla rtsi 'bras sna gsum// sug smel bre ga rnams te bu ram sbyar// mkhal ma'i nad sel nyams rtogs rgyas par byed// tsha ba stobs ldan gur gum shug tsher bsnan// ka ra sbyar tshe tshos gsum thang gis 'phul// grang bar tsha ba gsum dang tshwa sna gsum// a rag gar chang 'phul btang me drod bskyed// chu sri rgya tshwa sdig srin gser bye bsdebs// lcam 'bras thang gi 'phul bas dgos dgu 'grub// ces so/

༈ /se 'bru bco lnga'i sbyor ba ni/ se 'bru lnga dang khyung lnga dang*// rtsa ba lnga sbyar bco lnga 'dis// mkhal mar grang gnyan rtsa dkar dang*// grum bu warta mkhal gcong sel// ces 'dug ༈ /'gram la chos nyid dmar po'i sbyor ba ni// gtso bo yungs dkar cha gnyis la// bi ṣa nag po cha gcig bsdebs// grogs su nā gi de dang mtshungs// mgrin bzang bong thug rakta bi ṣa mnyam// chu ser sman gsum cha phyed re// dngul chu gla rtsi zhad tsam sbyar// brag zhun chus sbrus bra ril tsam// seng ldeng khu bas phul la btang*// phan yon mo nad rtsa byer dang*// chu ser rus la zhan pa dang*// gza' klu gnyan gyi gnod pa dang*// dreg dang grum bu dkar nag dang*// rkang 'bam mkhal nad srin thor rigs// mdze nad chu ser mtha' dag sel// zab rgya'i nang nas bka' rgya ma// yang gsang zla bral gdams pa'o// zhes gsungs/ ༈ man ngag gam phye dmar po ni/ btsod tshig sum 'gyur yung ba 200 gnyis// de phyed bong nga 'bri tshil ma// gla rtsi 050 gu gul 050 shu dag can 050 // shug tsher 050 rgya skyegs 050 brag zhun 050 de yi phyed// rims tshad rgyu long la babs dang*// gnyan tshad khrag dang bsdong ba dang*// dreg grum gnyan dang bsdong ba dang*/ chu ser mkhal 'gram dpyi mig gzer// ma lus sel byed khyad chos yin/ ༈ /mkhal nad spyi 'joms a ru so lnga ni/ a ru bcu steng ba ru skyu ru ra// a 'bras sa 'bras 'jam 'bras ru rta dang*// gser bye sdig srin lcam pa ba spru dang*// shu dag gla rtsi sman chen gze ma dang*// ra mnye ba sha ka dang sle tres dang*// brag zhun chu ser sman gsum bong khrag mtshal// yungs dkar brag rtsa ka ra brag ma'i rtsa ba'ang bzhed/ brag tsha byas na ze tshwa sbyar bzhin btang*// ril bu sran chung tsam du dril byas la// gcig gsum lnga bdun nad stobs sbyar btang bas// phan yon mkhal rtsa 'gram 'khrugs tsha ba dang*// sked pa 'khor gzer zhwa ste 'phyis gzer dang*// dreg grum chu ser dkar nag tsha 'khrugs dang*// grang 'gram dri chu sri bsdam rnag 'dzag 'joms// ro rkyang las byung byang sems dkar dmar gnyis// nyes gsum duḥkha thur du bab pa na// nyi zla gyen du bzlog pa'i gdams pa bshad/

༈ /ba sha 030 tig ta 020 hong len 020 bong nga dkar/ 020 /tsandan dmar 020 bcas pas khrag 'khrugs sel bar byed// se 'bru 020 sug smel 020 smad kyi grang ba sel// gur gum 010 dom mkhris 010 yung bas 010 rtsa kha bsdam// rgya shug 010 btsod tshos 010 mkhal rtsa 'gram byer sel/ puṣa pu ra ba 030 kun dang mgo mnyam sbyar// zhib btags dmar gsum ba yi khu bas 'phul// phan yon zab khyad lag tu long dang gsal/ ༈ /sug smel sga dang rgyam tshwa pi pi ling*// gla rtsi sdig srin lcam pa 'bras sna gsum// bur dkar sbyar ba'i sug smel bcu pa ste// mkhal ma'i grang nad rdel nad chu 'gags sel/ ༈ /a ru zag gcod sbyor ba ni/ dang po dbyangs las skyes pa'i gser mdog a ru can// phyogs las rnam rgyal sman pa'i yid bzhin nor// lang ka'i bdag po'i zas kyi dwangs ma sha chen ni// tshad ldan yang na grang ba che na mnyam sbyor/ tsha shas che na a ru cha gnyis/ mnyam sbyor legs sbyar ba// dpa' bo'i chang btung ba rtsi zhun mar khu gang 'os phul// de yis grang 'dzag dang ni dwangs ma 'phel// tshe stobs bsod nams gzi brjid rgyas par byed/ ༈ /dar phug bre ga bcu gsum pa/ bre ga 030 smad 'bras gsum 030 dmar po gsum 020 shug tsher 010 a ru 010 gser mdog gser me tog 010 sug smel 020 mkhal ma zho sha 010 ba sha ka 020 bur dkar sbyar ba'i bre ga bcu gsum pa// smad nad mkhal tshad 'gram dang 'or lhung dang*// tsha grang gang gis 'bras bu skrang pa'i nad// ma lus sel byed kho bo'i myong bas grub/ ༈ /rtsa thag bcu gsum sbyor ba ni/ dres 'bru btsod skag zhu mkhan sdig srin dang*// thang phrom ba sha mkhal zho 'bras sna gsum// gser bye rgya tshwa sbyar bas bcu gsum zhes// tsha grang gang yin 'bras bu skrang pa'i nad// ma lus sel ba kho bos myong grub yin/ ༈ /chu 'gag gi sman skor ni/ g.yer drug ni/ g.yer ma gze ma lcam pa dang*// skyu ru rgya tsha sdig srin bsdebs// gcin 'gag nad sel myong bas grub// de steng gser bye shing mngar gnyis// bsnan na lhag par shin tu zab// sug smel bcu pa gong du yod/

༈ /gu gul bcu gcig sbyor ba ni/ gu gul cog sgong tsam pa gcig /sindhu ra'ang de dang mnyam// ldong ros dur byid chu rtsa gsum// nyis 'gyur bra ba'i ril ma tsam// bong dug sran ma tsam pa gcig /gser mdog gcig dang shu dag gnyis// yung ba cu gang gla rtsi dri thon tsam// zhib btags thun tshad legs par byed// phul byed tsha grang 'byung bar bstun// gson 'dre gdon gyis mi tshugs so// lhog pa rang gi bshal du 'don// rtsa chu bsdam pa'i them pa lhod// pho long sbos pa rang sar zhi// mkhris pa yul nas 'don par byed// rgyu gzer la ni thengs pa'i chog /tsha srin grang srin gnyis ka sel/ ༈ /chu 'gag tsha sbyor chen mo zhes bya ba/ ze tshwa rgya tshwas sna drangs tshwa sna tshogs// gser gyi bye ma sdig srin 'bras sna gsum// nyi dga' gla rtsi sug smel tsha ba gsum// spos dkar 'bu skyogs bur dkar chang sbyar gtong*/ gsang sman chu sbur bsnan na ches legs/ /chu 'gag kun sel lhag par rde'u bshig /sa steng chu 'gag sman gyi rgyal po yin/ ༈ /rkang 'bam sman skor gser thang bco brgyad ni/ a ru gser mdog ba ru ra// sle tres seng ldeng skyu ru ra// ko byi ar nag dzā ti dang*// li shi tsher sngon ru rta gsum// gu gul dkar nag skabs dang sbyar// tsandan mdzo shing tshos gtsod dang*// ma nu sga skya kaṇḍa ka /stod du kha lce skam pa'i dus// so phag 'u su stabs seng sbyar// smad du dri chu sri ba'i dus// gser bye gze lcam sdig srin rnams// skabs dang sbyar ba man ngag yin// 'bam rigs la sogs khrag mkhris nad// stod gzer dbugs thung rngams pa rgod// 'du ba 'khrugs pa'i nad rnams la// bdud rtsi lta bu e ma ho/ ༈ /'bam 'beb par bdun thang steng tsandan dkar po btsod 'bri mog gsum/ snying zho rdog gcig gzer 'joms thun gnyis bsnan pas/ ratna brgyad sbyor ram chu bar gsang sman/

lab phyi 'bam thang zhes khrag rlung stod gzer kun la bsngags/ 'di yi sbyor tshad ma nu sle tres cha mnyam/ kaṇḍa ka ri nyis 'gyur sga skya tshwa 'debs tsam/ 'bras gsum nang skyu ru ra cha mtho// dmar gsum cung zad bsnan zhes 'dug ༈ /gi waṃ cu gang gur gum tsandan dkar dmar gnyis// tig ta re skon ba sha a ga ru// ma nu 'u su pri yang skyu ru ra// utpal gser me ru rta brag zhun dang*// ba le ka sbyar glang chen bco brgyad pas// rkang 'bam la sogs stod nad smad du 'bebs// de phyir 'di med rkang 'bam gso mi nus// 'di ldan 'tsho byed snying la nyi shar mtshungs// gzhan yang mchin khrag mkhris pa smug po'i nad// khrag tshabs tsha ba gsar rnying rgod// bcos rdugs bad khrag 'dus pa'i gnyen po mchog ༈ /dngul chu mu zi seng ldeng khaṇḍa dang*// bzang po drug dang chu ser sman gsum po// khyung lnga gu gul sbyor bsnan bcas pa ni//

skyu ru klu bdud dngul chu bco brgyad ces grags klu gdon dang*// chu ser mdze dang dregs grum pho 'bras srin// g.yan pa za kong la sogs nad rigs la// thengs mchog sbyor ba tsha grang rta ni tsha na gi waṃ grang na pi ling yin yis bsgyur// ches zab yang gsang snying gi nor bu'o/ ༈ /a gar bcu dgu ni/ a gar li shi ko byi snying zho sha /dzā ti hong len ge sar gu gul dkar nag gnyis// gzer sman gsum a byag tsher sngon ming can gsum/ dang klu bdud pu shel rtse// ma nu ru rta sman chen skyu ru ra// a ru sbyar bas a gar bcu dgu 'dis// khrag rlung stod rgyas smug po stod zhugs dang*// stod gzer gnyan tshad rlung gsum 'dres pa dang*// khyad par 'bam nad stod du phyur ba dang*// me steng chu blugs bzhin du 'phral zug gcog /yun du bsten na stod 'bam smad du 'babs// gnyan med sman chen tshab tu tsan dmar btang*// ma nu bzhi steng ko byi rdog gcig bsnan// lnga thang btang bas rlung khrag stod 'tshang bzlog /ces so/ ༈ /yungs kar nyer lnga ni/ yungs kar ar nag tsan dkar bzang po drug /se 'bru da li ru rta pri yang ku// shing mngar ma nu pa tra spos dkar dang*// thal rdor so ra gla rtsi shu dgas dang*// spang spos pi ling shing tsha star bu dang*// gser me gi waṃ mngar gsum 'dam bu dkar// tho rangs chu bskol sum 'thag lto stong dbul// nyi shar bar du kha zas 'dzems pa gces// rlung 'bam dkar po bad 'bam khra bo dang*// mkhris 'bam nag po chu ser nag po yi// 'bam rigs kun la sman mchog 'di nyid bsngags// zhes so/ ༈ /dreg grum sman skor/ bong khrag nyer lnga ni/ tsandan dkar dmar gi waṃ bzang po drug /chu ser sman gsum ge sar rnam pa gnyis// tig ta sle tres spyi bzhur 'bras bu gsum// gla rtsi spang rgyan be do ba sha ka /bong khrag ka ra sbyar bas nyi shu lnga// gung gnyis seng ldeng khu bas phul la btang*// skabs su se 'bru lnga pa bsnan pa yis// dwangs ma gnas 'jog chu ser rang sar skem// dreg nad ma lus 'joms zhes byang pa'i lugs/

༈ /seng ldeng nyer lnga seng ldeng 'bras bu gsum// rtsa ba lnga dang chu ser sman gsum dang*// sle tres pi ling lcags phye gser zhun dang*// sman chen gla rtsi shu dag ru rta dang*// bse ru nya phyes srad dkar kyi lce dang*// se rgod bar shun sbrang sbyar nyi shu lnga// zha rengs gza' phog rtsa 'gram rtsa dkar dang*// grum bu chu ser thig nag 'bam gyi gshed// drang srong dharma swa ma'i khyad nor lags/ ༈ /spos dkar thal ka rdo rje so ma rā// ru rta ba sha ka dang 'bras bu gsum// sle tres brag zhun sbyar bas spos dkar bcu// dreg grum chu ser ko ler 'khrugs pa sel// de steng khyung lnga bsnan pas spos chung zer/ ༈ /klu bdud bi ṣa thal ka rdor// stong zil brag zhun shu dag sle tres dang*// a ru dbang lag ba ru spos dkar gla// so ma rā dza seng ldeng gu gul nag /ba sha ru rta skyu ru bong nga bcas// klu bdud bco brgyad chu khol tsha mos 'phul// mdze dang g.yan pa glang shu dreg nad dang*// za rkong pho 'bras gnyan srin ya ma dang*// chu ser tsha ba'i nad rigs yin no cog /khyad par thig nag 'bam dang grum bu 'joms// zhes so/ ༈ /rtsa dkar sman skor bsam 'phel nor bu ni// sman gyi rgyal po bzang po drug /shing gi rgyal po dri ldan tsandan dkar dmar a ga ru gsum// srog chags rtsi yi rgyal po gla rtsi gi waṃ gnyis// gangs kyi rwa dang chu bse ru mu tig gam nya phyis tshab yi rus// 'bru rgyal a bar skyur gsum dang spod rgyal sga dmar pi ling gnyis// zi ra dkar nag gnyis dang chu sman rgya tsha sdig srin gnyis gnyis// gser shing mngar zangs shing tsha lcug ma ru 'bri rta sa 'dzin rta dngos dang*// nyi dga' lcam pa sbyar ba nyi shu drug /'bru bcud sbrang rtsi dwangs ma'i rta la skyon// mtshams nyid tsam du btang bar bya// yang na gung gnyis chu bskol 'phul// rengs 'khum rtsa la byer rnying dang*// mkhal tshad rtsa tshad rtsa 'gram dang*// sman pas bcos sdug nad la bsngags// drang srong gza' yi nad rnams 'joms// mchog tu rtsa nad can la shis// surya'i nad rnams ma lus sel// rgyun shes bu yi bkod pa yin// ming yang bsam 'phel nor bu zer/

༈ /gur gum 1 me tog bkra ba'i gnas bzang gtso bo gur gum bzang po du/ tsandan dkar 2dmar 3 ljon pa'i bsil grib na// yid 'ong lha yi bu 4 dang bu mo 5 cong zhi brag zhun gnyis// rin chen byi ru6 mu tig7 mu men dang 8// kun tu dga' ba li shi'i 9 dri bsung 'phro// gnyis med mnyam par rol ba'i thig le rgya mtshal 10 cog la ma 'dzin// dbang phyug yon tan brgyad la 'dod rgur rol// rgu drus 11 btsod 12 re skon 13 ga dur 14 rgya tshwa 15 se 'bru 16 pi ling 17 a gar 18 brgyad do// las bzhi'i phrin las dngos grub dpal du shar// dom mkhris 19 sindhu ra 20 ha shig21 khab len 22 rnams so// mtho ris dpalagyi 'byor ba bdun dang ldan// a ru 23 ba ru 24 skyu ru 25 shu dag 26 mkhan chung 27 ha ri nu ka 28 sngo rtag ngu 29 bcas so// ye shes drug gi 'gro drug gnas su 'dren// gi waṃ 30 gla rtsi 31 byang ba dug bton 32 gser bye 33 spos dkar 34 sug smel 35 nad med dga' bde'i ro la rtag tu rol// shing mngar ro 36 'gyur med thig le gcig gi ngang du gnas// bse ru 37 de ltar byang chub phyogs chos grangs ldan sman// zhib btags ril bu tshad dang ldan par dril// tho rangs mngar gsum ting khrol sbyar la btang*// gang gis bstan pa de yi lus la ni// gza' klu rgyal bsen la sogs 'byung po dang*// nyes dang rma dug mtshon dang lhan skyes kyi// shin tu gso dka'i rma rigs brgyal lkug smyo 'bog // zha rengs mdog mi sdug dang dbang po nyams// mi bzad reg pa'i sdug bsngal zhen gyur na// 'di min zhi ba'i thabs gzhan ga la yod// stobs dang dbang po kha dog tshe dang dpal// nad med lang tsho blo gros bde ba skyed// gzhan yang bcos rdugs rtsa la bab pa'i nad// 'di la kha bsgyur sbyar ram ltag sprad btang*// rtsa dkar la sogs bcos gzhan rdugs pa yis// sa steng nad kun 'di yi mi 'joms su// drang srong rig pa 'dzin pa'i byin rlabs las// ye shes bdud rtsi'i reg pa mngon sum pa// rmi lam brda la rkyen byas ma ti yi// blo gros chu gter las byung bdud rtsi'o/

༈ /sa 'dzin nyer lnga'i sbyor ba ni// 'bri ta sa 'dzin 'bras bu gsum// gser bye sdig srin lcam pa gsum// tsandan gnyis dang a gar gsum// bse ru gi waṃ gla rtsi gsum// pi ling ru rta nya skyogs gsum// shing tsha zi ra dkar nag gnyis// bzang po drug dang ka ra sbyar// rtsa dkar nad la mchog tu bsngags// rtsa chad mthud cing rgyus nad mnyen par byed// g.yu thog mkhas pa'i khyad chos yin// zhes so/ ༈ /byug pa rtsa dkar kun sel ni// spang spos shu dag go snyod rdo rgyus dang*// g.yer ma bul tog shing mngar rnams// zhib btags mar ram phag tshil gyis// lhan cig sbyar byugs rtsa gas dang*// rtsa 'chus rtsa rengs rtsa 'khum dang*// rtsa mdud gzhogs zha bshal 'dar sogs// kun la phan pa myong bas grub// nad tshabs che na de steng du// btsan dug byang ba dud pa bsnan// phan yon gong bshad khel bas chog ༈ /a gar nyi shu'i sbyor ba ni// a gar brgyad steng tsandan gi waṃ dang*// li shi bse yab gur gum ma nu dang*// bse ru nya phyis ko byi ri bong snying*// sa 'dzin skyu ru sbyar ba'i nyi shu pa// rlung khrag 'thab dang gza' nad rtsa dkar dang*/ srog rtsar rlung zhugs smyo lkug yan lag sbrid// rlung bus tsha ba byer sogs nad rigs la// man ngag 'di ni bdud rtsi lta bu'o/ ༈ /so phag bsdus khur 'u su ka ra btab// mkhurabaskang kha lce skam pa sel/ skyigs bu la/ rlung can rigs la a gar so lnga gong du song*/ bad rkyen la go gre ma nu 'bri ta sa 'dzin dang*// yu mo ol krong da li cu gang dang*// gur gum li shi shing mngar spang rgyan dkar// ru rta a ru rgun 'brum tsandan dmar// se 'bru utpal pi ling ka ra sbyar// go gre bcu bdun bad kan rke nad dang*// pho ba'i nad sel lag blangs shin tu zab/ ༈ /glang thabs sman skor phan pa kun ldan ni// rtsa ba thang phrom dkar po ril ma tsam// 'bras bu btang na nyi shu gcig

/se 'bru sug smel rgya tshwa dang*// gla rtsi shing kun byi tang ka /g.ya' kyi ma nu sha pho ra// kha che gur gum pho ba ris// sdig srin rgyam tshwa a ru ra// bong dkar thar nu dur byid rnams// zhib btags bur dkar ril bu ni// che chung bra ba'i ril ma tsam// lnga bdun dgu dang bcu gcig sogs// na tshod nad stobs sbyar la btang*// mchin mtsher las byung don glang dang*// pho glang rgyu ma'i snod glang dang*// gnyan glang dang ni srin glang dang*// phyi nang rtsa yi glang thabs sogs// kun la lto ru song tsam gyis// zug gzer chog pa the tshom med// za zi cha chol skyon lang na// mar gsar rdor ldan thug pa gtong*// yang na pi ling thang btang 'joms/ ༈ /'chi med srin sel sbyor ba ni// gtum po bong nga khyung ni cha gcig la// a mṛ ta a ru gser mdog ni cha lnga ste// a ru rta ma ldan pa cha gsum sbyar// tsa la shu dag zhes bya cha gnyis la// katpu ra gla rtsi ni phyed du 'dod// srin dgra stong sel byi tang ka 'du 'joms ni// sbyor ba 'di dang bong mnyam sbyor// mgo srin so srin khong srin dang*// gzhang srin lpags srin la sogs pa// tsha srin grang srin brtag mi dgos// srin gyi grong khyer kun 'joms shing*// mchog tu gnyan srin glang thabs sel/ ༈ /ru rta se 'bru ba sha ka /sug smel pi pi ling drug steng nyid du// pri yang 'u su utpal re skon pa// sga dang go thal byi tang bcu gsum po// 'di ni bal sman rgyal po'i sbyor ba ste/ ༈ /g.yu dril bcu gsum smug po'i spyi sman yin// khyad par tsha grang 'thab pa'i gnyen po'o// de steng tsandan brag zhun a ru ra// gi waṃ ma nu sbyar ba'i phye ma la// g.yu dril bco brgyad ces grags smug po 'thab// byer 'khrugs mi nad dug thabs srin tshabs dang*// mchin khrag tsha grang 'thab la bdud rtsi 'dra/ ༈ /ru rta drug dang khyung lnga bsdebs pas ru khyung zhes lag blang ma'o/

༈ /'khru ba'i sman skor mkhris phye bdun pa ni// dom mkhris gser gyi me tog dug mo nyung*// gla sgang bong nga dkar po ba le ka /re skon ka ra sbyar ba'i mkhris phye bdun// rgyu long snad 'gram khrag mkhris tsha 'khru gcod// brag zhun dgu nang a ru gla rtsi phri// khyung lnga bsdebs pas brag khyung zhes bya bas// gnyan rims pho bar babs pa'i nad la bsngags/ dug nyung bong dkar ga dur ba le ka /ind+ra bzhi thang rgyu long snod tshad sel// da trig smag dang tha ram lo btsan spod// btsod khrag lug mur da trig bdun pa ste// tsha grang rtas bsgyur 'khru ba gcod pa'i mchog /'jam 'bras 010 sra 'bras bsil gsum a ru ra// dzā ti la la phud dang pi pi ling*// bca' sga utpal btsod dang tsi tra ka /ka bed mon kṣa ra dang da trig dang*// se 'bru tshad ldan srang gsum bu ram ril bu dang*// gu ling 'bras kyi ril bu bad rlung rgyas// stod tsha smad grang 'khru ba gsar rnying gcod/ ༈ /skyugs nad la shing mngar drug pa ni// shing mngar 'bras dang bse yab byi tang ka /go snyod 'u su tsha grang rta yis bsgyur// shing mngar drug pa skyugs pa gcod pa'i mchog /'khru skyugs rigs la brag skya ha bo/ gur gum/ cong zh-i/ 'bras kyi phye ma sbyar bas 'khru skyugs gnyis ka sel/ ༈ /byis pa gso skor sle tres bzhi thang ni/ ma nu bzhi thang sle tres bung bskyed btang*// cu gur li gsum ga dur bong nga dkar// glo mang de steng shing mngar sro lo dkar// 'khrugs rims hong len tsandan dkar po bsnan// khyad par rims sogs byis pa'i sman gyi mchog /rig ldan chen pos gcig shes kun grol gsungs// bsil gsum tsandan dkar dmar li ga dur// de nyid gzhir bzhag gnyan tshad sel ba la// gla ba gu gul 'dzin pa a ru ra// de bzhin glo tshad sel bar byed pa la// ru rta mtshal dang shing mngar sro lo sbyar// rlung tshad 'joms pa'i ri thangs mtshams kyi ni// a gar dzā ti sle tres sgog thal sbyar// byis pa'i dus su gsung yang kun la bsngags// thog mtha' bar gyi zas spyod bsten mkhas bya// thengs po glo nad rnying pa rlung ldan la// blon po gsum steng shing mngar rgun 'brum dang*// sro lo sbyar ba'i drod 'jam yang yang gtong*// spyi 'joms ril bu la/

bzang drug /gla rtsi/ ldong ros/ shing kun/ ga pur/ ru rta/ mu zi ser po/ 'dre 'jigs/ shu dag /sgog pa/ sman chen/ gi waṃ/ dom mkhris/ gla rtsi/ ga pur bzhi po'i ril bu dril dgos/ tshad pa'i rigs su gyur pa dang*// glo tshad mchin tshad mtsher tshad dang*// don snod tshad pa ma lus sel// khyad par byis pa'i tshad rims kun la bsngags// nad brgya kun sel ril bu'o/ ༈ /rims 'khru tsha 'khru la/ ind+ra bzhi steng gi waṃ cu gang sbyar// yang na mkhris phye bdun pa'am// bong dkar dug nyung dom mkhris btang*// grang 'khrur se 'bru bzhi steng gur gum bsnan// ma chod da trig sbyor ba'i gcod sman btang*/ ༈ /tsha skyugs la/ blon po sum steng ka ra sbyar// grang skyugs dzā ti sug smel dang*// da trig sra 'bras bu ram sbyar// byis pa kha lang kha la rma 'brum 'byung*/ de la gong gi rims tshad sel lam/ gtso khyung zab bsdus byas pa'i khong sman bsten// lte ba chad pa'i lkog dum khar drud phan// de med ra pho rog po'i khrag byug gam// skya ga'i sgro gzhob ra dkar 'o mas bkrus// kha yi rma la byugs pas phan pa yin// skyes 'phral lte ba bcad khrag khar byugs pas// kha nad gtan nas mi 'byung zab/ chung nad zas mi 'dod cing sa dmar za// sha mdog ser zhing skam la rid pa 'byung*// de la bsil gsum sug smel pi ling dang*// tsandan dmar po ka ra sbyar ba la// rdo dreg lcags sel gnyis po thun log bsnan/ ༈ /ba'am bong bu'i 'o mas phul btang mchog /mo nad sel ba'i sman skor las/ smyug rtsi li shi shing kun dang*// rgya skag btsod dang 'bri mog dmar// sdig srin zhu mkhan gser phye dang*// 'bras bu gsum dang gi waṃ dang*// sle tres dom mkhris tsandan dmar// gur gum sug smel cu gang dang*// dzā ti cong zhi ka ko la// rtsa ba gsum rang mye/ nye shing lci ba dang bu ram sbyar// mo nad rigs gyur thams cad la// thengs chog smyugs rtsi nyer lnga yin/

༈ /rgya ru bse ru sha ru gsum// gur gum dom mkhris mtshal dkar gsum// tsandan dzā ti sug smel gsum// rgya skyegs btsod dang shug tsher gsum// se 'bru ba spru bcu gnyis pa// phye ma su ri'i rta la bskyon// khrag tshabs sked rus rgyu zhabs gzer// dbugs sna thung zhing stod gzer sogs// mngal skyon khrag tshabs ma lus sel/ ༈ /rgya ru bcu bzhi'i steng a gar bco lnga bsnan pas rlung tshabs snying srog gzer ba 'joms// a ru bco brgyad bsdebs pas mkhal sked gzer ba 'joms// spos dkar bcu pa bsdebs pas rkang lag dang tshigs mig la bab pa 'joms// mo nad grang ba'i rigs dang khyad par rtsa chu 'gag pa la sug smel dang rnon po gsum bsdebs// khrag tshabs stod la phyur nas snying srog gzer ba la sga lo sman dmar dang ltag pa sprad la gtong ba sogs rig pas 'phrul shes na mo nad spyi 'joms bla na med pa yin gsungs// spos dkar bcu pa dang a ru bcu pa bsdebs pas rgya stag mjing bsnol te chu ser dang mo nad mkhal mar bab pa la phan/ ༈ /mo nad sel ba'i tsandan bco brgyad ni// tsandan dkar dmar bsil gsum bse ru dang*// a gar ma nu 'u su spos dkar dang*// go snyod cong zhi

dmar po spang rgyan dkar// shing mngar ga dur ru rta brag zhun dang*// a ru ra dang sbyar ba'i bco brgyad 'dis// mo nad khrag 'khrugs stod rgyas snying nad sel// gur gum li shi gi waṃ bse ru mtshal// tsandan gla rtsi 'jam 'bras bong nga dkar// ru rta 'bras bu gsum dang ka ra sbyar/ ༈ /gur gum bcu gsum mchin rgud sbyar dug dang*// mkhal ma snad 'gram chu sri tsha sbos dang*// ya ma nag po'i srin nad sel bar byed// de steng khyung lnga bsdebs pas gur khyung grags// lar gur gum bcu gsum steng du dmar gsum/ khyung lnga rtse gsum/ chu sman gsum/ ba spru/ 'phang ma/ 'ol mo se/ brag zhun/ cong zhi dmar po/ ma nu/ chu ser sman gsum snying zho sha /dzā ti/ ar nag /dpa' yungs/ 'phur sleb/ rgya tshwa bsnan pa'i mang sbyor khrag tshabs rlung tshabs/ srin tshabs/ tshag 'grib/ dug sdang*/ srog rlung thams cad la phan no// dge legs yon tan kun 'byung gangs can ljongs// mkhas mchog mi dgu bka' drin 'khor med pas// drang srong brgyud par bcas la gus btud nas// 'gro ba'i zug rngu zhi bar byin gyis rlobs/ ༈ /ru rta drug dang tsha bsreg 'phang ma'i 'bru// gtso bo sman gsum a ga ru// tshwa sna gsum dang dzā ti snying zho sha /mdze tshwa star bu ha shig dang*// cong zhi brag zhun kyi lce pri yang ku// bya rog nor bu sga skya snyugs ma'i rtsi// sdig srin mgron thal g.yer ma mu tra dang*// gser gyi nyi dga' ba spru dar ya kan// ka ra sbyar ba chu bskol lam/ yang na skyes pa dar ma'i byang sems bcas// ril bu dril nas dam tshig ldan pas zab// mo nad khrag mkhris skran dang dmu rdzing dang*// rgyu zhabs pho ba mi bde mig mi gsal// nad chen stobs gzhung lus sbrid khol bur na// bu btsa' skran du khrag mkhar 'tshing sgregs dang*// yan lag mi bde dbugs 'tshang mal mi brten// 'phyo 'dar smyo lkugs chu nad ldan 'dus sogs// gtso bo mo nad gsum cu rtsa gnyis dang*// phal pa'i nad brgyad bsdom pa'i bzhi bcu gnyis// de sogs mo nad mtha' dag 'joms par byed// khrag tshabs rlung tshabs gnyis la smos ci dgos// khyad par skran chu'i g.yul las rnam par rgyal// gso gzhung mi 'gal nyams kyi yig chung 'di// lag tu longs la byams pa'i 'gro don gyis/

༈ /'ol mo se nyer lnga ni/ 'ol se cha gcig gzhan rnams phyed// se 'bru shing tsha pho ril rgyam tshwa dang*/ a ru ma nu 'u su skyu ru dang*// rgya tshwa sga dang bu dkar rgya mtshal dang*// dom mkhris rgya skag btsod dang 'bri mog dang*// phang ma'i 'bru dang re skon ba sha ka /a ga ru dang dzā ti tsandan dmar// ze tshwa star bu sbrul sha ba spru dang*// bu ram sbyar ba'i 'ol se nyer lnga ste// mo nad khrag tshabs rlung tshabs srin tshabs dang*// sked pa rkang dang rus tshig khol zhing na// rgyu zhabs mchin mkhris ro stod khol zhing na// lhag par ro stod khrag mig khol ba dang*// snying srog ro stod gzer 'khyim rna ba 'on// 'doms skrangs tshang ra rgyu zhabs mtshan ma gzer// rkang bol yan chad rus pa khol zhing na// kun sel man ngag 'dzam gling nor phyed grags// gyen log ri gsum ser po sman rnams gong du gsal/ ༈ /khrag bshig rin chen phal lam ni// skyu ru a ru tsha la ba ru ra// star bu hong len rgya skyegs pri yang ku// zhu mkhan mdzo tsher 'bri mog tsandan dmar// tig ta ba le ba sha 'ol mo se// mdze tshwa rgya ru mde'u 'byin 'u su mtshal// gur gum ru rta g.yer shing gze lcam dang*// ma nu gi waṃ cong zhi dmar po rnams// zhib btags phye ma bra bo'i thang gis 'phul// zla mtshan gyen log khrag nad stod rgyas dang*// mtshon phog brdab khrag stod du 'khar ba dang*// stod tshad khrag tu rgyas pa rtsa sbubs sogs// dmar nag rtsa mkhris khrag chags 'gags 'phyur 'tham// me ltar 'bar ba'i khrag nad tsha bar 'gyur// zla mtshan 'gag 'khyil khrag zhen rgyu zhabs gzer// khrag 'dril rgyu ma skrang pas bsdam pa dang*// stod smad tsha grang la sogs khrag gi nad// kun 'joms khyad par khrag mkhar chags pa bshig /khrag rgan thur du 'then pa'i gong non yin// tshabs che khrag bshal rtsa bshal 'jam sbyong bsten/ ༈ /mde'u 'byin dgu pa ni/

mde'u 'byin nyi dga' ba spru gze ma dang*// thar nu cong zhi ming can rgya ru dang*// lug thug rwa sbyar 'phral du bu 'byin byed/ ༈ /mde'u 'byin nyer lnga ni/ mde'u 'byin 130 rgya ru 050 lug gi rwa 040 bang rmig 040 gna' ru 040 shwa ru'i thal 050 ba spru 100 ra mye 080 gze ma 100 lcam pa 070 thang phrom dkar po'i 'bras bu 040 gser bye 030 rgya tshwa 030 zangs rtsi 070 sbrul sha 040 bya ma byi'u sha 035 spre'u'i sha rus 050 sdig srin 030 sram gyi mchin pa 020 rgya ma bu'i khrag 020 lcog la 030 dur byid 045 re lcag 040 gla rtsi 001 bu dang sha thog 'byin/ ༈ /gza' gdon bcos skor/ khrag sbyor nyer lnga ni/ a ga ru dang dzā ti snying zho sha /cu gang spos dkar ru rta a ru ra/ na ga ge sar li shi ma nu sga// gu gul gla rtsi shu dag spang spos dang*// gri snying sbrul dang pu shud te lo'i sha /gza' dug dkar nag pri yang ku// 'u su dkar nag mu zi 'dzin pa sbyar// khrag sbyor nyer lnga gza' gdon spyi 'joms yin// rgyun du btang na bzang drug tshang bar gces// me gza' ga pur gi waṃ stong zil bsdeb// rlung gza' shing kun gri sha drod sman bsdeb// nad rnying rnams dang chu gza' skrang pa la// chu ser sman gsum sman chen sga tig bsdeb// sa gza' dang ni grang rlung che ba la// se 'bru tsha ba gsum dang bca' sga bsdeb// mig 'grib gur gum brag zhun lcags phye bsdeb// yan lag zha na a ba rdo rgyus bsdeb// lkug par 'u su lcam pa g.yer ma dang*// lag tu dmar po bsdeb btang sngags srung bya/ lbu sob skyugs na mar khu 'o dron 'phul/ khong srung sman ni srin bya'i klad pa dang*// zangs rdo spos dkar gu gul li khri dang*// gza' dug shing kun rgya snag gam mtshal rgya skag sbyar/ zhib btags ril bu shwa ba'i ril ma tsam// nang mo re la re re khong du gtong*// zhag ni nyer brgyad la sogs ji tsam bar// nad las grol ba'i tshad dang sbyar te gtong*// lo gcig khong srung nag po dgu sbyor 'di// btang na kho nas gza' nad nges par 'joms// 'di las zab pa'i sman gzhan med ces bshad/

༈ /de tshe dud pa btang ba'i rdzas dgu ni// shing kun mu zi nag po gu gul nag /bong nga nag po rgya skyegs thang phrom 'bru// ra dug rta bon mtshal bcas zhib btags bdug /nang re bzhin du khong srung ril bu btang*// de rjes du ba'i bdug pa'i gnyis sbrags te// nang ma bdun byas gza' nad phal cher chod// 'di las zab pa'i gza' bcos gzhan na med// 'di'i ma phan sngon las nad yin pas// bcos gzhan gang gis phan pa dka' zhes bshad/ ༈ /rma bcos skor la ldum chen dgu sbyor ni// stag sha hong len rgu drus rta lpags pa// phur mong yu gu shing dang brag spos pa// a ba 'bri rta sa 'dzin sman sna dgu// dom mkhris sbyor ba khong btang byug kyang rung*// rma sman 'di ni khog pa'i snying 'dra'o/ ༈ /bcad 'byor nyer lnga'i sbyor ba ni// de yang gsang ba sgau 'byed las// phag gdong bcad 'byor yu gu shing*// 'ug pa bcad 'byor stag sha ba// gla ba bcad 'byor rgu drus pa// phyi ba bcad 'byor brag lcam pa// spre'u bcad 'byor bong dkar ba// sbrul nag bcad 'byor srad ser ba// thang dkar bcad 'byor yu mo za// sha ba bcad 'byor srol gong pa// co ga bcad 'byor 'bu su hang*// gong mo bcad 'byor gab skyes pa// bya waṃ bcad 'byor ma tang pa// spyang thang bcad 'byor rtsa a ba// ngang pa bcad 'byor khur mang pa// dom nag bcad 'byor ldum nag pa// stag ma bcad 'byor gur tig pa// thang smug bcad 'byor gzig mjug pa// nya mo bcad 'byor chu lo pa// bya rog bcad 'byor chu tshan pa// mi rgod bcad 'byor lcags gcod pa// bcad 'byor nyi shu 'tshogs pa 'dis// rmas ma thag tu sman btab pas// de ma thag tu 'tsho bas na// lha min dmag la nyam mi nga*// lus gnas sna re smas pa na// mthu nus sna re gtso sbyar bas// sman sbyor nyi shu'i gtso bo yin// de steng bya khyung lnga sbyar bas// nyer lngas grags pa lugs gcig yin// yu gu shing dang rta lpags pa// brag spos brag lcam rgu drus lnga// reg 'byor lnga pa zhes su grags// dom mkhris kyis ni rno bton pas// 'thung ngam byug pa byas kyang rung*// rma rigs mtha' dag 'drub pa'i mchog

/lus dang yan lag mgo bo sogs// chags gas brdab grum byung ba na// 'bri gung 'tsho mdzad man ngag bri// mtshan mo 'od ldan cong zhi cha drug 'ong ba la// nyin byed sman mtshal gyis kha lo bsgyur bar bya// rtsa skyon can la sgo 'byed a wa bsten// rus sbyor klad pa sdom pa'i sbal rgyab bsnan// rus tshad chu ser skem pa'i mdung rtse bsnan// klad rus rtsa nad sel ba'i khab len bsnan// klad pa'i rgya gsang ga byed gangs thig bsnan// klad gso chu ser skam pa'i pha waṃ gru bzhi bsnan// klad pa'i chu ser yur 'dren dar ya stag sha kan// rnag khrag 'dren pa'i 'bri rta sa 'dzin dang*// rtsa chad mthud pa'i sman la gong bu 'bu su haṃ can// ma tang ldum zho 'ding mchin bu'i rus pa sbyor ba'i sman// tsher sngon rus chag gso zhing lha ba 'degs// stab seng rus chag sman la mchog tu bsngags// li khri'i 'od 'phro gur gum srog gi me tog dom mkhris gi waṃ gnyis// rtsa la byug pa'i chu ser khrag ngan bsdom// ri dwags lte bas rma yi gnyan rnams srung*// 'brug gi rus pas tshad pa sel bar byed// spos dkar chu ser sbyong zhing skem par byed// klad tshad g.yu bzang nya lcibs mu tig mtshon// rdo sman kun la 'ju rtsi dar sman tshwa la ze tshwa bcos// zhib btags gar chang smin pa'i rta la bskyon// khong du bsten pas me ltar mched nas ni// gras dbug mi dgos rtsa mthud gzhom pa gso// gas pa sbyor zhing chag pa rus mdud 'grigs// rdeb pa 'degs shing grum pa lugs su chud// klad rgya ral tshem klad rtsa chad pa mthud// klad mdog sngon po song na rang mdog dkar// klad skyer kha lkugs pa yang dbye na 'byed// rus 'dzer phyir 'bud sha'u zab lam 'tsho// mig 'grib pa la mchog tu bsngags pa yin// 'di las gzhan na gab skung yod re kan// 'di phyi'i skyabs gnas dkon mchog dpang por byed// de phyir thugs kyi dkyil du sbas par zhu/

༈ /ljang gu drug sbyor ni/ hong len kyi lce yug shing ba sha ka /btsod dang spang rtsi drug steng gsang sman/ tshar ma dar btum mthing shun/ bsdeb// gnyan la gu gul gla rtsi shu stab seng thang gis 'phul/ dag bsdeb// rus chag la zab/ ༈ /'bri gung 'tsho mdzad lugs kyi rdo rtsi mang sbyor ni/ sngo yi rgyal po bdud rtsi thengs pos dar ya kan// srol gong stab seng a wa tsher sngon can// sa 'dzin sgā sdig mda' rus dang yon tan rus sman gsum che/ rus chag sbyor zhing rma 'drub lha ba 'dzin// rnag khrag chu ser 'dren skem rus tshad sel// slob dpon rje yis gtso bo sbal rgyab smug /mdung rtse cog la gru bzhi byi'u mgo /khab len mu tig me dang cong zhi dkar dmar zla ba'i cha// chu ser 'dren skem rus sbyor klad pa bsdom// lha ba 'dzin zhing mig nad sha'us gso// btsun mo srog gi me tog dom mkhris li khri'i gur gum mdangs// klu dug khong gnas 'thung chu bsil zer che// rtsa sdom rul gcod gnyan srung sha'u bskyed// rus chag sbyor zhing chu ser skem sbyor byed// lan tshwa rnam gnyis rma 'drub rdo rnams 'ju// phye ma myos byed smin pa'i bcud kyis 'phul// yang na chig thub sngon po'i khu ba mchog /gras bcos la sogs rtsub pa'i dpyad rigs rnams// mi dgos sman gyi sbyor ba gcig pu rang*// bsten pas chog pa'i man ngag mchog // chang zhim po dang sha khu sogs kyi 'phul/ 'od ldan bcu gcig ni/ mtshan mo 'od ldan/ dang rgya mtshal/ mdog ldan/ a ba/ tsher sngon/ bre gu gser thig /gru bzhi/ mdung rtse/ sbal rgyab/ gangs thig /tshwa la chu bcad ci mang*/ med na ze tshwas rung*/ de steng thar nu'i myu gu man ngag bzhin dang med na khron lo de bzhin bsnan pa chang gar mos phul/ ༈ /gzhang lugs sman skor sbrul zhags bcu gnyis ni/ a ru sman nag se 'bru shu dag dang*/ gla rtsi 'om bu dwa li gze ma dang*// dzā ti sug smel ka ped sbrul zhags pa// sbrul zhags bcu gnyis sbyor ba stobs ldan 'dis// tsha grang rlung gsum 'khrugs 'byams cham lugs sel// de steng dngul chu go yu dang*// lca ba ra mye nye shing dang*// ba spru bsdeb pa'i bco brgyad pas// grang ba spyi dang grang gzer dang*// khyad par cham lugs rang mal gzhugs/

༈ /sbyar dug sman skor dbang ril nyer lnga'i sbyor ba ni/ dbang ril bse ru gur gum gnyis// nyungs khaṇa khyung skyugs li pu gnyis// cong zhi gla rtsi rgya bong ru// gser bye nyi dga' sdig srin dkar// a ru gser mdog ba ru ra// skyu ru tsandan dkar po dang*// ba sha ka dang ldum re ral// a 'bras sra 'bras 'jam 'bras gsum// mtshal dkar mkhal zho dkar po dang*// go yu sbyar ba'i nyi shu lnga// dug 'don ngar 'dogs ril dril yod// lag len ma 'chug tshad sbyar bas// phan yon dug nad gsar rnying dang*// tshad pa rnying pa rnams la ni// sdud dang gsod dang 'joms par byed// 'di las zab pa gzhan na med// dug rigs spyi dang khyad par du// smug po dug thabs gso dka' ba// rgyun ring bsten na phan pa che// mkhas dbang rnams kyis myong grub gsung*// rin chen sbyor ba rnams gzhung gzhan nas longs/ ༈ /gyur dug sman skor gi waṃ bco lnga ni/ gi waṃ utpal bsil gsum dug mo nyung*// tshwa la hong len spos dkar so ma ra// a ru dom mkhris brag zhun bong nga dkar// tsandan tig ta brag zhun cu gang dang*// gur gum pi ling dkar sbyar ltag pa sprad// de rjes gang dang nye bas gnas nas sbyong*// zhes so/ ༈ /dug sman mang sbyor chen mo ni/ a ru brag zhun gser gyi me tog dang*/ khyung sder dpa' bo ser po bya 'phur slebs// ru rta bong nga dmar ser dkar po dang*// dug nyung hong len g.ya' kyi gang ga chung*// re ral brag spos 'om bu pri yang ku// mu men byi ru g.yu dang mu tig dang*// mtshal dang gla rtsi gi waṃ ba sha ka /tig ta gangs tig zi ra ba le ka /bse ru tsan gnyis chu ser sman gsum dang*// ge sar gsum dang bzang drug bya tshan gsum// se 'bru ka ra dkar po'i rta dang sbyor// sbyar dug gyur dug rang bzhin dngos kyi dug /mthong ba'i dug dang reg pa nyi zer dug /kha rlangs dug sogs dug rigs ma lus pa// gtan nas 'joms shing gab tshad rnying tshad rnams// gting 'don byed pa'i man ngag khyad par 'phags/
༈ /sha dug sman skor la/ thang ser bdud rtsi'i sbyor ba mchog /rgyal po chig thub chen po
