bsil smyug pa la/ rgyal bu rma bya'i rma bya mdangs 'khor can// btsun mo byi ru'i rna rgyan byi'u la phud dkar dmar can// btsun mo gser yung ba mdangs g.yu re ral mdangs gnyis// blon po gser skyer pa shing g.yu 'om bu shing gnyis// dmag dpon shel gyi spang rgyan dkar po go khrab can// dpa' bo gser sga chung mdongs g.yu lug ru smug po gdong gnyis// phyi dpung rnam par a ru rgyal ba bcas// sman ser bdud rtsi sbyor ba 'di// yul dus mang tshogs nad stobs dpag /thang dang phye ma gang 'phrod sbyor// 'di yi phan yon bstan pa ni// tshad pa'i nad rigs spyir yang 'phrod// mchog tu dug nad mkhris tshad sel// khyad par gyur dug sbyar dug rigs// sha nad sha dug gsar rnying la// sleb pas chog pa'i chig rgyud yin// ma tshad gsang sman rnam gnyis bskyed// gre ba 'gags la dmag dpon bskyed// nad ro sbyangs na thar nu lcum rtsa bsdeb// bdud rtsi lta bu'i sman sbyor 'dis// zug rngu'i nad kyis gdung ba yis// nyams thag 'gro ba thams cad la// 'chi med bdud rtsi'i gsos su shog /dge'o// : gu hya: gser zhi gong du gsal/ zhi drug kha tshar can ngag la nyon/ reg dug sman skor ra khrag bco lnga ni/ ra khrag ga pur phyi ma rgyud kyi ni/ gur gum bcu gsum legs par tshad du sbyar/ reg dug sman mchog ra khrag bco lnga zhes/ reg dug bsregs sman la/ ze tshwa 070 rgya mtshur 080 lcog la 013 dngul chu 100 re re bzhin 'dul sbyang so so byas la/ go rim bzhin du rim par brtsegs/ de thog dkar yol mthing yangs pa gcig sbub/ rdza sa legs pa chu yis brnag pa kha mtshams zhabs phyir g.yogs/ bye zhib kyis dkar yol zhabs phyin 'geng pa blugs// 'grim 'grul med pa'i sa ru thab sum tshugs bzos nas de thog btsug /dkar yol thog rdo khyer phyed do tsam gyis mnan/ thab nang du glang ma'am gom pa'i me btang*// dang po me chung bar du je cher/

tshos tshad/ sgra byung mtshams me rgyas nas sla nga'i mthil dkar yol 'og skya ha re ma song bar me btang*/ de ma thag sla nga yang du phog grang dus sla nga sbub/ dkar yol yar bskyag nas nang du dmar ser chags pa rim par dkrug /che ba kha'am ma rnyed na ra khrag gi sbrus la ril bu dril/ ril bu sran chen tsam du slar bu nang du g.yugs nas skam dgos/ ༈ /tshe bsring rgas gso'i las/ rtsi bzhi dwangs ma lnga yi bcud blangs pa// sa yi dwangs ma brag zhun sha yi gsos// rdo yi dwangs ma cong zhi rus pa'i gso// shing gi dwangs ma bu ram stobs kyis gsos// me tog dwangs ma sbrang rtsi mdangs kyis gsos// rtsi yi dwangs ma mar dkar bcud kyis gsos// shug 'bru ba lu mtshe dang mkhan pa bzhi// dgun mi skam pa tshe yi gsos su 'gyur// 'di dgu'i bcud long srog gcod nad dgu grol// rgas po'i rtags nub bcu drug lta bu'i lus// seng ge'i rtsal la glang po lta bu'i stobs// rma bya'i mdangs ldan mgyogs pa cang shes rta// tshe srog nyi zla gnyis dang mnyam par gyur// de yi sbyar thabs chen po chung ngu gnyis// dang po cong zhi bre gang zho gcig chur// gdus pa'i khu ba btsags nas 'don// bdud rtsi bzhi dang brag zhun bre phyed phyed// gud gud gdus pa'i khu ba khyor ba re// 'o ma mar srang sum cu chu bcad la// bu ram bre re sbyar ba thod bzang blugs// bai ro tsa na oṃ/ badzra satwa hūm̐/ ratna saṃ bha tram̐/ a mi ta bha hrīḥ karma badzra āḥ rigs lnga yab yum byang sems 'phro 'du byas/ zla ba yar ngo'i tshes gcig nang bar bza'// dro gong rgyun bsten rngul ma byung tsam bzhag /chung ba cong zhi phul gang spang mer bsregs// chu nang btang ste 'o ma bre gang dang*// mar srang gsum btsos lug zho tsam gyur las/ brag zhun bzhi yi bdud rtsi bzhi khyor re// sbrang phul sum cha bur srang gsum dang sbyar// dal tsam btsos te snod bzang bcangs la bsten/

༈ /'ba' sam sman dmar 'bras gsum a ru ra// sum cu ba ru nyi shu skyu ru ra// bcu dang rtsa ba lnga po cha gnyis bcas// khram khrum brdung la gdus thang bre gsum la// 'o ma bre bzhi mar nyag brgyad// sdeb skol chu tshod mar khu bcas// bur sbrang kha tshar sman sogs 'debs// ma skam bar du dkrugs pa sogs// 'di ni phyag chen rnam dag y-in/ ༈ /go yu bde bsam sku mdun phyag len ni/ go yu 200 cu gang 030 gur gum 040 li shi 060 sug smel 060 dzā ti 060 ko la 060 a ru 010 skyu ru 010 sdig srin 010 ba ru 010 rgya tshwa 005 gser bye 005 'jam 'bras 010 a 'bras 010 mkhal zho 100 se 'bru 040 sga dmar/ 004 dmar po 'jam ril can gtso bo dang gzhan dmar skya gnyis bcas/ gla rtsi 006 da li 020 cong zhi 'dam btags 020 brag zhun 100 ba spru 100 ra mye 100 nye shing 100 lca ba 100 gze ma 100 sram sha 100 gtsang sha 100 lug mur 020 bre ga 050 dbang lag 200 dbyar rtsa dgun 'bu 100 dngul chu grang 'dul 005 lcam 'bru 050 pi ling 030 pho ril 030 mar/ ka ra/ bu ram/ sbrang bcas so// sha rnams dug 'don tshad ldan dgos/ ༈ ro rtsa'i sman skor la/ mda' 'phur grags pa'i da byid bcu gsum ni// da byid smug po 050 dbang lag 050 'bras dkar 010 dang*/ gsang ba'i dpal lugs rgya mchil mgo dmar sha /sde nyid lugs mi dbang 'khrus/ sha chen 010 nas zan sha 010 khyim bya 020 dbyar rtsa dgun 'bu la sogs bsnan// cha mnyam rtsi bzhin btags la sbrang rtsi dang*// sbyar ba tho rangs dus btang ro rtsa ni// lus kyi stobs bskyed kun gyi mchog yin zhes// bod sman mda' 'phur grags pa'i nyams myong lugs// sbyar tshad dug 'don la sogs zhal las shes// lag len sha rnams zhib btags gla ba'i rtsi// se ba gnyis tsam chu sbang sha rnams btab// me nyor nang bzhag tshar shing thur mas dkrugs// chu thim dug thon chu 'dreg med par bya// rno 'don gtsang g.yaier rgya tshwa se 'bru bsdebs/

༈ /da byid gsang ba dgu sbyor ni// chu dang mgo khog stod che ba nya sbal sha'o rdo dang mdung rtse sha dang gangs sbal gsum// bya dang khyim bya mkhar dang rgya mchil mgo dmar klu dang gtsang pa'i sha gsum// g.ya' dang gong mo sman dang a ru sngo dang bre ga gsum// da byid gsang ba dgu sbyor 'di// 'dab chags tha ma'i mar la sbyar// gang gis zos par gyur pa de'i// stobs ni glang po che dang mnyam// mdangs ni rma bya lta bur 'gyur// tshe ni nyi zla dag dang mnyam// bang ni rta dmar mgyogs pa'o// 'dod chags me ltar 'bar ba sogs// sman 'di'i nus pa bsam mi khyab/ ༈ /'phags ma dbyangs can ril bu ni// res gza' phur bu shar ba'i nyin// a skyur pi ling shing mngar dang*// sgron shing go snyod dug mo nyung*// lug ru gsum dang spang rgyan dkar// sman sna bcu gcig cha mnyam la// zhib par btags la tshags su bya// ka ra sbrang rtsis ril bu dril// zhag garasum zos pa dig pa dang*// lkug pa glen pa dag kyang 'tsho// bcu gcig skad bzang mgrin pa bde// nyi shu mi brjed gzungs thob gyur// sbyar thabs lag len ma 'khrul ba// 'di la 'phri bsnan ma byed cig /kun la dge ba'i bkra shis shog /ngo mtshar sprul zhing lta na sdug pa nas// ma rgan nad par rjes chags thugs rje yis/ rig pa'i ye shes mi yi tshul bzung ba// bsil ldan sman gyi ston pa rim byon gyi// myong zhes man ngag rgyas bsdus bar gsum gyi// nad rigs bye brag bcos pa'i nyams yig tsam// yid 'dzin ched du gang phan 'di na bkod// 'gro phan sman bla dngos dang mtshungs par shog /'tsho byed kyi gral sa 'dzin pa bdag kyang sngar nas sngon byon 'tsho mdzad dam pa rnams kyi thugs rjes bskyangs pa'i mthu las skye bo rnams la phan pa'i lhag bsam bcangs te mi lo bcu phrag drug lhag ring 'bad pas bsags pa'i nyams myong phran bu thob pa tho 'god bgyis na gsar bu rnams la sman par bsam bzhin/

de mur lus pa la myong ba can gyi sman pa rgan pa dang gsar slob mang pos bskul ma yang yang byung ba dang*/ ri bo che rdzong dang sman khang gis kyang mdzub ston bskul lcag gnang bar brten/ mdo stod dbyi shod kyi sa yi char gze ma yo gwa pa'i nye 'gram gangs gzhung bya bar kun dga' tshe dbang gis bgrang bya re gnyis pa shing mo glang lo'i zla ba bzhi par/ spyi lo 1985 myong ba phyogs bsdeb sug bris su bkod pa 'dis lus can kun mi bzad nad kyi gdung ba las grol ba'i rgyur gyur cig// / "b "_ "Z sarba maṅga laṃ/ dge'o// dge'o// dge'o// //"d
